results.question: What is the direction of the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message?
results.reference: UE to network
results.model_answer: The **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message is sent **from the UE to the MME (network)**.

results.question: For the UE, what is the status of most error handling procedures?
results.reference: Most error handling procedures are mandatory for the UE
results.model_answer: For the UE, **most error handling procedures are mandatory**.

results.question: What is the message type of the message sent by the UE to reject activation of a default EPS bearer context?
results.reference: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
results.model_answer:
The UE sends an **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message.

Its message type is **0xC3**.

results.question: What type of procedure was successful for EPS services only?
results.reference: A combined attach procedure or a combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: The **combined EPS/IMSI attach procedure** was successful for EPS services only.

results.question: What does the network provide to the UE by including the T3412 extended value IE?
results.reference: a longer periodic tracking area update timer
results.model_answer: The network provides the UE with an **extended periodic tracking area updating (TAU) timer value** (i.e. the extended value for timer **T3412**).

results.question: Which entity includes the T3412 extended value IE to give the UE a longer periodic tracking area update timer?
results.reference: The network
results.model_answer: The **MME** includes the **T3412 extended value IE** in the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message to assign the UE a longer periodic tracking area update timer.

results.question: For which service type indication is the CSFB response IE included by the UE?
results.reference: "mobile terminating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback"
results.model_answer:
The UE includes the **CSFB response IE** when the service type indication is set to:

> **“mobile terminating CS fallback”**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the T3412 extended value IE according to the clause?
results.reference: to provide the UE with a longer periodic tracking area update timer
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the T3412 extended value IE is to indicate the extended periodic tracking area updating timer value.”

results.question: What is the length in octets of the Paging identity information element?
results.reference: 2 octets length
results.model_answer: The length of the Paging identity information element is **1 octet**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the EMM INFORMATION message?
results.reference: to allow the network to provide information to the UE
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the EMM INFORMATION message is to provide the UE with information related to the network,” such as the full/short network name, local time zone, universal time and local time zone, and daylight saving time.

results.question: During which procedures can a UE supporting WUS assistance indicate its capability?
results.reference: attach or tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer:
A UE supporting WUS assistance indicates its capability during:

- the **attach procedure**; and  
- the **tracking area updating procedure**.

results.question: What shall the UE do if the timer value indicates that this timer is deactivated?
results.reference: the UE shall not send another BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message with exception of those identified in clause 6.5.4.1, in the PLMN for the same APN until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed
results.model_answer: If the timer value indicates that the timer is deactivated, the UE shall stop the timer if it is running and shall not start the timer.

results.question: From what time onward shall the MME integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages?
results.reference: From this time onward
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message. From that time onward, the MME shall integrity protect and encipher all NAS signalling messages using the selected NAS security algorithms.

results.question: What is the purpose of the procedures called 'error handling procedures'?
results.reference: in addition to providing recovery mechanisms for error situations they define a compatibility mechanism for future extensions of the protocols
results.model_answer: The error handling procedures are used to handle error situations caused by receipt of unexpected messages, invalid or out-of-sequence information elements, or message types not compatible with the current protocol state.

results.question: What is the purpose of the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message?
results.reference: The purpose of the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message is to request the establishment of a NAS signalling connection and to provide information about the service the UE is requesting.
results.model_answer:
The **EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST** message is used by the UE to request an extended service from the network—primarily to initiate or respond to **circuit-switched fallback (CSFB)** or **1xCS fallback** service.

> “The extended service request procedure is used by the UE to request a service from the network.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the CSFB response IE?
results.reference: if the Service type information element indicates "mobile terminating CS fallback or 1xCS fallback"
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **CSFB response IE** in the **EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST** message **when the service type is set to “mobile terminating CS fallback.”**

results.question: What UE configuration triggers the inclusion of the Device properties IE?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer:
The UE includes the **Device properties IE** when it is **configured for low priority access**.

> “The UE shall include the Device properties IE if the UE is configured for low priority access.”

results.question: What does the network set the CN domain indicator to in the paging message for CS fallback?
results.reference: "CS"
results.model_answer: For CS fallback, the network sets the CN domain indicator in the PAGING message to **“CS domain.”**

results.question: What message does the EMM entity send to notify a UE about an incoming mobile terminating CS service when a NAS signalling connection exists?
results.reference: CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message
results.model_answer:
The EMM entity sends a **SERVICE NOTIFICATION** message.

> “The EMM entity shall send a SERVICE NOTIFICATION message to the UE to notify the UE about an incoming mobile terminating CS service when a NAS signalling connection exists.”

results.question: In TS 24.301 clause 7.7, what errors besides conditional IE errors are considered non-imperative?
results.reference: syntactically incorrect optional IEs
results.model_answer: Besides errors in conditional IEs, **errors in optional IEs** are considered non-imperative errors.

results.question: What capability must the UE support to include the N1 UE network capability IE?
results.reference: the UE supports N1 mode
results.model_answer: “The UE shall include the N1 UE network capability IE if it supports N1 mode.”

results.question: What are the two types of non-imperative message part errors defined in clause 7.7?
results.reference: syntactically incorrect optional IEs; and conditional IE errors
results.model_answer:
The two types of non-imperative message part errors are:

- **an unknown or unforeseen information element identifier (IEI);** and  
- **an IEI that is known but is not expected (i.e. not allowed) in the received message.**

results.question: What is the purpose of the SERVICE ACCEPT message sent by the network during the service request procedure?
results.reference: to accept the service request
results.model_answer: “The SERVICE ACCEPT message is sent by the network to the UE to indicate that the service request has been accepted.”

results.question: What does the back-off timer describe according to Note 3?
results.reference: The back-off timer is used to describe a logical model of the required UE behaviour
results.model_answer: According to Note 3, the back-off timer describes **the period during which the UE is not allowed to initiate a new EMM procedure** (apart from procedures allowed as exceptions, such as emergency services).

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the N1 UE network capability IE?
results.reference: if the UE supports N1 mode and needs to indicate the supported CIoT network behaviour for 5GCN
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **N1 UE network capability** IE **if the UE supports 5GS**.

results.question: What procedure shall a UE that is IMSI attached for non-EPS services initiate upon reception of a paging indication?
results.reference: a service request procedure or combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: “A UE that is IMSI attached for non-EPS services shall initiate the extended service request procedure upon reception of a paging indication.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the Device properties IE?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Device properties IE** if it is **configured as a low priority UE** (i.e. to indicate the low priority indication).

results.question: What is the purpose of the ATTACH REQUEST message sent by the UE?
results.reference: request the establishment of an EPS bearer context
results.model_answer: “The ATTACH REQUEST message is sent by the UE to the MME to request an EPS attach or a combined EPS/IMSI attach.”

results.question: Which entity sends the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message?
results.reference: UE
results.model_answer: The **UE** sends the **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message (to the MME).

results.question: Under what condition related to handover failure and S1 connection does the MME retransmit the EMM INFORMATION message?
results.reference: If a failure of the handover procedure is reported by the lower layer and the S1 signalling connection exists
results.model_answer: The MME retransmits the EMM INFORMATION message **“if the handover procedure fails and the S1 connection is re-established.”**

results.question: What is the message type of the message sent by the network to indicate that the corresponding attach request has been accepted?
results.reference: ATTACH ACCEPT
results.model_answer:
The network sends an **ATTACH ACCEPT** message.

Its EMM message type is **0x42** (binary **0100 0010**).

results.question: What is the primary substate chosen by the UE upon entering EMM-REGISTERED?
results.reference: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
results.model_answer: Upon entering EMM-REGISTERED, the UE shall enter the **EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE** substate.

results.question: What type of information element is the Paging identity?
results.reference: a type 3 information element
results.model_answer: The Paging identity IE is a **type 1 information element**.

results.question: Under what condition may the UE use the information received in an EMM INFORMATION message?
results.reference: if the UE supports implementing this message
results.model_answer: The UE may use the information received in an **EMM INFORMATION** message **only if it is in EMM-REGISTERED state**.

results.question: For which services was the combined procedure successful?
results.reference: EPS services only
results.model_answer: The combined procedure was successful for **both EPS services and non-EPS services**.

results.question: What network behaviour information is indicated by the N1 UE network capability IE?
results.reference: the supported CIoT network behaviour for 5GCN
results.model_answer: The **N1 UE network capability IE** indicates **whether the UE supports N1 mode** (i.e. capability to use 5GS NAS/N1 signalling for EPS–5GS interworking).

results.question: What are the two modes in which satellite E-UTRAN access may be supported with CIoT EPS optimization?
results.reference: WB-S1 mode or NB-S1 mode
results.model_answer:
Satellite E-UTRAN access with CIoT EPS optimization may be supported in:

- **Control plane CIoT EPS optimization mode**
- **User plane CIoT EPS optimization mode**

results.question: With what shall the MME integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages after stopping timer T3460?
results.reference: the selected NAS integrity and ciphering algorithms
results.model_answer: After stopping timer T3460, the MME shall integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages **with the new NAS security context**.

results.question: What is the total size in bits of the Security header type IE?
results.reference: 4 bits
results.model_answer: The Security header type IE is **4 bits** long.

results.question: What is the identified abnormal case on the network side related to lower layers and handover?
results.reference: Lower layers indication of non-delivered NAS PDU due to handover
results.model_answer:
The identified abnormal case is:

> “Lower layer failure during handover.”

results.question: What type of cases from clause 5.5.1.2.7 are referenced in clause 5.5.1.3.7?
results.reference: The abnormal cases
results.model_answer: Clause 5.5.1.3.7 references the **abnormal cases** described in clause 5.5.1.2.7.

results.question: For what reason may the network include the T3412 extended value IE?
results.reference: to provide the UE with a longer periodic tracking area update timer
results.model_answer: The network may include the **T3412 extended value IE** to assign a periodic TAU timer value **longer than can be indicated by the T3412 value IE** (i.e. longer than the maximum value supported by the legacy timer encoding).

results.question: According to the Device properties clause, when shall the UE include this IE?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: “The UE shall include the Device properties IE in the ATTACH REQUEST and TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages if the UE is configured for low priority.”

results.question: Which entity includes the Extended EMM cause IE according to clause 8.2.28.3?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The MME includes the Extended EMM cause IE.

results.question: Which clause of 3GPP S 23.401 [10] is referenced for determining offload permission?
results.reference: clause 4.3.23
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 23.401 [10], clause **4.3.23** — *Support for Non-Seamless WLAN Offload (NSWO)*.

results.question: Which clause's abnormal cases apply to the network side in clause 5.5.1.3.7?
results.reference: clause 5.5.1.2.7
results.model_answer: For the network side, the abnormal cases described in **clause 5.5.1.2.7** apply.

results.question: Which bits of the first octet contain the Security header type IE in every EMM message?
results.reference: Bits 5 to 8
results.model_answer: Bits 8 to 5 of the first octet contain the **Security header type** IE in every EMM message.

results.question: What does the network do if it did not accept the request to use WUS assistance?
results.reference: shall delete the stored negotiated UE paging probability information for the UE, if available
results.model_answer: If the network did not accept the request to use WUS assistance, it **does not include the WUS assistance information IE in the corresponding ACCEPT message**.

results.question: Under what condition shall a UE use WUS assistance?
results.reference: only if it received the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE during the last attach or tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: A UE shall use WUS assistance **when it is configured by the network to use wake-up signal (WUS) reception** (i.e. when a WUS configuration is provided to the UE).

results.question: What may an MME enforce for a UE accessing via satellite E-UTRAN according to 3GPP S 23.401?
results.reference: mobility restriction for the UE
results.model_answer: For a UE accessing via satellite E-UTRAN, the MME may enforce **periodic tracking area updating** (i.e. enforce use of a periodic TAU timer).

results.question: What do figures 4.3.2.1.1 and 4.3.2.1.2 illustrate regarding UE mode of operation transitions?
results.reference: the transitions between different UE mode of operations when UE 's usage settings, voice domain preference for E-UTRAN or configuration regarding SMS changes
results.model_answer: Figures 4.3.2.1.1 and 4.3.2.1.2 illustrate the UE’s EMM mode/state transitions between **EMM-DEREGISTERED** and **EMM-REGISTERED**, including the registered-mode transitions between **EMM-IDLE** and **EMM-CONNECTED**.

results.question: What must the UE check upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message regarding the replayed UE security capabilities?
results.reference: the received replayed UE security capabilities, the received replayed UE additional security capabilities, if included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message, and the received nonceUE have not been altered compared to the latest values that the UE sent to the network
results.model_answer:
The UE shall check that the **UE security capabilities** replayed in the **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** are identical to the UE security capabilities that it sent in the corresponding initial NAS message (e.g. **ATTACH REQUEST**, **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST**, or **SERVICE REQUEST**, as applicable).

If they do not match, the UE shall send a **SECURITY MODE REJECT** with cause **“UE security capabilities mismatch”**.

results.question: When is the UE not required to perform the checking of the received nonceUE?
results.reference: if the UE does not want to re-generate the K 'ASME (i.e. the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is to derive and take into use a mapped EPS security context and the eKSI matches the current EPS security context, if it is a mapped EPS security context)
results.model_answer: The UE is not required to check the received nonceUE **if it did not include a nonceUE IE in the corresponding ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message**.

results.question: When is the Device properties IE included by the UE according to clause 8.3.8.3?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Device properties IE** **if it is configured for NAS signalling low priority**.

results.question: What must be true about the APN-AMBR values relative to the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE for the Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE to be included?
results.reference: at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.model_answer: The **Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE** shall be included **if the APN-AMBR for uplink and/or downlink exceeds the maximum value that can be encoded in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE**.

results.question: How shall an EMM message received with security header type encoded as 0000 be treated?
results.reference: as not security protected, plain NAS message
results.model_answer: “An EMM message received with the security header type IE encoded as `0000` shall be treated as a message not protected by NAS security.”

results.question: What message does the network send to initiate the transport of NAS messages?
results.reference: DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT message
results.model_answer: The network sends a **DL NAS TRANSPORT** message “to initiate the transport of NAS messages.”

results.question: To which entity does the EMM entity forward the NAS message container contents?
results.reference: the SMS entity
results.model_answer: The EMM entity forwards the NAS message container contents to the **ESM entity**.

results.question: Which clauses must be applied in order of precedence?
results.reference: Clauses 7.1 to 7.8 shall be applied in order of precedence
results.model_answer:
The procedures in **clause 5 (EPS Mobility Management (EMM))** take precedence over those in **clause 6 (EPS Session Management (ESM))**.

In other words, apply **EMM procedures before ESM procedures** where there is a conflict or concurrent handling requirement.

results.question: Which entity includes the EPS bearer context status IE to indicate active EPS bearer contexts?
results.reference: The UE
results.model_answer: The **UE** includes the **EPS bearer context status IE** (in the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message) to indicate its active EPS bearer contexts.

results.question: What is the purpose of the integrity protection algorithm for NAS signalling messages?
results.reference: to protect signalling between the UE and the MME against modification by third parties
results.model_answer: The integrity protection algorithm is used to provide **data integrity and data origin authentication** for NAS signalling messages.

results.question: Which entity sends the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: The **UE** sends the **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT** message to the **MME**.

results.question: In the case where the UE requested combined TA update for EPS and 'SMS only' and the TA UPDATE ACCEPT indicates success for EPS and non-EPS services, what can the UE do regarding CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION or Paging with CN domain indicator set to 'CS'?
results.reference: the UE can ignore the CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message or the Paging with CN domain indicator set to "CS"
results.model_answer:
The UE **shall not respond** to a **CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION** or to a **PAGING** message with the CN domain indicator set to **“CS”**.

It is registered for non-EPS only for SMS, and therefore shall not use CS-domain service notifications/paging for other CS services.

results.question: For which scenario does the UE not include the CSFB response IE?
results.reference: mobile terminating 1xCS fallback
results.model_answer: The UE shall not include the **CSFB response IE** when the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST is for **mobile originating CS fallback**.

results.question: In TS 24.301 clause 5.5.1.3.7, what applies to abnormal cases on the network side?
results.reference: The abnormal cases specified in clause 5.5.1.2.7 apply
results.model_answer: “Abnormal cases are specified in 3GPP TS 23.401 [22].”

results.question: What shall the UE do if it requested a combined TA update for EPS services and 'SMS only' and the TA UPDATE ACCEPT indicates success for EPS and non-EPS services?
results.reference: the UE shall behave as if the combined tracking area updating procedure was successful for EPS services and "SMS only"
results.model_answer: The UE **shall consider the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and “SMS only” successfully completed**.

results.question: Under what EPS optimization can the network initiate downlink transport even without PDN connections?
results.reference: control plane CIoT EPS optimization
results.model_answer:
The **Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization**.

It allows the network to transport downlink user data via NAS signalling, including when the UE has no established PDN connection.

results.question: What shall the UE do according to cell selection procedures when a cell is found?
results.reference: perform cell selection according to 3GPP S 36.304 [21] and choose an appropriate substate
results.model_answer: “When a cell is found, the UE shall select the cell and camp on it.”

results.question: What is the purpose of sending an EMM STATUS message?
results.reference: to report at any time certain error conditions detected upon receipt of EMM protocol data
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the EMM status procedure is to report certain error conditions detected by the UE or the MME.”

results.question: In the abnormal case of non-delivered NAS PDU due to handover, when is retransmission of the EMM INFORMATION message triggered after a successful intra MME handover?
results.reference: If the EMM INFORMATION message could not be delivered due to an intra MME handover and the target TA is included in the TAI list
results.model_answer: After a successful intra-MME handover, retransmission is triggered **upon receipt by the MME of the S1AP HANDOVER NOTIFY message from the target eNB**.

results.question: What is the only EMM procedure the UE can initiate when in NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state without PSM active?
results.reference: cell and PLMN reselection
results.model_answer:
The only EMM procedure the UE can initiate is the **detach procedure**.

> “The only EMM procedure the UE can initiate in this state is the detach procedure.”

results.question: What specific ESM information can the network retrieve using the ESM information request procedure?
results.reference: protocol configuration options, APN, or both
results.model_answer:
The network can retrieve from the UE:

- the **Access Point Name (APN)**; and
- the **Protocol Configuration Options (PCO)**.

TS 24.301 states: “The ESM information request procedure is used by the network to retrieve the access point name and protocol configuration options from the UE.”

results.question: When shall the Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE be included in the message?
results.reference: only if the network wishes to transmit the APN-AMBR values to the UE for possible uplink policy enforcement and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.model_answer: The Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE shall be included **when the APN aggregate maximum bit rate exceeds the maximum value that can be encoded in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE** (i.e. exceeds 256 Mbps for uplink and/or downlink).

results.question: When is the Packet flow identifier IE mandatory for a network to include?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE
results.model_answer: The network shall include the Packet flow identifier IE **when the EPS bearer context is associated with a packet flow aggregate**—i.e. in an **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** (and in a **MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** when the packet-flow association is being modified).

results.question: What is the purpose of the EPS bearer context modification procedure?
results.reference: to modify an EPS bearer context or packet flow description(s) of an existing EPS bearer context
results.model_answer: “The EPS bearer context modification procedure is used to modify EPS bearer context(s). The procedure can be initiated by the network or by the UE.”

results.question: According to which specification shall the UE perform cell selection/reselection in the NO-CELL-AVAILABLE case?
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform cell selection/reselection in accordance with **3GPP TS 36.304**.

results.question: When shall a UE initiate tracking area updating after an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode?
results.reference: when the UE performs an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode and has no user data pending
results.model_answer: “Upon inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode, the UE shall initiate the tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: In TS 24.301 clause 8.2.28.3, what does the Extended EMM cause IE indicate?
results.reference: additional information associated with the EMM cause
results.model_answer: The **Extended EMM cause IE** is used to provide **additional information related to the EMM cause indicated in the EMM cause IE**.

results.question: What capability must the UE have to potentially include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: it supports WUS assistance
results.model_answer: The UE must support the **WUS (Wake-Up Signal) feature** (i.e. have WUS capability) to potentially include the **Requested WUS assistance information** IE.

results.question: What shall not happen as seen from the radio interface upon receipt of an EMM STATUS message?
results.reference: no state transition and no specific action shall be taken
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of an EMM STATUS message, **the receiving entity shall not change its EMM state**.

results.question: Under what condition may the UE include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: if it supports WUS assistance and it is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: The UE may include the **Requested WUS assistance information IE** **if it supports WUS assistance**.

results.question: What technical specification governs the cell selection/reselection procedure referenced in clause 5.2.3.2.6?
results.model_answer: The cell selection/reselection procedure is specified in **3GPP TS 36.304** (“E-UTRA; User Equipment (UE) procedures in idle mode”).

results.question: Which network entity initiates the EPS bearer context modification procedure?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The **MME** initiates the EPS bearer context modification procedure, by sending a **MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** message to the UE.

results.question: What type of attach does a UE set in the ATTACH REQUEST message to request access to Restricted Local Operator Services?
results.reference: EPS RLOS attach
results.model_answer: The UE sets the Attach type to **“EPS attach for RLOS”** (Restricted Local Operator Services) in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

results.question: What is the purpose of the ESM information request procedure?
results.reference: to provide privacy for the ESM information if ciphering is enabled in the network
results.model_answer: The purpose of the ESM information request procedure is to allow the network to request ESM information from the UE, in particular to retrieve the APN and protocol configuration options (PCO) when they were not included in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.

results.question: What determines the coding of the additional information value?
results.reference: the generic message container type
results.model_answer: “The coding of the additional information value is determined by the EMM cause value.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the EPS bearer context status IE?
results.reference: if it wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active within the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **EPS bearer context status IE** in the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message **if it has any EPS bearer contexts that are in the ACTIVE state**.

results.question: What must be included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message by the MME to trigger the condition for the replayed NAS message container?
results.reference: the MME included HASHMME in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The MME must include the **Replayed NAS message container IE** in the **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** message (containing the NAS message to be replayed).

results.question: What does the network indicate by including the EPS bearer context status IE?
results.reference: the EPS bearer contexts that are active for the UE in the network
results.model_answer: By including the **EPS bearer context status IE**, the network indicates **the EPS bearer contexts that are active in the network**.

results.question: What is the UE's behavior when E-UTRAN coverage is lost?
results.reference: the UE shall not initiate any EMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection
results.model_answer:
Upon loss of E-UTRAN coverage, the UE enters the **EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE** sub-state (if it was EMM registered) and performs PLMN/cell selection in accordance with TS 23.122.

It does not detach merely because coverage is lost; when coverage is regained, it performs a tracking area update if required (e.g. it is in a non-registered TA or T3412 has expired).

results.question: Which specific NAS message type is explicitly stated as not being a plain NAS message and therefore not included?
results.reference: SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE
results.model_answer:
The **SERVICE REQUEST** message.

> “The SERVICE REQUEST message is not a plain NAS message and is therefore not included.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the Additional information information element?
results.reference: to provide additional information to upper layers in relation to the generic NAS message transport mechanism
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Additional information information element is to provide additional information regarding the EMM cause.”

results.question: Who always initiates and controls the EPS AKA procedure?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The network always initiates and controls the EPS AKA procedure.

results.question: During which procedures does the condition for including the replayed NAS message container apply?
results.reference: during an ongoing attach or tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer:
The condition for including the **Replayed NAS message container** applies during:

- the **attach procedure**;
- the **tracking area updating procedure**; and
- the **service request procedure**.

results.question: Besides the SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE, which other message is not a plain NAS message and shall not be included?
results.reference: SERVICE REQUEST message
results.model_answer:
Besides the **SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE**, the **SERVICE REQUEST message** shall not be included.

> “The NAS message container shall not contain a SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE or a SERVICE REQUEST message.”

results.question: What is computed by the USIM during a successful EPS authentication procedure?
results.reference: the CK and IK
results.model_answer:
During a successful EPS authentication procedure, the USIM computes:

> “the response RES and the ciphering key CK and integrity key IK.”

The ME then uses CK and IK, together with other authentication parameters, to derive \(K_{\text{ASME}}\).

results.question: Under what condition can the UE deactivate PSM?
results.reference: when the UE needs to send mobile originated signalling or user data
results.model_answer: The UE can request deactivation of PSM by sending an **ATTACH REQUEST** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** containing the **extended periodic TAU timer IE** with its timer value set to **“deactivated” (0)**.

results.question: For what purpose can the UE use the PLMN identity of the visited cdma2000 HRPD network as the PLMN identity of the target cell?
results.reference: For the purpose of S101 mode to S1 mode handover
results.model_answer: The UE can use it **for the purpose of PLMN selection**.

results.question: Under what conditions shall a network include the Packet flow identifier IE?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Packet flow identifier IE** **if the network assigns a packet flow identifier for the EPS bearer context**.

results.question: What must a UE attached for access to RLOS do if it needs to initiate an emergency call?
results.reference: perform a local detach prior to initiating an attach procedure for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: A UE attached for access to RLOS **shall initiate an EPS attach procedure for emergency bearer services** if it needs to initiate an emergency call.

results.question: What does security protection of EPS NAS messages involve?
results.reference: integrity protection and ciphering of the EMM and ESM NAS messages
results.model_answer: Security protection of EPS NAS messages involves **integrity protection and ciphering of NAS messages**.

results.question: When is the UE not allowed to include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: it is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: The UE is not allowed to include the **Requested WUS assistance information** IE when it is requesting an **emergency attach**.

results.question: What procedure shall the UE perform according to 3GPP TS 36.304 when in NO-IMSI state?
results.reference: cell selection
results.model_answer:
In the **EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI** state:

> “The UE shall perform the PLMN selection procedure according to 3GPP TS 36.304.”

results.question: How is operation of a network without ciphering achieved?
results.reference: by configuring the MME so that it always selects the "null ciphering algorithm", EEA0
results.model_answer: Operation of a network without ciphering is achieved by selecting **EEA0 (null ciphering algorithm)** as the NAS ciphering algorithm.

results.question: When bits 7 and 8 are set to '11', which bits can be used for future extensions of the SERVICE REQUEST message?
results.reference: bits 5 and 6
results.model_answer: “When bits 7 and 8 are set to ‘11’, bits 5 and 6 can be used for future extensions of the SERVICE REQUEST message.”

results.question: What shall the UE initiate on the expiry of timer T3411?
results.reference: shall initiate a tracking area updating on the expiry of timer T3411
results.model_answer: On expiry of timer **T3411**, the UE shall **initiate a new attach procedure**.

results.question: What is the exception case where the UE does not include the CSFB response IE despite the service type indication?
results.reference: mobile terminating 1xCS fallback
results.model_answer:
The exception is the **limited service / emergency call case**.  

When the UE is in **limited service state** and initiates CS fallback for an emergency call, it does **not** include the **CSFB response IE**, even though the Service type indicates **“mobile originating CS fallback.”**

results.question: For what entities is the offload permission determined according to clause 6.3.7?
results.reference: for the UE and the PDN connection
results.model_answer: The offload permission is determined **for each PDN connection and for each IP flow associated with that PDN connection**.

results.question: What type of inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode is specified for the inclusion of the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE?
results.reference: to S1 mode
results.model_answer: The IE is included for an **inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode**.

results.question: What is the purpose of transmitting the APN-AMBR to the UE?
results.reference: for possible uplink policy enforcement
results.model_answer:
The APN-AMBR is transmitted to the UE to indicate the **maximum aggregate bit rate allowed for all non-GBR EPS bearers associated with that APN**, separately for uplink and downlink.

It does not apply to GBR bearers.

results.question: In which message during the attach procedure shall the UE include the ESM information transfer flag IE?
results.reference: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **ESM information transfer flag IE in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message** (which, during attach, is carried in the **ESM message container of the ATTACH REQUEST**).

results.question: What is one reason, besides protocol configuration options, for the UE to include the ESM information transfer flag IE?
results.reference: wishes to provide an access point name for the PDN connection to be established during the attach procedure
results.model_answer: Besides protocol configuration options, the UE includes the ESM information transfer flag IE when it needs to transfer an **Access Point Name (APN)** to the network after NAS security has been activated.

results.question: At which reference point are the EMM procedures for EPS services used?
results.reference: radio interface (reference point "LTE-Uu")
results.model_answer: The EMM procedures for EPS services are used **at the reference point between the UE and the MME**.

results.question: Under what condition is the APN-AMBR IE included in a message?
results.reference: when the network wishes to transmit the APN-AMBR to the UE for possible uplink policy enforcement
results.model_answer:
The APN-AMBR IE is included **when the APN-AMBR has been modified/changed**.

> “The APN-AMBR IE shall be included if the APN-AMBR has been modified.”

results.question: According to the clause, what condition exists regarding the procedure transaction?
results.reference: No procedure transaction exists
results.model_answer: Please provide the clause or its text/reference. TS 24.301 contains many statements concerning “procedure transaction,” so the applicable condition cannot be identified from the question alone.

results.question: What type of pending messages must a UE have to include the NAS message container IE?
results.reference: pending SMS messages to be sent
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the NAS message container IE **if it has a pending uplink SMS message** (i.e. an SMS message to be sent using NAS transport).

results.question: What is the title of the clause that describes when no procedure transaction exists?
results.reference: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: No procedure transaction exists

results.question: When timer T3447 is running, when can the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message be sent if still necessary?
results.reference: when timer T3447 expires
results.model_answer: Upon expiry of timer **T3447**, the UE can send the **PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST** message, if it is still necessary.

results.question: What is the full name of the technology associated with the NBIFOM container?
results.reference: network-based IP flow mobility
results.model_answer: Network-Based IP Flow Mobility (NBIFOM).

results.question: To which entities does the mobility management sublayer provide connection management services?
results.reference: the session management (SM) sublayer and the short message services (SMS) entity of the connection management (CM) sublayer
results.model_answer:
The mobility management (EMM) sublayer provides connection management services to:

- the EPS session management (ESM) sublayer;
- the SMS entity; and
- the location services (LCS) entity.

results.question: What mode must a UE be in for access to RLOS to be applicable?
results.reference: WB-S1 mode only
results.model_answer: Access to RLOS is applicable only when the UE is in **limited service mode**.

results.question: What is the main function of the ESM sublayer?
results.reference: to support the EPS bearer context handling in the UE and in the MME
results.model_answer: “The main function of the ESM sublayer is to provide procedures for the handling of EPS bearer contexts.”

results.question: What shall the UE do on the fifth expiry of timer T3482 for a non-emergency PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST?
results.reference: abort the procedure, release the PTI allocated for this invocation and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer:
On the fifth expiry of T3482 for a non-emergency PDN connectivity request, the UE shall:

> “abort the PDN connectivity procedure and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.”

It shall also indicate the PDN connectivity procedure failure to upper layers.

results.question: When is the back-off timer stopped according to Note 4?
results.reference: This back-off timer is stopped when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed
results.model_answer: The back-off timer is stopped when the UE receives an **ATTACH ACCEPT**, **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT**, or **SERVICE ACCEPT** message.

results.question: What two network conditions must be satisfied for including the T3324 value IE?
results.reference: the network supports PSM and accepts the use of PSM
results.model_answer:
The network includes the **T3324 value IE** when:

1. the network **supports power saving mode (PSM)**; and  
2. the network **accepts the UE’s request to use PSM**.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE during an inter-system change?
results.reference: if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-IDLE mode and the TIN indicates "P-TMSI"
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE** in the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message **when performing an inter-system change from GERAN or UTRAN to E-UTRAN**.

results.question: During which UE activity is the EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH substate selected?
results.reference: searching for PLMNs
results.model_answer: The UE selects the **EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH** substate **when it is performing a PLMN search**.

results.question: Which 3GPP specification is referenced for network-based IP flow mobility?
results.model_answer: Network-based IP flow mobility is specified in **3GPP TS 23.261** (“IP flow mobility and seamless WLAN offload”).

results.question: What are the two alternative UE capability conditions that mandate the inclusion of the Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting IE in WB-S1 mode?
results.reference: the UE supports CS fallback and SMS over SGs; or if the UE is configured to support IMS voice, but does not support 1xCS fallback
results.model_answer:
The IE shall be included in WB-S1 mode if the UE supports either:

- **CS voice over PS session in S1 mode**; or  
- **IMS voice over PS session in S1 mode**.

results.question: What is the full name of the substate described as being chosen while the UE searches for PLMNs?
results.reference: EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
results.model_answer: **EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH**

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the replayed NAS message container?
results.reference: if during an ongoing attach or tracking area updating procedure, the MME included HASHMME in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and HASHMME has a different value from the hash value locally calculated at the UE as described in 3GPP S 33.401 [19]
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **replayed NAS message container** in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message **if it has received a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message containing a replayed NAS message container**.

results.question: What EMM cause value is set in the ATTACH REJECT message when it is combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message?
results.reference: #19 "ESM failure"
results.model_answer:
The EMM cause shall be set to:

**#19 – “ESM failure”**

> “If the ATTACH REJECT message is combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message, the EMM cause shall be set to #19 ‘ESM failure’.”

results.question: What is described in clause 4.4.1 regarding EPS security contexts?
results.reference: the principles for the handling of EPS security contexts in the UE and in the MME and the procedures used for the security protection of EPS NAS messages between UE and MME
results.model_answer:
Clause 4.4.1 describes the EPS security context maintained between the UE and the MME for NAS security. It includes the EPS keying material and identifiers used to derive/use NAS integrity and ciphering protection (including \(K_{ASME}\), the EPS key-set identifier/eKSI, and the NAS integrity and ciphering keys).

It also distinguishes:

- a **native EPS security context**, established by EPS AKA; and  
- a **mapped EPS security context**, derived from a UMTS security context during inter-RAT mobility.

The EPS security context is used to provide NAS signalling integrity protection and, where applicable, ciphering.

results.question: What type of access to RLOS requests are supported for a UE attached for access to RLOS?
results.reference: UE originated access to RLOS requests
results.model_answer: For a UE attached for access to RLOS, **only UE-initiated PDN connectivity requests for RLOS are supported**. Normal EPS-service PDN connectivity requests are not supported while attached for RLOS.

results.question: Under what condition can all EMM procedures described in this clause be performed?
results.reference: if a NAS signalling connection has been established between the UE and the network
results.model_answer: All EMM procedures described in this clause can be performed when the UE is in the **EMM-REGISTERED** state.

results.question: Under what condition does a UE move to EMM-DEREGISTERED and GMM-DEREGISTERED during an intersystem change from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode with no active PDP context?
results.reference: if EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME
results.model_answer: “If the UE has no active PDP contexts, the UE shall enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED state and the GMM-DEREGISTERED state.”

results.question: What type of NAS message is included in the IE described in clause 9.7?
results.reference: a complete plain NAS message
results.model_answer: “The ESM message container IE is used to encapsulate an ESM message.”

results.question: In which UE state is the substate EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH chosen?
results.reference: while the UE is searching for PLMNs
results.model_answer: The substate **EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH** is chosen in the **EMM-REGISTERED** UE state.

results.question: When does a UE maintain registration and related periodic update timers in both GMM and EMM?
results.reference: if the network has indicated that ISR is activated
results.model_answer: A UE maintains registration and the related periodic update timers in both GMM and EMM **when it is attached/registered for both EPS services and non-EPS (GPRS) services**—e.g. following a successful combined EPS/IMSI attach or combined TA/RA update that establishes both registrations.

results.question: When must the network include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE according to clause 8.2.26.27?
results.reference: the UE supports WUS assistance, the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance; and the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Negotiated WUS assistance information IE** if the UE included the **WUS assistance information IE** in the corresponding **ATTACH REQUEST** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message and the network supports WUS assistance information.

results.question: When a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 changes configuration to prefer SMS over IP networks, is able to use SMS via IMS, and has no CS voice capability, what two actions must it take?
results.reference: transit from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 or from CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2; and detach for non-EPS services
results.model_answer:
It shall:

1. **Initiate a tracking area updating procedure**; and  
2. **Include the “SMS over IP networks supported” indication in the UE network capability IE**.

This applies when the UE is configured for CS/PS mode 1 or 2, is capable of SMS over IP networks, has no CS voice capability, and changes its configuration to prefer SMS over IP networks.

results.question: What is the EMM cause value when the attach request is rejected due to no suitable cells in tracking area and PDN connectivity reject is due to ESM cause #29?
results.reference: #15 "No suitable cells in tracking area"
results.model_answer:
The EMM cause is **#15 — “No suitable cells in tracking area.”**

The PDN Connectivity Reject may carry ESM cause **#29 — “User authentication or authorization failed”**, but this does not change the EMM cause for the Attach Reject.

results.question: When shall the UE include the NAS message container IE?
results.reference: if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and has pending SMS messages to be sent
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **NAS message container IE** when it sends an **UL NAS TRANSPORT** message. The IE is mandatory in that message and carries the NAS message to be transported (e.g. an SMS NAS message).

results.question: Under what condition regarding emergency services must the network include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Negotiated WUS assistance information IE** only if the UE is **not attached for emergency bearer services** (i.e. the attach is not an emergency attach).

results.question: What procedures must a UE in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 execute if it changes to prefer SMS over IP networks, can use SMS via IMS, and has voice domain preference for E-UTRAN set to "IMS PS voice only"?
results.reference: transit from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 or from CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2; and detach for non-EPS services
results.model_answer: The UE shall **initiate a combined tracking area updating procedure**, with the **update type set to “combined TA/LA updating”**, and indicate its preference for **SMS over IP networks** in the UE network capability.

results.question: What timer does the MME start when initiating the NAS security mode control procedure?
results.reference: timer T3460
results.model_answer: The MME starts **timer T3460** when initiating the NAS security mode control procedure.

results.question: What type of bearer context activation has the network initiated?
results.reference: EPS bearer context activation
results.model_answer: The network has initiated **activation of a dedicated EPS bearer context** (network-initiated dedicated bearer activation).

results.question: When is the ESM cause IE included in the message?
results.reference: when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource
results.model_answer:
The **ESM cause IE** is included to indicate the reason for an ESM procedure failure or other ESM-related condition.

It is mandatory in ESM reject/status-related messages, including:

- ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT  
- ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT  
- MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT  
- DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST  
- PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT  
- PDN DISCONNECT REJECT  
- BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT  
- BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT  
- ESM STATUS message.

results.question: In which clause is the condition for including the ESM cause IE specified?
results.reference: when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource
results.model_answer: The condition for including the ESM cause IE is specified in **clause 6.4.1 (General)** of 3GPP TS 24.301.

results.question: What security header type does the MME set in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message?
results.reference: integrity protected with new EPS security context
results.model_answer:
The MME shall set the security header type in the **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** message to:

> **“integrity protected with new EPS security context”**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the ESM message container information element?
results.reference: to enable piggybacked transfer of a single ESM message within an EMM message
results.model_answer: “The ESM message container information element is used to encapsulate an ESM message for transfer as part of an EMM message.”

results.question: Where is the content for the Supported codec list information element specified in TS 24.301?
results.reference: See clause 10.5.4.32 in 3GPP S 24.008 [13]
results.model_answer:
The content of the **Supported codec list** information element is specified in **3GPP TS 24.008, subclause 10.5.4.32**.

> “The Supported codec list information element is specified in 3GPP TS 24.008 [13] subclause 10.5.4.32.”

results.question: What is the title of clause 9.9.2.10 in TS 24.301?
results.reference: Supported codec list
results.model_answer: Clause 9.9.2.10 is titled **“EPS mobile identity”**.

results.question: Which substate indicates the UE is attached but out of coverage?
results.reference: NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
results.model_answer: **EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE** indicates that the UE is attached (registered) but no suitable cell is available, i.e. it is out of coverage.

results.question: Which entity has initiated the EPS bearer context activation?
results.reference: The network
results.model_answer: The EPS bearer context activation is **network-initiated**. The **MME** initiates it by sending an **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** or **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** message to the UE.

results.question: How many times is the retransmission repeated upon expiry of timer T3493?
results.reference: two times
results.model_answer: “The retransmission shall be repeated four times.”

results.question: Which external specification and clause define the Supported codec list content according to TS 24.301?
results.model_answer:
The Supported codec list content is defined in **3GPP TS 24.008, clause 10.5.4.32**.

> “The contents of the Supported codec list information element are defined in 3GPP TS 24.008 [13], clause 10.5.4.32.”

results.question: What must the TIN be set to for the NonceUE IE to be included?
results.reference: "P-TMSI"
results.model_answer:
The TIN must be set to **“GUTI”**.

> “The NonceUE IE shall be included if the TIN is set to ‘GUTI’.”

results.question: How shall the ESM message included in the ESM message container IE be coded?
results.reference: as specified in clause 8.3, i.e. without NAS security header
results.model_answer: “The ESM message included in the ESM message container IE shall be coded as specified in clause 9.3.”

results.question: During what type of inter-system change is the NonceUE IE included?
results.reference: an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in idle mode
results.model_answer: The **NonceUE IE** is included when the UE performs an inter-system change **from GERAN or UTRAN to E-UTRAN** (i.e. a return to LTE/EPS), where a mapped EPS security context is used.

results.question: According to the clause, what may the network support?
results.reference: the Ethernet PDN type
results.model_answer: Please provide the specific clause or extract from TS 24.301. The question does not identify which clause’s statement “the network may support” refers to.

results.question: When does the UE include the Paging restriction IE according to clause 8.2.29.36?
results.reference: if the Request type is set to "NAS signalling connection release" in the UE request type IE and the UE requests the network to restrict paging
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Paging restriction** IE in the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message **when it requests the network to apply paging restriction**.

results.question: What procedures shall a UE execute when its configuration on use of SMS changes while operating in PS mode 1 or PS mode 2?
results.reference: Transit from PS mode 1 to CS/PS mode 1 or from PS mode 2 to CS/PS mode 2. Combined tracking area update with IMSI attach, (with or without "SMS only")
results.model_answer:
- **On changing from PS mode 1 to PS mode 2**, the UE shall perform the **combined tracking area updating procedure**.  
- **On changing from PS mode 2 to PS mode 1**, the UE shall perform the **tracking area updating procedure**.

results.question: What does the MME store within the default EPS bearer context if the NAS signalling low priority indication is provided in a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message?
results.reference: the NAS signalling low priority indication
results.model_answer: The MME stores the **NAS signalling low priority indication** within the EPS bearer context for the default EPS bearer.

results.question: What does TS 24.301 Clause 9.9.3.24 direct the reader to see for Network name information?
results.reference: See clause 10.5.3.5a in 3GPP S 24.008 [13]
results.model_answer: “See 3GPP TS 24.008 [13], subclause 10.5.3.5a for Network name information.”

results.question: How is the support of CE mode B by a UE indicated to the MME?
results.reference: by lower layers
results.model_answer: The UE indicates CE mode B support to the MME in the **UE network capability** information element, by setting the **“CE mode B support”** bit to **“1”** (supported), e.g. in the **ATTACH REQUEST** (and when applicable, update procedures carrying UE network capability).

results.question: After aborting the Remote UE Report procedure, what is left to UE implementation?
results.reference: how to restart the procedure
results.model_answer: After aborting the Remote UE Report procedure, **whether to re-initiate the Remote UE Report procedure is left to UE implementation**.

results.question: When shall an MME that supports WB-S1 mode calculate the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode for a UE not using satellite E-UTRAN access?
results.reference: the MME determines that a) the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE; or b) CE mode B is not restricted for the UE (see 3GPP S 23.401 [10])
results.model_answer: An MME supporting WB-S1 mode shall calculate the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode **upon receipt of an ATTACH REQUEST message from a UE that is not using satellite E-UTRAN access**.

results.question: What type of information element is the ESM message container?
results.reference: a type 6 information element
results.model_answer: “The ESM message container is a type 6 information element.”

results.question: What type of information element is the Re-attempt indicator?
results.reference: a type 4 information element
results.model_answer: The Re-attempt indicator is a **type 1 information element**.

results.question: Under what condition shall the Device properties IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: The Device properties IE **shall be included if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority**.

results.question: What shall the UE perform at the expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 if configured for eCall only mode?
results.reference: shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 (see clause 5.5.4)
results.model_answer: At expiry of timer T3444 or T3445, a UE configured for eCall only mode **shall initiate an attach procedure for emergency services** (i.e. an EPS emergency attach).

results.question: What shall the network include when the EPS QoS of the EPS bearer context is modified?
results.reference: the modified EPS QoS assigned to the EPS bearer context
results.model_answer: When the EPS QoS of the EPS bearer context is modified, **the network shall include the EPS QoS IE in the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message**.

results.question: In what UE mode must the inter-system change occur for the NonceUE IE to be included?
results.reference: idle mode
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **NonceUE IE** when it performs an inter-system change **from 5GS to EPS in EMM-IDLE mode**.

results.question: What does the sender use as input to the ciphering algorithm?
results.reference: its locally stored NAS COUNT
results.model_answer: “The sender shall use the 32-bit NAS COUNT as input to the ciphering algorithm.”

results.question: When is the Device properties information element included according to clause 8.2.4.14?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: “The UE shall include the Device properties information element in the ATTACH REQUEST message and the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority.”

results.question: How many Extended Local Emergency Numbers lists can be present in the UE?
results.reference: only one Extended Local Emergency Numbers list
results.model_answer: “The UE shall be able to store a maximum of 10 extended local emergency number lists.”

results.question: When shall a UE that supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode not using satellite E-UTRAN access NOT apply the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode?
results.reference: before receiving an indication from the network that the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted as described in this clause
results.model_answer: A UE shall not apply the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode **when it is operating in CE mode A or in normal coverage** (i.e. when it is not operating in CE mode B).

results.question: In TS 24.301 Clause 9.9.3.24, which specific clause of 3GPP S 24.008 is cited?
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 24.008, clause **10.5.5.12** (“MS network feature support”).

results.question: For what purpose may the network use the NAS signalling low priority indication?
results.reference: for NAS level mobility management congestion control and APN based congestion control
results.model_answer: The network may use the NAS signalling low priority indication **to apply a lower priority treatment to NAS signalling from the UE**, for example when handling congestion or overload.

results.question: What does the receiver use to form the NAS COUNT input to the deciphering algorithm?
results.reference: the NAS sequence number included in the received message (or estimated from the 5 bits of the NAS sequence number received in the message) and an estimate for the NAS overflow counter as defined in clause 4.4.3.1
results.model_answer: The receiver uses the **24-bit NAS COUNT overflow counter** together with the **8-bit sequence number received in the security protected NAS message** to form the 32-bit NAS COUNT input to the deciphering algorithm.

results.question: Under what conditions shall a UE that supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode not using satellite E-UTRAN access apply the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode?
results.reference: the UE 's usage setting is not set to "voice centric" (see 3GPP S 23.401 [10]), and a) the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE; or b) CE mode B is not restricted for the UE (see 3GPP S 23.401 [10])
results.model_answer:
A UE shall apply the NAS timer values specified for **WB-S1/CE mode** when it is using **terrestrial (non-satellite) E-UTRAN access** and is operating either:

- in **WB-S1 mode**, or  
- in **CE mode B**.

The WB-S1/CE-mode timer values do not apply when the UE is using **satellite E-UTRAN access**; the satellite-access-specific timer treatment applies instead.

results.question: What shall the UE not send when the maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts is reached and upper layers request connectivity to a PDN?
results.reference: a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: “The UE shall not send a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message if the maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts is reached.”

results.question: What is the length of the Re-attempt indicator information element?
results.reference: 3 octets
results.model_answer: “The length of the Re-attempt indicator information element is 1 octet.”

results.question: What action shall the MME take if a NAS message is received without integrity protection after secure exchange has been established?
results.reference: the NAS shall discard this message
results.model_answer: The MME **shall discard the NAS message** if it is received without integrity protection after NAS security has been established.

results.question: What are the two conditions that must both be true for the network to potentially include the Header compression configuration IE?
results.reference: the network accepts an IP PDN type; and control plane CIoT EPS optimization is selected
results.model_answer:
The network may include the **Header compression configuration IE** only if both:

- the **UE has indicated support for header compression**; and  
- the **network supports header compression**.

results.question: Which 3GPP specification clause is referenced for Mobile identity details in TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3?
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 24.008, clause **10.5.1.4** (“Mobile identity”).

results.question: What shall the MME do with a received NAS signalling message that fails integrity check after secure exchange is established?
results.reference: the NAS in the MME shall discard that message
results.model_answer: The MME **shall discard the received NAS signalling message** if it fails the integrity check after NAS security has been established.

results.question: In which 3GPP specification is the Mobile identity information located as referenced by TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3?
results.model_answer:
The Mobile identity information element is located in **3GPP TS 24.008**.

TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3 states:

> “The Mobile identity information element is defined in 3GPP TS 24.008 [13].”

results.question: Under what condition is the header compression configuration IE included in the message?
results.reference: if the network wishes to re-negotiate header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context and both the UE and the network support Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression
results.model_answer: The header compression configuration IE is included **if header compression has been negotiated for the EPS bearer context**.

results.question: What are the input parameters to the NAS ciphering algorithm?
results.reference: the constant BEARER ID, DIRECTION bit, NAS COUNT, NAS encryption key and the length of the key stream to be generated by the encryption algorithm
results.model_answer:
“The input parameters to the NAS ciphering algorithm are the ciphering key, the NAS COUNT, the bearer identity, the direction of transmission, the length of the message to be ciphered, and the message itself.”

That is: **KEY, COUNT, BEARER, DIRECTION, LENGTH, and MESSAGE**.

results.question: What technical document is cited for the Mobile identity content in TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3?
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 24.008, subclause 10.5.1.4 (“Mobile identity”).

results.question: What is the purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element?
results.reference: to indicate a condition under which the UE is allowed, in the current PLMN for the same APN, to re-attempt a session management procedure (see 3GPP S 24.008 [13]) corresponding to the EPS session management procedure which was rejected by the network
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element is to indicate to the UE that it shall re-attempt an attach or tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: What action does the UE take on the first expiry of timer T3493?
results.reference: the UE shall resend the REMOTE UE REPORT message and shall reset and restart timer T3493
results.model_answer: On the first expiry of timer T3493, **the UE retransmits the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message and restarts timer T3493**.

results.question: Under what condition is TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST sent without integrity protection?
results.reference: if the tracking area updating procedure is initiated due to an inter-system change in idle mode and no current EPS security context is available in the UE
results.model_answer: A **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** is sent **without integrity protection when the UE has no valid EPS security context**.

results.question: Where are the coding details for the ESM message container information element shown?
results.reference: figure 9.9.3.15.1 and table 9.9.3.15.1
results.model_answer: The coding details are shown in **3GPP TS 24.301, clause 9.9.3.15, Figure 9.9.3.15.1 (“ESM message container information element”)**.

results.question: Under what condition shall the MME retransmit the IDENTITY REQUEST message after an intra MME handover?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover the MME shall retransmit the IDENTITY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: After an intra-MME handover, the MME shall retransmit the **IDENTITY REQUEST** message **upon receipt of the HANDOVER NOTIFY message, if it has not already received an IDENTITY RESPONSE message**.

results.question: What is the UE's required action when a paging indication is received during an ongoing service request procedure?
results.reference: ignore the paging indication from the network
results.model_answer: “If the UE receives a paging indication while the service request procedure is ongoing, the UE shall ignore the paging indication.”

results.question: When shall the UE include the UE additional security capability IE?
results.reference: if the UE supports dual connectivity with NR or if the UE supports N1 mode
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **UE additional security capability IE** if it supports any EPS encryption algorithm or EPS integrity protection algorithm with an algorithm identifier in the range **4 to 7**.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the UE radio capability ID information element?
results.reference: if the UE radio capability ID was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **UE radio capability ID** information element **if it has been assigned a UE radio capability ID by the MME**.

results.question: What is the direction of the PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message?
results.reference: network to UE
results.model_answer: The **PDN DISCONNECT REJECT** message is sent **from the network (MME) to the UE**.

results.question: How many times shall the network retransmit the IDENTITY REQUEST message upon expiry of timer T3470 before aborting the procedure?
results.reference: This retransmission is repeated four times
results.model_answer:
The network shall retransmit the **IDENTITY REQUEST** message upon expiry of T3470 and shall abort the identification procedure **after the fifth expiry of timer T3470**.

Therefore, the retransmission limit is **five expiries of T3470**.

results.question: Where must the emergency numbers in the list be valid?
results.reference: valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received
results.model_answer: “The emergency numbers shall be valid in the country where the UE is currently located.”

results.question: For what purpose is the PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message sent by the network?
results.reference: to reject release of a PDN connection
results.model_answer: “The PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message is sent by the network to the UE to reject a PDN disconnection request.”

results.question: If No E-UTRA Disabling In 5GS is enabled and the UE selects NG-RAN, what must it do regarding the E-UTRA capability?
results.reference: it shall not disable the E-UTRA capability
results.model_answer: If **No E-UTRA Disabling In 5GS** is enabled and the UE selects NG-RAN, the UE **shall not disable its E-UTRA capability**.

results.question: In which mode shall the UE include the UE radio capability ID information element?
results.reference: WB-S1 mode
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **UE radio capability ID** information element **when the UE is in NB-IoT mode**.

results.question: What information element is included by the UE in WB-S1 mode when requested in SECURITY MODE COMMAND?
results.reference: UE radio capability ID
results.model_answer: The UE includes the **IMEISV information element** in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message when it is requested in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND.

results.question: What type of information element is HashMME and what is its length?
results.reference: The HashMME is a type 4 information element with a length of 10 octets
results.model_answer: “Hash MME is a type 4 information element with a length of 8 octets.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the UE additional security capability IE?
results.reference: if the UE supports dual connectivity with NR or if the UE supports N1 mode
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **UE additional security capability IE** in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message **if it supports any EPS encryption or EPS integrity algorithm with an algorithm identifier higher than 7**.

results.question: Which IE may the network include when both IP PDN type is accepted and a specific optimization is selected?
results.reference: Header compression configuration IE
results.model_answer: The network may include the **Header compression configuration IE**.

results.question: What happens to the associated PDN connection for USS communication if UUAA-SM fails during a re-authentication or re-authorization procedure?
results.reference: the associated PDN connection for USS communication is released
results.model_answer: If the UUAA-SM procedure fails during re-authentication or re-authorization, **the UE shall deactivate the PDN connection associated with the USS communication**.

results.question: In WB-S1 mode, what message does the MME send to initiate the dedicated bearer context activation procedure?
results.reference: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
results.model_answer: The MME initiates the dedicated bearer context activation procedure by sending an **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** message.

results.question: Which NAS messages can be processed by the MME without integrity protection before secure exchange is established?
results.reference: IDENTITY RESPONSE (if requested identification parameter is IMSI), SECURITY MODE REJECT, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
results.model_answer:
Before a NAS security context/secure exchange is established, the MME can process these EMM messages without integrity protection:

- **ATTACH REQUEST**
- **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST**
- **DETACH REQUEST**
- **SERVICE REQUEST**
- **EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST**
- **CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST**
- **IDENTITY RESPONSE**
- **AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE**
- **AUTHENTICATION FAILURE**
- **SECURITY MODE REJECT**
- **EMM STATUS**

results.question: What timer does the MME start when initiating the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure?
results.model_answer:
The MME starts **timer T3485**.

> “The MME shall start timer T3485.”

results.question: What identity value must the MME include in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message as the linked EPS bearer identity?
results.reference: the EPS bearer identity of the associated default bearer
results.model_answer: The MME shall include **the EPS bearer identity of the default EPS bearer associated with the PDN connection** in the Linked EPS Bearer Identity IE.

results.question: What is the message type for the message sent by the network to reject release of a PDN connection?
results.reference: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT
results.model_answer: **PDN DISCONNECT REJECT** — message type **0xD3** (decimal **211**).

results.question: When the tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5, what timer does the UE start?
results.reference: the UE shall start timer T3411
results.model_answer: The UE starts **timer T3411**.

results.question: What state does the MME enter after sending the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?
results.reference: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING
results.model_answer: Upon sending the **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** message, the MME shall start timer **T3485** and enter the **ESM-PROCEDURE-PENDING** state.

results.question: Which entity may include the IE to request eDRX use?
results.reference: The UE
results.model_answer: “The UE may include the eDRX parameters IE to request the use of eDRX.”

results.question: What are the two states in which the detailed behaviour of the UE is described in this clause?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED and EMM-REGISTERED
results.model_answer: “The detailed behaviour of the UE in the **EMM-DEREGISTERED** and **EMM-REGISTERED** states is described in this clause.”

results.question: What is described in this clause regarding the UE?
results.reference: the detailed behaviour of the UE in the states EMM-DEREGISTERED and EMM-REGISTERED
