results.model_answer: Please provide the clause number or the clause text/extract. Without it, I cannot determine what is described regarding the UE.

results.question: Which bit rate values does the UE wish to transmit to the network for the Extended EPS QoS IE to be considered?
results.reference: the maximum and guaranteed bit rate values
results.model_answer:
The UE includes the Extended EPS QoS IE when it wishes to indicate:

> “a maximum bit rate or guaranteed bit rate value exceeding 256 Mbps.”

This applies to the uplink and/or downlink maximum bit rate and guaranteed bit rate values.

results.question: What triggers when timer T3402 expires after the tracking area updating attempt counter reaches 5?
results.reference: the normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" or the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" is triggered
results.model_answer: When timer T3402 expires, the UE **shall reset the tracking area updating attempt counter and initiate a new tracking area updating procedure**.

results.question: For which entity is the detailed behaviour described in this clause?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer:
“The detailed behaviour of the UE is described in this clause.”  

Entity: **the UE (User Equipment)**.

results.question: When may the MS identity IE be included during a combined TA/LA update?
results.reference: to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE
results.model_answer:
During a combined TA/LA updating procedure, the UE shall include the **MS identity IE** if it has a valid P-TMSI.

> “If the UE performs a combined TA/LA updating procedure and has a valid P-TMSI, the UE shall include the MS identity IE containing the P-TMSI.”

results.question: What may the UE include to request the use of eDRX?
results.reference: this IE
results.model_answer: The UE may include the **extended DRX parameters IE** in an **ATTACH REQUEST** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message to request the use of eDRX.

results.question: What action can be performed on a TMSI using the MS identity IE in a combined TA/LA update?
results.reference: assign or unassign a new TMSI
results.model_answer: In a combined TA/LA update, **a new TMSI can be allocated (TMSI reallocation)** by including it in the **MS identity IE** (in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message).

results.question: What does the UE set the update status to after receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
results.reference: U1 UPDATED
results.model_answer: After receiving a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message, the UE shall set the update status to **U1 UPDATED**.

results.question: What timer does the MME start when TMSI reallocation is part of the combined tracking area updating procedure?
results.model_answer:
The MME starts **timer T3450**.

> “The MME shall start timer T3450 when the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message is sent.”

results.question: When an initial plain NAS message for transport of user data via control plane is to be partially ciphered, what is the length of the key stream set to?
results.reference: the length of the part of the initial plain NAS message (i.e. the value part of the ESM message container IE or the value part of the NAS message container) that is to be ciphered
results.model_answer: “The length of the key stream shall be set to the length of the initial plain NAS message,” i.e. including the part that is not ciphered.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the MS identity IE in a combined TA/LA update?
results.reference: to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE
results.model_answer:
The **MS identity IE** is included to provide the UE’s **CS-domain identity (normally the TMSI)** for the LA update part of the combined TA/LA update.

It enables the MME to convey the UE identity to the MSC/VLR so that the MSC/VLR can identify the UE’s existing CS-domain context and perform the location-area update.

results.question: When the attach attempt counter is equal to 5, what shall the UE do regarding radio access technology selection?
results.reference: the UE shall attempt to select GERAN, UTRAN or NG-RAN radio access technology and proceed with appropriate GMM or 5GMM specific procedures.
results.model_answer: When the attach attempt counter is equal to 5, **the UE shall select a PLMN on a radio access technology other than E-UTRAN, if available.**

results.question: What is the purpose of the UE including the Extended DRX parameters IE?
results.reference: to request the use of eDRX
results.model_answer: The UE includes the **Extended DRX parameters IE** to **request use of extended DRX (eDRX) in idle mode** and to indicate its requested eDRX settings, i.e. the **eDRX cycle** and **paging time window (PTW)**.

results.question: What must be exceeded from clause 9.9.4.3 for the Extended EPS QoS IE to be included?
results.reference: the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element
results.model_answer: The **Extended EPS QoS IE shall be included if any of the maximum bit rate or guaranteed bit rate values for uplink or downlink exceeds 256 Mbps**.

results.question: What state does the UE enter after receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message during a combined tracking area update?
results.reference: MM IDLE
results.model_answer: After receiving a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message during a combined tracking area update, the UE enters the **EMM-REGISTERED state**.

results.question: How is the HashMME information element coded?
results.reference: as shown in figure 9.9.3.50.1 and table 9.9.3.50.1
results.model_answer:
The **HashMME information element** is coded as a **TLV** IE:

- **Octet 1:** IEI (HashMME IEI = `0x4F`)
- **Octet 2:** Length of HashMME contents (set to `8`)
- **Octets 3–10:** **HashMME**, coded as an octet string of **8 octets**.

Thus, the HashMME value itself is 8 octets long.

results.question: Under what circumstance is the ESM cause IE included according to clause 8.3.10.3?
results.reference: when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource
results.model_answer: The ESM cause IE **shall be included in the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message**.

results.question: Which clause of TS 24.301 contains the Supported codec list information element?
results.reference: Clause 9.9.2.10
results.model_answer: Clause **9.9.4.37**, “Supported codec list.”

results.question: In which clause is the detailed behaviour of the UE in the states EMM-DEREGISTERED and EMM-REGISTERED described?
results.reference: In this clause
results.model_answer: The detailed behaviour is described in **clause 5.3, “EMM specific procedures.”**

results.question: In which abnormal case does the UE receive a paging indication while a UE-initiated EMM specific procedure is ongoing?
results.reference: The paging indication received when UE-initiated EMM specific procedure or service request procedure is ongoing
results.model_answer: “If the UE receives a paging indication while a UE initiated EMM specific procedure is ongoing, the UE shall abort the ongoing EMM specific procedure and initiate the service request procedure.”

results.question: What does the MME do if it includes a new TMSI in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message and then receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message?
results.reference: sends an SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE** message, the MME **shall consider the new TMSI as valid** (and can release/delete the old TMSI/GUTI allocation).

results.question: What type of tracking area updating is used to periodically notify the availability of the UE to the network?
results.reference: periodic tracking area updating to periodically notify the availability of the UE to the network
results.model_answer: **Periodic tracking area updating** is used to periodically notify the availability of the UE to the network.

results.question: What shall the receiving EMM or ESM entity in the UE not do once secure exchange of NAS messages has been established?
results.reference: shall not process any NAS signalling messages unless they have been successfully integrity checked by the NAS
results.model_answer: Once a secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the receiving EMM or ESM entity in the UE **shall not process any NAS message received without integrity protection**.

results.question: For case a in clause 5.6.1.1, what Control plane service type shall the UE indicate in the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message?
results.reference: "mobile terminating request"
results.model_answer: For case a, the UE shall indicate **“mobile originating data”** as the Control plane service type in the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

results.question: What shall the UE do if a NAS signalling message is received as not integrity protected after secure exchange is established?
results.reference: the NAS shall discard this message
results.model_answer: After a secure NAS exchange has been established, the UE **shall discard any NAS signalling message that is received without integrity protection** (apart from any explicitly specified exceptions for messages allowed to be unprotected).

results.question: Under what condition does the MME retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message after a lower layers indication of non-delivery due to handover?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover
results.model_answer:
The MME retransmits the DETACH REQUEST **if the handover procedure has been completed successfully**.

> “If the MME receives an indication from lower layers that the DETACH REQUEST message has not been delivered due to handover, the MME shall retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message if the handover procedure has been completed successfully.”

results.question: Which entity's response is the UE waiting for in the EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state?
results.reference: the MME
results.model_answer: In the **EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED** state, the UE is waiting for a response from the **MME**.

results.question: Which specific clause in TS 24.301 is identified as void?
results.reference: Clause 8.3.11.3
results.model_answer: Clause **5.5.1.3** is identified as **void**.

results.question: When timer T3402 expires, what procedure is triggered?
results.reference: the normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" or the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" is triggered
results.model_answer: When timer **T3402** expires, **the UE shall initiate a PLMN selection procedure**.

results.question: What does the UE do upon receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message?
results.reference: stop timer T3493 and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE** message, the UE shall stop the associated timer and consider the remote UE report procedure successfully completed.

results.question: What action does the network take upon receiving a DETACH REQUEST with 'switch off' indication during a network-initiated detach procedure?
results.reference: both procedures shall be considered completed
results.model_answer: Upon receiving a DETACH REQUEST with the **“switch off”** indication while a network-initiated detach is in progress, the network **aborts the network-initiated detach procedure and proceeds with the UE-initiated detach procedure**.

results.question: What EMM state does the network change to upon aborting the detach procedure due to lower layer failure, if the detach type is not 'IMSI detach' or 're-attach not required' with cause #2?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED
results.model_answer:
“The network shall abort the detach procedure if a lower layer failure occurs. If the detach type is not ‘IMSI detach’ or ‘re-attach not required’ with cause #2 ‘IMSI unknown in HSS’, the network shall return to EMM-REGISTERED state.”

So, it changes (returns) to the **EMM-REGISTERED** state.

results.question: In WB-S1 mode, what does the UE do if access is barred for 'originating signalling'?
results.reference: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process.
results.model_answer:
In WB-S1 mode, if access is barred for **“originating signalling”**, the UE **shall not initiate an EMM or ESM procedure that requires establishment of an RRC connection** (i.e. mobile-originated signalling), until access is no longer barred.

Emergency services are exempt: the UE may still initiate procedures for emergency bearer services.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Detach type information element?
results.reference: indicate the type of detach
results.model_answer: The purpose of the Detach type information element is **to indicate the type of detach requested**.

results.question: Into which state does the UE enter after receiving the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message?
results.reference: enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE** message, the UE shall enter the **EMM-REGISTERED state**.

results.question: What does the Back-off timer value IE request regarding procedure retry?
results.reference: a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed
results.model_answer: The Back-off timer value IE requests the UE to **wait for the indicated back-off period before attempting to re-initiate the procedure**.

results.question: What type of information element is the Detach type?
results.reference: a type 1 information element
results.model_answer: The **Detach type** is a **type 1 information element**, with a length of **4 bits**.

results.question: What does the UE provide to the network via the protocol configuration options when requesting a PDN connection for USS communication?
results.reference: CAA-level UAV ID
results.model_answer: The UE includes a request for the **P-CSCF IP address** in the Protocol Configuration Options (PCO) — i.e. a **P-CSCF IPv4 address request and/or P-CSCF IPv6 address request** — so that it can perform USS communication via IMS.

results.question: Which clause defines the Detach type information element?
results.reference: TS 24.301, Clause 9.9.3.7, Detach type
results.model_answer: Clause **9.9.3.10 — Detach type** defines the Detach type information element.

results.question: Who is informed by the EPS additional request result IE?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: The **EPS additional request result IE** is used to **inform the UE** of the result of its EPS additional request.

results.question: What message and cause shall the UE respond with if it receives an ESM DATA TRANSPORT message which includes a reserved EPS bearer identity value or an assigned value that does not match an existing EPS bearer context?
results.reference: ESM STATUS message including ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity"
results.model_answer: The UE shall respond with an **ESM STATUS** message with ESM cause **#43 “Invalid EPS bearer identity”**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the HashMME information element?
results.reference: to transfer a 64-bit hash value to the UE so the UE can check the MME calculated value against the value locally calculated by the UE to determine whether the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message sent by the UE has been modified
results.model_answer: The **HashMME** information element is used to enable the UE to detect a change of MME **when no new GUTI is allocated**. It carries a hash value associated with the serving MME identity, which the UE stores and compares with a previously stored value.

results.question: What is the purpose of the tracking area updating procedure when a UE enters S1 mode after CS fallback?
results.reference: to indicate that the UE enters S1 mode after CS fallback or 1xCS fallback
results.model_answer:
The tracking area updating procedure is used **to update the UE’s registration in the MME** when it re-enters S1 mode after CS fallback.

In particular, TS 24.301 states that it is used “to update the registration of the UE in the MME, i.e. to update the tracking area list and the UE’s temporary identity.”

results.question: What does the UE do on the third expiry of timer T3493?
results.reference: the UE shall abort the procedure and release any resources for this procedure
results.model_answer: On the third expiry of timer T3493, the UE **locally deactivates all EPS bearer contexts associated with the PDN connection and informs upper layers that the PDN connection has been disconnected.**

results.question: What action is controlled by the Back-off timer value IE in clause 8.3.9.3?
results.reference: procedure retry
results.model_answer: “The Back-off timer value IE is used to indicate the back-off time in seconds during which the UE shall not initiate any PDN connectivity procedure.”

results.question: To whom does the network transmit data when including the Extended protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: to the UE
results.model_answer: The network transmits the data **to the UE** (using the Extended protocol configuration options IE).

results.question: What message shall the UE respond with if it receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message which includes an unassigned or reserved EPS bearer identity value or an assigned EPS bearer identity value that does not match an existing EPS bearer context?
results.reference: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message with the EPS bearer identity set to the received EPS bearer identity
results.model_answer: The UE shall respond with an **ESM STATUS** message with ESM cause **#43 “invalid EPS bearer identity”**.

results.question: What are the two methods by which the UE and PDN GW can exchange protocol configuration options?
results.reference: via the dedicated ESM information request procedure or via other ESM procedures
results.model_answer:
The UE and the PDN GW can exchange protocol configuration options using:

- the **PDN connectivity procedure**; and  
- the **ESM information procedure**.

results.question: What is the exception for processing ATTACH REJECT without integrity protection?
results.reference: if the EMM cause is not #25
results.model_answer:
The UE shall ignore an **ATTACH REJECT** received without integrity protection, **except** when the EMM cause is:

- **#3 – Illegal UE**
- **#6 – Illegal ME**
- **#7 – EPS services not allowed**
- **#8 – EPS services and non-EPS services not allowed**

For those causes, the UE processes the unprotected ATTACH REJECT.

results.question: What must be true about the values to be transmitted for the Extended APN-AMBR IE to be included?
results.reference: at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.model_answer: The Extended APN-AMBR IE shall be included **if the APN-AMBR values to be transmitted cannot be encoded in the APN-AMBR IE**.

results.question: What shall the UE do if it receives an ESM message other than those listed in items a through j in which the message includes an unassigned or reserved EPS bearer identity value or a value that does not match an EPS bearer context of an established PDN connection?
results.reference: ignore the message
results.model_answer: The UE **shall ignore the ESM message**.

results.question: What is the name of the state a UE enters after starting the service request procedure while waiting for an MME response?
results.reference: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
results.model_answer: **EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED** state.

results.question: After starting which procedure does a UE enter the EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state?
results.reference: the service request procedure
results.model_answer: After starting the **service request procedure**, the UE enters the **EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED** state.

results.question: Which specific EMM procedure can the UE initiate in this substate as a response to paging?
results.reference: service request
results.model_answer: The UE can initiate the **service request procedure** as a response to paging.

results.question: What does a UE in PS mode 2 use for non-EPS services?
results.reference: the procedures defined in the relevant 3GPP specifications for CS mode
results.model_answer: A UE in **PS mode 2** uses the **CS domain (via GERAN or UTRAN)** for non-EPS services.

results.question: While in the EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state, what is the UE waiting for?
results.reference: a response from the MME
results.model_answer: “The UE has initiated the service request procedure and is waiting for a response from the network.”

results.question: When does the MME use the default APN as the requested APN?
results.reference: If no requested APN is included in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message or the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message and the request type is different from "emergency" and from "handover of emergency bearer services" and from "RLOS"
results.model_answer:
The MME uses the default APN as the requested APN **when the UE does not include an APN in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message**.

> “If the APN is not included, the MME shall use the default APN as the requested APN.”

results.question: In what geographical scope can the emergency numbers in the Extended emergency number list IE be valid?
results.reference: valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received or valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received
results.model_answer:
The emergency numbers in the **Extended emergency number list IE** can be valid in:

- the **entire PLMN**;
- a **tracking area**; or
- a **cell**.

results.question: In which UE substates does the tracking area updating attempt counter reset when a new tracking area is entered?
results.reference: the UE is in substate EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE or EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM
results.model_answer: “The UE shall reset the tracking area updating attempt counter when entering a new tracking area in **EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE**, **EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE** or **EMM-REGISTERED.UPDATE-NEEDED** state.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the Extended APN-AMBR IE be included in the message?
results.reference: if at least one of the APN-AMBR values has been changed by the network and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.model_answer: The Extended APN-AMBR IE shall be included **if the APN-AMBR for uplink and/or downlink is greater than 8 640 kbps**.

results.question: What information is included with the emergency numbers in the Extended emergency number list IE?
results.reference: with URN information
results.model_answer: The Extended emergency number list IE contains a list of emergency numbers, **each associated with an emergency service category value** (e.g. police, ambulance, fire brigade).

results.question: What is the purpose of the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure?
results.reference: to establish a dedicated EPS bearer context between the UE and the EPC
results.model_answer: “The dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure is used by the network to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the EPS additional request result IE according to TS 24.301?
results.reference: to inform the UE about the result of additional request
results.model_answer: “The EPS additional request result IE is used to indicate the result of an additional request made by the UE during the attach procedure or tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: What are the two possible reasons for the UE entering the UPDATE-NEEDED substate?
results.reference: the access class is blocked due to access class control, or if the network rejects the NAS signalling connection establishment
results.model_answer:
The UE enters the **EMM-REGISTERED.UPDATE-NEEDED** substate when:

- it detects that it has entered a tracking area that is **not included in its registered tracking area list**; or  
- **periodic tracking area updating is required** (i.e. the periodic TAU timer expires).

results.question: What procedure shall a UE in LIMITED-SERVICE state perform regarding cell selection/reselection?
results.reference: shall perform cell selection/reselection according to 3GPP S 36.304 [21]
results.model_answer: “The UE shall perform cell selection and reselection procedures in order to select a suitable cell.”

results.question: What does the UE check using the HashMME value?
results.reference: the UE can check the MME calculated value against the value locally calculated by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE uses the **HashMME** value to check that the MME involved in the procedure is the same MME to which the UE’s current EPS security context is bound (i.e. to verify the MME identity/security-context association).

results.question: Which timer does the UE stop when it receives the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message?
results.reference: stop timer T3493
results.model_answer: The UE **stops timer T3440** when it receives the **REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE** message.

results.question: Who may send the Extended emergency number list IE?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The **MME** may send the **Extended emergency number list IE** to the UE.

results.question: What type of data can the network transmit using the Extended protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events)
results.model_answer: The network can use the **Extended protocol configuration options IE** to transfer **external network protocol options associated with a PDN connection** to the UE (i.e. protocol-configuration data, in an extended-length format).

results.question: Under what condition is the Forbidden TAI(s) IE included in the message?
results.reference: if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access
results.model_answer:
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included when the EMM cause is set to:

- **#12 “Tracking area not allowed”**, or  
- **#13 “Roaming not allowed in this tracking area.”**

results.question: What procedure must the UE initiate after completing the network-initiated detach with 're-attach required' and releasing the NAS signalling connection?
results.reference: initiate an attach or combined attach procedure
results.model_answer:
After sending the **DETACH ACCEPT** and releasing the NAS signalling connection, the UE **shall initiate an attach procedure**.

> “If the detach type indicates ‘re-attach required’, the UE shall, after sending the DETACH ACCEPT message and after the NAS signalling connection has been released, initiate an attach procedure.”

results.question: What state does the UE enter after sending DETACH ACCEPT during the network-initiated detach procedure with 're-attach required'?
results.reference: enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED
results.model_answer:
After sending the DETACH ACCEPT, the UE **enters the EMM-DEREGISTERED state**.

For detach type **“re-attach required”**, it then initiates the attach procedure.

results.question: How many octets long is the EMM cause information element?
results.reference: 2 octets length
results.model_answer: The EMM cause information element is **1 octet** long.

results.question: When timer T3447 is running, when can the UE send the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message if it is still necessary?
results.reference: when timer T3447 expires
results.model_answer: “Upon expiry of timer T3447, the UE may send the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message, if it is still necessary.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the EMM cause information element?
results.reference: to indicate the reason why an EMM request from the UE is rejected by the network
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the EMM cause information element is to indicate the reason why an EMM procedure has failed or is being rejected.”

results.question: Which information element may be included to provide a new DCN-ID to the UE?
results.reference: DCN-ID
results.model_answer: The **DCN-ID information element** may be included to provide a new DCN-ID to the UE.

results.question: When timer T3346 is running, when can the UE send the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message if it is still necessary?
results.reference: when timer T3346 expires or is stopped
results.model_answer: When timer T3346 is running, the UE shall not send an **UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT** message, **unless it is sent in response to a DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message and is still necessary**.

results.question: What must be set in the paging message's CN domain indicator when initiating paging for SMS?
results.reference: set to "PS"
results.model_answer: For paging initiated for SMS, the **CN domain indicator shall be set to “PS domain.”**

results.question: What type of information element is the EMM cause?
results.reference: type 3 information element
results.model_answer: “The EMM cause information element is a type 1 information element.”

results.question: Which messages are accepted by the UE without integrity protection in certain situations?
results.reference: IDENTITY REQUEST (if requested identification parameter is IMSI), ATTACH REJECT (if the EMM cause is not #25), DETACH ACCEPT (for non switch off), TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT (if the EMM cause is not #25), SERVICE REJECT (if the EMM cause is not #25)

results.question: Under what condition is the EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED substate entered?
results.reference: if the UE is attached for EPS and non-EPS services and wants to detach for non-EPS services only
results.model_answer: The UE enters the **EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED** substate **when it initiates the IMSI detach procedure**.

results.question: What does the UE need to obtain for ciphered broadcast assistance data to include the Additional information requested IE?
results.reference: new ciphering keys
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Additional information requested** IE when it needs to obtain the **ciphering key for ciphered broadcast assistance data**.

results.question: To what entity is a new DCN-ID assigned when the DCN-ID IE is included?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: A new DCN-ID is assigned to the **UE** when the DCN-ID IE is included.

results.question: What is the purpose of the transport of NAS messages procedure?
results.reference: to carry SMS messages in an encapsulated form between the MME and the UE
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the transport of NAS messages procedure is to provide a means for the transfer of NAS messages between the UE and the MME.”

results.question: Under what condition is the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE excluded during a periodic tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: except when the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: The **DRX parameter IE shall be excluded** in a periodic tracking area updating procedure in NB-S1 mode **if the UE has not changed its DRX parameter since the last successful TAU/attach procedure**.

results.question: In TS 24.301, what does Clause 6.1.4A direct the reader to see?
results.reference: clause 6.1.4 in 3GPP S 24.501 [54]
results.model_answer: Clause 6.1.4A directs the reader to **3GPP TS 24.008, subclause 11.2** (“Handling of unknown, unforeseen and erroneous protocol data”).

results.question: What is the purpose of including the DCN-ID IE according to clause 8.2.16.3?
results.reference: to assign a new DCN-ID to the UE
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the DCN-ID is to identify a dedicated core network.”

results.question: Under what condition can a UE send an UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message when timer T3346 is running, if the UE is configured for dual priority?
results.reference: the UE is configured for dual priority and has a PDN connection established without low access priority but the timer T3346 was started in response to NAS signalling request with low access priority
results.model_answer: A UE configured for dual priority may send an **UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT** message while **T3346** is running **only if the message is associated with high-priority NAS signalling** (i.e. it is a high-priority message/transport).

results.question: What types of information may be sent and received while in the EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED substate?
results.reference: User data and signalling information
results.model_answer: While in the **EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED** substate, the UE may send and receive **EMM signalling messages and SMS messages**.

results.question: When does the network initiate paging for an incoming mobile terminating SMS received outside the paging time window for a UE using eDRX?
results.reference: at T time ahead of the beginning of the next paging time window
results.model_answer:
The network initiates paging **at the start of the next paging time window (PTW)**.

> “If the network receives a mobile terminating SMS outside the paging time window, the network shall initiate paging at the beginning of the next paging time window.”

results.question: What can be lost during inter-system mobility from NB-S1 mode to WB-S1 mode according to Note 1?
results.reference: the end-to-end support of the extended protocol configuration options IE
results.model_answer: According to Note 1, **the UE can lose its EPS bearer context(s)** during inter-system mobility from NB-S1 mode to WB-S1 mode.

results.question: Which IE shall be included when the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412?
results.reference: MS network feature support
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Extended periodic timer T3412 value IE**.

results.question: What ESM cause value does the UE send when rejecting an activation request due to a semantic error in the TFT operation?
results.reference: #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation"
results.model_answer: ESM cause value **#41 – “semantic error in the TFT operation”**.

results.question: What does the Extended emergency number list IE indicate when sent by the network?
results.reference: a list of emergency numbers (with URN information) valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received or valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received
results.model_answer: When sent by the network, the **Extended emergency number list IE** indicates the emergency numbers applicable at the UE’s current location (i.e. the emergency numbers the UE can use in the serving area).

results.question: What shall the MME do if a NOTIFICATION message could not be delivered due to an intra MME handover and the handover is successfully completed?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover the MME shall retransmit the NOTIFICATION message
results.model_answer: “If the NOTIFICATION message could not be delivered due to an intra MME handover and the handover is successfully completed, the MME shall retransmit the NOTIFICATION message.”

results.question: Which IETF-based method is specified for IPv4 address allocation and IPv4 parameter configuration?
results.reference: IPv4 address allocation and IPv4 parameter configuration via DHCPv4
results.model_answer: The specified IETF-based method is **Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv4 (DHCPv4)**.

results.question: How does a UE in EMM-IDLE mode using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization transport the first SMS message?
results.reference: by encapsulating it in the NAS message container IE in the Control Plane Service Request message
results.model_answer:
A UE in **EMM-IDLE** mode using **control plane CIoT EPS optimization** transports the first SMS by initiating the **control plane service request procedure**.

It includes the SMS message in the **NAS message container** of the **CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST** message.

results.question: Which timers shall the MME not start for the paging procedure for SMS?
results.reference: timers T3413 and T3415
results.model_answer: For a paging procedure for SMS, the MME shall not start **timer T3413** and **timer T3417**.

results.question: Under what condition does the network initiate paging for an incoming mobile terminating SMS when the UE is attached for EPS services with CIoT EPS optimization?
results.reference: the UE has requested "SMS only" and the UE is in NB-S1 mode
results.model_answer:
The network initiates paging for an incoming mobile-terminating SMS **only if the UE has indicated in the ATTACH REQUEST that it supports mobile-terminating SMS over NAS transport**.

> “If the UE is attached for EPS services with CIoT EPS optimization, the network shall initiate paging for an incoming mobile terminating SMS only if the UE has indicated in the ATTACH REQUEST message that it supports mobile terminating SMS over NAS transport.”

results.question: When is the MS network feature support IE mandatory according to clause 8.2.29.22?
results.reference: if the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412
results.model_answer: The **MS network feature support IE is mandatory when the UE supports IMS voice over PS sessions in S1 mode and/or emergency bearer services in S1 mode**.

results.question: What shall a UE configured for eCall only mode do at the expiry of timer T3444 or T3445?
results.reference: shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 (see clause 5.5.4)
results.model_answer: At expiry of timer **T3444** or **T3445**, a UE configured for eCall only mode **shall initiate the detach procedure and enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.ECALL INACTIVE state**.

results.question: In which UE operating modes and state shall the combined tracking area updating procedure be initiated?
results.reference: The UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2, in state EMM-REGISTERED
results.model_answer: A UE shall initiate the combined tracking area updating procedure **when operating in A/Gb mode or Iu mode and in EMM-IDLE mode**.

results.question: Which ESM cause value is used when the UE rejects the activation request due to an invalid EPS bearer identity?
results.reference: #43: invalid EPS bearer identity
results.model_answer: ESM cause value **#51 — “Invalid EPS bearer identity”** is used.

results.question: What does the MME do upon receiving an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message while in state BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING?
results.reference: stop the timer T3485, enter the state BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE and abort the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
results.model_answer:
Upon receiving an **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message in state **BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING**, the MME:

> “shall stop timer T3485, release the resources associated with the dedicated EPS bearer context and enter the state BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the EPS update result information element?
results.reference: to specify the result of the associated updating procedure
results.model_answer: “The EPS update result IE is used to indicate the result of the tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the MS network feature support IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412
results.model_answer: The **MS network feature support IE shall be included if the UE supports one or more of the network features represented by that IE** (e.g. IMS voice over PS session in S1 mode and/or emergency bearer services).

results.question: Under what configuration condition shall the UE perform the eCall inactivity procedure at timer expiry?
results.reference: if configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP S 31.102 [17]
results.model_answer: At expiry of the eCall inactivity timer, **“the UE shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure if the UE is configured for eCall only mode.”**

results.question: When can the transport of NAS messages procedure be used?
results.reference: when the UE is attached for EPS services and non-EPS services or for EPS services and "SMS only", and the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode
results.model_answer:
The transport of NAS messages procedure can be used **only when the UE is in the EMM-REGISTERED state**.  

If the UE is in EMM-IDLE mode, it first needs to establish NAS signalling connectivity (e.g. by the service request procedure) before sending an **UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT** message.

results.question: What type of information element is the EPS update result?
results.reference: a type 1 information element
results.model_answer: “The EPS update result is a type 3 information element with a length of 1 octet.”

results.question: According to TS 24.301 clause 9.9.3.2, where should one look for the definition of the AUTN parameter?
results.model_answer: “The AUTN parameter is defined in 3GPP TS 33.102.”

results.question: To which entity is a TAI list assigned by the TAI list IE?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: The TAI list IE is used to assign a list of tracking areas **to a UE**.

results.question: When is a default EPS bearer context activated?
results.reference: when the UE requests a connection to a PDN
results.model_answer: “The default EPS bearer context activation procedure is used to establish a default EPS bearer context for a PDN connection. The procedure is initiated by the network, and can be initiated as part of the attach procedure or the PDN connectivity procedure.”

results.question: What value shall any other value received by the mobile station be treated as?
results.reference: 0110 1111, "protocol error, unspecified"
results.model_answer: Any other value received by the mobile station shall be treated as **“no adjustment for daylight saving time.”**

results.question: To which entity does the UE transmit data when using the Protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: to the network
results.model_answer:
The UE uses the **Protocol configuration options (PCO) IE** to transfer protocol configuration options to the **PDN Gateway (PDN-GW)**.

> “The Protocol configuration options IE is used to transfer external network protocol options between the UE and the PDN GW.”

results.question: Under what condition can the network initiate downlink transport of NAS messages procedure for a UE using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization?
results.reference: even if the UE does not have any PDN connections established
results.model_answer:
The network can initiate the downlink transport of NAS messages procedure **when the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode**.

If the UE is in EMM-IDLE mode, the network first initiates the network-triggered service request procedure.

results.question: What does the TAI list IE assign according to the provided clause?
results.reference: a TAI list
results.model_answer: “The TAI list IE is used to assign a list of tracking areas to the UE.”

results.question: What additional time is added to the timer in table 10.3.2 for an MME supporting NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: plus 180s
results.model_answer: For an MME supporting NB-S1 mode, **an additional 2 seconds** is added to the timer values in table 10.3.2.

results.question: Which clause of 3GPP S 24.008 is referenced for Daylight saving time details?
results.reference: clause 10.5.3.12
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 24.008, clause **10.5.3.12** (“Daylight saving time”).

results.question: What value is added to the NAS timer indicated in table 10.2.1 for a UE in NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: plus 240s
results.model_answer: For a UE in NB-S1 mode, **10 seconds** is added to the NAS timer value indicated in table 10.2.1.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the TAI list IE according to clause 8.2.16.2?
results.reference: to assign a TAI list to the UE
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the TAI list IE is to provide the UE with the list of tracking areas where the UE is registered.”

results.question: Which 3GPP specification clause defines the AUTN parameter according to TS 24.301?
results.model_answer: “The AUTN parameter is defined in 3GPP TS 33.102, clause 6.3.3.”

results.question: Which procedure shall be performed at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 if configured for eCall only mode?
results.reference: the eCall inactivity procedure
results.model_answer: “At expiry of timer T3444 or T3445, if configured for eCall only mode, the UE shall perform the tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: In which clause of TS 24.301 is Daylight saving time addressed?
results.reference: Clause 9.9.3.6
results.model_answer: Daylight saving time is addressed in **clause 9.9.3.12, “Daylight saving time”** of 3GPP TS 24.301.

results.question: According to NOTE 2, what specific access case is included in NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: satellite access
results.model_answer: NB-S1 mode includes **NB-IoT access via satellite (i.e. NB-IoT NTN/satellite access)**.

results.question: When shall the UE set the RACS bit to "RACS supported" in the UE network capability IE?
results.reference: In WB-S1 mode, if the UE supports RACS
results.model_answer: The UE shall set the RACS bit to **“RACS supported”** if it supports **Radio Access Capability Signalling (RACS)** as specified in 3GPP TS 23.401.

results.question: What message and ESM cause shall the UE reply with if the linked EPS bearer identity in an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST does not match any activated default EPS bearer context?
results.reference: reply with an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity"
results.model_answer: The UE shall reply with an **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message with ESM cause **#43 “invalid EPS bearer identity”**.

results.question: What network capability triggers the inclusion of the LLC SAPI IE?
results.reference: a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode
results.model_answer: The LLC SAPI IE is included **if the network supports inter-RAT mobility to GERAN or UTRAN**.

results.question: For what type of assistance data does the clause specify conditions for including the Additional information requested IE?
results.reference: ciphered broadcast assistance data
results.model_answer: The condition applies to **UE assistance information for paging** (i.e. paging assistance data).

results.question: What document is referenced for the specification of Daylight saving time?
results.model_answer: Daylight saving time is specified in **3GPP TS 24.008**, subclause **10.5.3.12**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Release assistance indication IE according to TS 24.301?
results.reference: to inform the network whether
results.model_answer:
“The Release assistance indication IE is used by the UE to indicate that it does not expect to send or receive any further data in the near future.”  

It assists the network in deciding to release the radio connection/resources.

results.question: What shall the UE do if the PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode is reached and it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST?
results.reference: the UE shall clear the determination representing the PLMN 's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode and proceed with the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
results.model_answer: If the UE is in S1 mode and the PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts has been reached, it shall send an **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message with ESM cause **#65 “maximum number of EPS bearers reached.”**

results.question: To which specific clause is the WLAN offload indication procedure specified?
results.reference: as specified in clause 9.9.4.18
results.model_answer: The WLAN offload indication procedure is specified in **clause 5.6.3** of 3GPP TS 24.301.

results.question: What TIN value shall a UE with ISR activated change to in order to locally deactivate ISR?
results.reference: "GUTI"
results.model_answer: The UE shall change the TIN value to **“P-TMSI”** to locally deactivate ISR.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the NAS security mode control procedure?
results.reference: to take an EPS security context into use, and initialise and start NAS signalling security between the UE and the MME with the corresponding EPS NAS keys and EPS security algorithms
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the security mode control procedure is to provide the UE with NAS security parameters which shall be used for subsequent NAS signalling messages.”

results.question: According to the clause, where is the specification for the newly connected remote UE information provided?
results.model_answer: The specification for the newly connected remote UE information is provided in **3GPP TS 24.334**.

results.question: Which entity includes the Remote UE Context Connected IE in the message?
results.reference: the UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay
results.model_answer: The **UE-to-Network Relay** includes the **Remote UE Context Connected** IE in the **REMOTE UE REPORT** message.

results.question: How is the EPS update result information element coded?
results.reference: as shown in figure 9.9.3.13.1 and table 9.9.3.13.1
results.model_answer:
The **EPS update result** information element is coded as a **4-bit value**:

- `0000` — **TA updated**
- `0001` — **combined TA/LA updated**
- `0010` — **combined TA/LA updated with IMSI attach**
- All other values are reserved.

It is carried in bits 4 to 1 of the octet; bits 8 to 5 are spare.

results.question: What shall the network do if a lower layer failure occurs before receiving ATTACH COMPLETE from the UE?
results.reference: the network shall locally abort the attach procedure, enter state EMM-DEREGISTERED and shall not resend the message ATTACH ACCEPT
results.model_answer: If a lower layer failure occurs before receipt of **ATTACH COMPLETE**, the network shall **abort the attach procedure and release the NAS signalling connection**. The network shall also release/deactivate the bearer resources established for the attach.

results.question: When does an MME supporting NB-S1 mode calculate the NAS timer value for signalling with a UE using NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: at start of a NAS procedure
results.model_answer: An MME supporting NB-S1 mode calculates the NAS timer value **when it starts a NAS timer for signalling with a UE using NB-S1 mode** (i.e. on a per-signalling-procedure basis, taking the NB-S1 transmission delay into account).

results.question: Under what condition does the network include the T3447 value IE when the UE has indicated support for service gap control?
results.reference: the EMM context contains a service gap time value
results.model_answer: If the UE has indicated support for service gap control, the network includes the **T3447 value IE** when it wants to provide the UE with a **T3447 value different from the default value**.

results.question: Which EMM cause values shall the network return in an ATTACH REJECT if the ATTACH REQUEST is received with a protocol error?
results.reference: #96: invalid mandatory information #99: information element non-existent or not implemented #100: conditional IE error; or #111: protocol error, unspecified
results.model_answer:
If the ATTACH REQUEST is received with a protocol error, the network shall return an ATTACH REJECT with one of these EMM cause values:

- **#95** — “semantically incorrect message”
- **#96** — “invalid mandatory information”
- **#97** — “message type non-existent or not implemented”
- **#99** — “information element non-existent or not implemented”
- **#100** — “conditional IE error”

results.question: For cases n, zc and ze, when shall the UE set the URCIDA bit to "UE radio capability ID available" in WB-S1 mode?
results.reference: if the UE supports RACS and the UE has an applicable UE radio capability ID for the new UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN
results.model_answer: For cases **n, zc and ze**, in **WB-S1 mode**, the UE shall set the URCIDA bit to **“UE radio capability ID available”** if it has a **valid UE radio capability ID for WB-S1 mode** (i.e. an ID assigned by the MME that remains valid for the UE’s current radio capabilities).

results.question: What shall the MME do if the ATTACH REQUEST is received with invalid or unacceptable UE security capabilities?
results.reference: the MME shall return an ATTACH REJECT message
results.model_answer: The MME shall reject the attach by sending an **ATTACH REJECT** message with EMM cause **#23 – “UE security capabilities mismatch.”**

results.question: Upon modification of which EPS bearer contexts shall the UE change its TIN to "GUTI" to locally deactivate ISR?
results.reference: any EPS bearer context which was activated before the ISR is activated in the UE
results.model_answer: “Upon modification of **any EPS bearer context**, the UE shall change the TIN to ‘GUTI’ and shall locally deactivate ISR.”

results.question: What shall the UE do if it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with an EPS bearer identity identical to that of an already activated default EPS bearer context?
results.reference: the UE shall locally deactivate the existing default EPS bearer context and all the associated dedicated EPS bearer contexts, if any, and proceed with the requested dedicated EPS bearer context activation
results.model_answer: The UE **shall send an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #43 “invalid EPS bearer identity.”**

results.question: What action does the UE take if, during TFT error checking, the TFT operation is an operation other than 'Create a new TFT'?
results.reference: reject the activation request with ESM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation"
results.model_answer: If the TFT operation is other than **“Create a new TFT”**, the UE **shall check that a TFT is already associated with the EPS bearer context**.

results.question: What mode must the UE support for the network to include the radio priority IE during S1 to A/Gb mobility?
results.reference: A/Gb mode
results.model_answer: The UE must support **A/Gb mode** for the network to include the **Radio priority** IE during S1-to-A/Gb mobility.

results.question: Upon deactivation of the last non-emergency EPS bearer context, when shall the UE change its TIN to "GUTI" to locally deactivate ISR?
results.reference: if the UE has only a PDN connection for emergency bearer services remaining
results.model_answer: “Upon deactivation of the last non-emergency EPS bearer context, the UE shall change its TIN to ‘GUTI’ **if the UE is in EMM-IDLE mode** in order to locally deactivate ISR.”

results.question: What shall the UE include during a combined tracking area updating procedure when it lacks a valid TMSI?
results.reference: this IE
results.model_answer: During a combined tracking area updating procedure, if the UE does not have a valid TMSI, it shall include the **TMSI status IE** in the `TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST` message and set it to **“no valid TMSI”**.

results.question: For restrictions concerning concurrent running of the security mode control procedure with other security procedures, which specification and clause should be referenced?
results.model_answer: For restrictions concerning concurrent running of the security mode control procedure with other security procedures, refer to **3GPP TS 33.401, clause 7.2.3** (“NAS security mode control procedure”).

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the Additional information requested IE?
results.reference: if the UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and the UE needs to obtain new ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Additional information requested** IE **if it requests the network to provide additional information to the UE** (i.e. in the corresponding ATTACH ACCEPT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message).

results.question: What UE configuration triggers inclusion of the Device properties IE?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer:
The UE includes the **Device properties IE** when it is **configured for NAS signalling low priority**.

> “The UE shall include the Device properties IE if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority.”

results.question: What shall the UE initiate according to conditions given in clause 5.5.3.3 or clause 5.5.2.2.4?
results.reference: combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: The UE shall initiate the **attach procedure**.

results.question: What are two examples of EMM common procedures that may be initiated?
results.reference: the EMM authentication and security mode control procedures
results.model_answer:
Two examples of EMM common procedures are:

- **Authentication procedure**
- **Security mode control procedure**

results.question: What does the table in each definition list about Information Elements?
results.reference: the Information Elements (IE) known in the message and the order of their appearance in the message
results.model_answer: The table in each message definition lists the Information Elements **in the order in which they shall appear in the message**, together with their **type/reference, presence, format, and length**.

results.question: What shall the UE not attempt with the current PLMN after receiving ATTACH ACCEPT with EMM cause #15?
results.reference: shall not attempt combined attach or combined tracking area updating procedures with current PLMN until switching off the UE or the UICC containing the USIM is removed
results.model_answer: “The UE shall not attempt to attach to the current PLMN in the current tracking area.”

results.question: What does each definition given in clause 8.1 include regarding message significance?
results.reference: a brief description of the message direction and use, including whether the message has 1. Local significance, i.e. relevant only on the originating or terminating access 2. Access significance, i.e. relevant in the originating and terminating access, but not in the network 3. Dual significance, i.e. relevant in either the originating or terminating access and in the network; or 4. Global significance, i.e. relevant in the originating and terminating access and in the network
results.model_answer: Each message definition includes **“a brief description of the message significance.”**

results.question: Over what time interval does the Serving PLMN rate control apply?
results.reference: per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: “The Serving PLMN rate control value indicates the maximum number of PDN connectivity requests that the UE is allowed to make in a **6 minute interval**.”

results.question: During which procedure may the MME initiate EMM common procedures?
results.reference: the combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: “The MME may initiate EMM common procedures at any time during an EMM specific procedure.”

results.question: Which message's purpose does the Control plane service type information element specify?
results.reference: the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message
results.model_answer: “The Control plane service type information element is used to specify the purpose of the SERVICE REQUEST message.”

results.question: When shall the WLAN offload indication IE be included in the message?
results.reference: when the network wishes to indicate if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s)
results.model_answer: The WLAN offload indication IE shall be included in the **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** message **if the MME has received a WLAN offload indication from the serving GW**.

results.question: What may the UE do regarding the T3412 extended value IE when T3324 value IE is included?
results.reference: include this IE to request a particular T3412 value
results.model_answer: If the UE includes the **T3324 value IE**, it **may include the T3412 extended value IE** (to request an extended periodic tracking area update timer value).

results.question: What UE capability triggers the requirement for the network to include the Radio Priority IE?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode
results.model_answer:
The requirement is triggered when the UE indicates **support for the radio priority feature** in the **UE network capability IE**.

In that case, the network shall include the **Radio Priority IE**.

results.question: What type of information element is the Control plane service type?
results.reference: a type 1 information element
results.model_answer: “The Control plane service type information element is a type 1 information element.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the TMSI status IE?
results.reference: if it has no valid TMSI available
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **TMSI status IE** in the **ATTACH REQUEST** message **if it has a valid TMSI available and is performing a combined EPS/IMSI attach**.

results.question: What does the length indication '?' mean for an Information Element?
results.reference: the maximum length of the IE is only constrained by link layer protocol
results.model_answer: The length indication **“?”** means that the Information Element has **variable length**. Its actual length is determined from the IE’s own length field/length indicator (where applicable), rather than being a fixed number of octets.

results.question: Under what condition related to handover failure shall the MME retransmit the NOTIFICATION message?
results.reference: If a failure of the handover procedure is reported by the lower layer and the S1 signalling connection exists
results.model_answer: The MME shall retransmit the **NOTIFICATION** message **if the handover fails after the NOTIFICATION message has been sent to the target eNodeB (i.e. upon receipt of a HANDOVER FAILURE indication/message)**.

results.question: Which entity sends the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The **MME (network)** sends the **AUTHENTICATION REJECT** message to the UE.

results.question: Under what condition may the UE include the T3412 extended value IE?
results.reference: if the T3324 value IE is included
results.model_answer: The UE may include the **T3412 extended value IE** if it supports the extended periodic TAU timer and requests a periodic TAU timer value that is longer than the maximum value representable by the normal **T3412 value IE**.

results.question: When is the Device properties IE included according to clause 8.2.33.5?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: “The Device properties IE shall be included in the ATTACH REQUEST message and TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if the UE is configured for low priority access.”

results.question: Which specific procedures, when failed, can lead to the UE selecting the ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate?
results.reference: attach or combined attach procedure
results.model_answer:
The UE can select **EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH** following failure of:

- an **attach procedure**;
- a **tracking area updating (TAU) procedure**; or
- a **service request procedure**,

where the applicable failure handling causes the UE to become deregistered and to attempt a new EPS attach.

results.question: What shall the UE indicate in the EPS attach type IE when initiating a combined attach procedure?
results.reference: "combined EPS/IMSI attach"
results.model_answer: The UE shall indicate **“combined EPS/IMSI attach”** in the EPS attach type IE.

results.question: For what services can a UE in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 use the combined attach procedure to attach?
results.reference: both EPS and non-EPS services, or both EPS services and "SMS only"
results.model_answer: “A UE configured for CS/PS mode 1 of operation or CS/PS mode 2 of operation shall use the combined attach procedure to attach for **EPS services and non-EPS services**.”

results.question: Under what condition does the UE use the default value for T3423?
results.reference: If this IE is not included
results.model_answer: The UE uses the default value for T3423 when no **T3423 value IE** is included in the relevant **ATTACH ACCEPT** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message.

results.question: What is the direction of the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message?
results.reference: network to UE
results.model_answer: The **AUTHENTICATION REJECT** message is sent **from the network to the UE**.

results.question: What is the message type for the message sent by the network to provide EPS mobility management related data in response to a tracking area update request?
results.reference: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
results.model_answer:
**TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message (message type **0x49**).

> “The TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message is sent by the network to provide EPS mobility management related data to the UE in response to a tracking area updating request message.”

results.question: What entity may initiate EMM common procedures during the combined tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: the MME
results.model_answer: “The MME may initiate EMM common procedures during the combined tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: What does the T3423 value IE indicate when included?
results.reference: a value for timer T3423
results.model_answer: When included, the **T3423 value IE indicates the time, in seconds, during which the UE shall not initiate a tracking area updating procedure** (i.e. the value to be used for timer T3423).

results.question: What is the purpose of the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message in 3GPP TS 24.301?
results.reference: to indicate that the authentication procedure has failed and that the UE shall abort all activities
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is to indicate that the authentication of the UE has failed.”

results.question: What EPS update status does the UE set when a tracking area update is rejected with EMM cause #12?
results.reference: EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
results.model_answer:
The UE shall set its EPS update status to **EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED**.

> “the UE shall set its EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED”

results.question: When shall the Protocol configuration options IE NOT be included in the message?
results.reference: if the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included in the message
results.model_answer: The **Protocol configuration options IE shall not be included in the message if the UE does not request any protocol configuration options.**

results.question: In which direction is the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message sent from the UE?
results.reference: UE to network
results.model_answer: The **MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message is sent **from the UE to the network (MME)**.

results.question: For what type of UE is core network selection specified in clause 4.8.4A.1 of 3GPP S 24.501?
results.reference: A UE that supports CIoT optimizations
results.model_answer: Core network selection is specified for **a UE that supports both 5GS and EPS**, i.e. a UE capable of operating in both **N1 mode and S1 mode**.

results.question: In which type of messages does the second octet contain the procedure transaction identity?
results.reference: every EPS Session Management (ESM) message
results.model_answer: The second octet contains the **Procedure Transaction Identity (PTI) in EPS Session Management (ESM) messages**.

results.question: What EMM cause value is set in the ATTACH REJECT message when it is combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message due to default EPS bearer setup failure?
results.reference: #19, "ESM failure"
results.model_answer: The ATTACH REJECT message shall contain EMM cause value **#19 “ESM failure”** when it is combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT due to default EPS bearer setup failure.

results.question: What is the purpose of the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message?
results.reference: to reject a modification of an active EPS bearer context
results.model_answer: “The MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message is sent by the UE to the MME to indicate that the requested modification of an EPS bearer context is rejected.”

results.question: Which entity can send the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message according to clause 8.3.17.1?
results.reference: the UE or the network
results.model_answer:
The **UE** can send the **MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message.

> “The UE shall send a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message to the MME …”

results.question: Which bits of the second octet contain the procedure transaction identity in every EPS Session Management message?
results.reference: Bits 1 to 8
results.model_answer: Bits 1 to 8 of octet 2 contain the procedure transaction identity (PTI).

results.question: What is the procedure number for the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure not accepted by the network?
results.model_answer: **5.4.5.4 — UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure not accepted by the network**

results.question: In which octet of every EPS Session Management message is the procedure transaction identity located?
results.reference: the second octet (octet 1a)
results.model_answer: “The procedure transaction identity is located in octet 2 of every EPS session management message.”

results.question: What EMM cause value and timer are set when a tracking area update request is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control?
results.reference: #22 "congestion" and assign a value for back-off timer T3346
results.model_answer:
The MME rejects the TAU request with:

- **EMM cause #22 — “congestion”**
- **Timer T3346**, set to the value included in the **T3346 value IE** of the `TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT` message.

results.question: Under what UE capability conditions may the MME include the Header compression configuration IE in the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST?
results.reference: If the UE indicated "Control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported" and "Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported" in the UE network capability IE in the latest ATTACH REQUEST message or the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and the MME supports Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization
results.model_answer:
The MME may include the **Header compression configuration** IE only if the UE has indicated support for:

- **Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization**; and
- **header compression** (in the UE’s ESM capability information).

results.question: What state does the UE enter after setting the attach attempt counter to 5 due to severe network failure?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
results.model_answer:
The UE enters the **EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH** state.

> “The UE shall set the attach attempt counter to 5 and enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state.”

results.question: According to clause 5.3.19.1, what is performed as specified in clause 4.8.4A.1 of 3GPP S 24.501?
results.reference: core network selection
results.model_answer: “The UE radio capability ID management procedure is performed as specified in clause 4.8.4A.1 of 3GPP TS 24.501.”

results.question: What is the message type for the message sent to reject a modification of an active EPS bearer context?
results.reference: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
results.model_answer:
**MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** — ESM message type **0xCB**.

> “The MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message is sent by the UE to the network to reject the modification of an active EPS bearer context.”

results.question: What shall the UE do if there is a request for emergency services pending and the emergency bearer services indicator shows 'emergency bearer services in S1 mode not supported'?
results.reference: shall skip the requirements defined below in the present clause for the receipt of an ATTACH ACCEPT message including an EMM cause value, attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology, select a setup message as defined in clause 5.3.7, proceed with appropriate MM specific procedures, and send the setup message
results.model_answer: The UE **shall not initiate a PDN connectivity procedure for emergency bearer services in S1 mode**.

results.question: What substate is entered if a suitable cell is found and the PLMN or tracking area is not forbidden?
results.reference: NORMAL-SERVICE
results.model_answer: The UE enters the **EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE** substate.

results.question: What does the UE set the EPS update status to when the attach request is rejected due to severe network failure?
results.reference: EU2 NOT UPDATED
results.model_answer: The UE shall set the EPS update status to **EU2 NOT UPDATED**.

results.question: In which 3GPP specification clause are the abnormal cases for default EPS bearer context activation in the UE defined?
results.reference: TS 24.301, Clause 6.4.1.5, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The abnormal cases are defined in **3GPP TS 24.301, clause 6.4.1.5, “Abnormal cases”**, under the EPS bearer context activation procedure.

results.question: What does the network provide to the UE during the UAV identification, authentication, and authorization procedure?
results.reference: the UAV identification, authentication, and authorization information
results.model_answer: The network provides the UE with **UAV authorization information** during the UAV identification, authentication, and authorization procedure.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Serving PLMN rate control IE according to clause 8.3.6.16?
results.reference: when the network wishes to indicate the maximum number of uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages including User data container IEs the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Serving PLMN rate control IE is to indicate the maximum number of uplink NAS transport messages that can be sent by the UE in a given time unit in the serving PLMN.”

results.question: What shall the UE do with the tracking area updating attempt counter if a new PLMN is selected?
results.reference: reset the tracking area updating attempt counter
results.model_answer: If a new PLMN is selected, **the UE shall reset the tracking area updating attempt counter.**

results.question: What APN condition must be met for including the Protocol configuration options IE when the UE supports local IP address in TFT filter?
results.reference: the requested APN is not for UAS services
results.model_answer: If the UE supports local IP address in TFT filter, it shall include the Protocol configuration options IE **when the APN is not an emergency APN**.

results.question: When shall the UE include the IMEISV information element?
results.reference: if the IMEISV was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **IMEISV** information element in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message **if the IMEISV request information element in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message indicates that the IMEISV shall be included**.

results.question: In which message must the IMEISV be requested for the UE to include it?
results.reference: within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer:
The IMEISV must be requested in the **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** message.

If requested, the UE includes the IMEISV in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message.

results.question: In NB-S1 mode, what EMM cause value is set when a tracking area update request is rejected due to operator determined barring?
results.reference: #22 "congestion"
results.model_answer: The MME shall set the EMM cause value to **#8 “operator determined barring.”**

results.question: What triggers the UE to include the IMEISV information element?
results.reference: if the IMEISV was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer:
The UE includes the **IMEISV information element in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message** when it receives a **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** containing an **IMEISV request IE** requesting the IMEISV.

> “If the UE receives a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message containing an IMEISV request IE, the UE shall include the IMEISV IE in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.”

results.question: Which 3GPP technical specification is referenced in clause 6.5.3.4?
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 23.401 is referenced in clause 6.5.3.4.

results.question: When shall the MME retransmit a DETACH ACCEPT message if it was not delivered due to an intra MME handover?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover
results.model_answer: “If the DETACH ACCEPT message is not delivered to the UE due to an intra MME handover, the MME shall retransmit the DETACH ACCEPT message after completion of the handover procedure.”

results.question: Under what conditions shall the Protocol configuration options IE be included when the UE wishes to transmit security protected data during attach?
results.reference: the UE is in WB-S1 mode
results.model_answer:
The UE shall include the **Protocol configuration options (PCO) IE** in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST (carried in the ESM message container of the ATTACH REQUEST) **if it wants to request protocol configuration options from the network for the PDN connection**.

In particular, it is included when the UE needs to exchange configuration parameters—e.g. IP/DNS-related options or authentication-related protocol options—needed for the data connection, including security-protected data use.

results.question: What two procedures can cause the UE to enter the PLMN-SEARCH substate as a result of a network rejection?
results.reference: a tracking area update rejected by the network or as a result of a service request rejected by the network
results.model_answer:
The two procedures are:

- **Attach procedure** — on receipt of an **ATTACH REJECT** (for applicable EMM causes).
- **Tracking area updating procedure** — on receipt of a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT** (for applicable EMM causes).

These rejections can cause the UE to enter **EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH**.

results.question: What action shall the MME take if a DETACH ACCEPT message was not delivered due to a handover failure but the S1 signalling connection still exists?
results.reference: the MME shall retransmit the DETACH ACCEPT message
results.model_answer: If the DETACH ACCEPT message was not delivered due to a handover failure but the S1 signalling connection still exists, **the MME shall retransmit the DETACH ACCEPT message**.

results.question: For restrictions applicable after handover or inter-system handover to S1 mode, which clause should be consulted?
results.reference: clause 5.5.3.2.3
results.model_answer: For such restrictions, consult **clause 5.5.2.1, “General”** (Tracking area updating procedure).

results.question: When shall the Serving PLMN rate control IE be included?
results.reference: when the network wishes to indicate the maximum number of uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages including User data container IEs the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval
