results.model_answer: The MME shall include the **Serving PLMN rate control** IE in an **ATTACH ACCEPT** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message when the UE has indicated support for **Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization** and the MME has a Serving PLMN rate-control value to provide to the UE.

results.question: What shall the MME send to the UE and what timer shall it start if the attach request is accepted?
results.reference: send an ATTACH ACCEPT message to the UE and start timer T3450
results.model_answer: “If the attach request is accepted, the MME shall send an **ATTACH ACCEPT** message to the UE and shall start timer **T3450**.”

results.question: Under what condition is the UE required to include the IMEISV IE?
results.reference: if the IMEISV was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer:
The UE is required to include the IMEISV IE in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message **when the SECURITY MODE COMMAND includes the IMEISV request IE requesting the IMEISV**.

In other words: if the network requests the IMEISV in the Security Mode Command, the UE shall provide it in Security Mode Complete.

results.question: When the UE moves from EMM-IDLE mode to EMM-CONNECTED mode, until the first handover, which PLMN identity shall the UE use?
results.reference: the UE shall use the PLMN identity of the selected PLMN
results.model_answer: “When the UE changes from EMM-IDLE mode to EMM-CONNECTED mode, the UE shall use the PLMN identity of the selected PLMN until the first handover.”

results.question: For which type of connection's traffic does the WLAN offload indication IE apply?
results.reference: the associated PDN connection
results.model_answer: The WLAN offload indication IE applies to **traffic associated with a PDN connection**.

results.question: Which entity must hold a valid last visited registered TAI for the IE to be included?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: “The UE shall include the last visited registered TAI IE if the UE has a valid last visited registered TAI.”

results.question: Upon receipt of which messages shall the RAND and RES values stored in the ME be deleted?
results.reference: SECURITY MODE COMMAND, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT, TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT, or AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
results.model_answer:
The ME shall delete any stored RAND and RES values upon receipt of:

- an **AUTHENTICATION REJECT** message; or
- a **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** message.

results.question: What does the network indicate via the WLAN offload indication IE regarding the UE?
results.reference: if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s)
results.model_answer: The network indicates **whether the UE is allowed to offload traffic to WLAN** (i.e. whether WLAN offload is permitted for the UE).

results.question: What does the UE do if the T3448 value IE is present in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and the value indicates the timer is zero or deactivated?
results.reference: the UE shall consider this case as an abnormal case and proceed as if the T3448 value IE is not present
results.model_answer: If the T3448 value IE is present and indicates that the timer value is zero or deactivated, **the UE shall stop timer T3448 if it is running**.

results.question: Which IE's inclusion allows the UE to include the T3412 extended value IE?
results.reference: the T3324 value IE
results.model_answer: The **UE network capability IE**—specifically the **“extended periodic timers”** capability indication—allows use of the **T3412 extended value IE**.

results.question: What shall the network do if an integrity-protected ATTACH REQUEST message is received from the UE and successfully integrity checked while a paging procedure is ongoing?
results.reference: the network shall abort the paging procedure
results.model_answer: The network **shall stop the paging procedure and proceed with the attach procedure**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the ATTACH REQUEST message?
results.reference: to perform an attach procedure
results.model_answer: “The ATTACH REQUEST message is sent by the UE to the MME to initiate the attach procedure.”

results.question: What must be active for the MME to potentially include the T3346 value information element?
results.reference: the NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
results.model_answer: The MME may include the T3346 value information element **if congestion control is active**.

results.question: What action shall the UE take upon receiving an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with an EPS bearer identity matching an already activated dedicated EPS bearer context?
results.reference: the UE shall locally deactivate the existing dedicated EPS bearer context and proceed with the requested default EPS bearer context activation
results.model_answer: The UE **shall locally deactivate the dedicated EPS bearer context** and then **process the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message**.

results.question: What procedures may the MME initiate during the tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: the EMM authentication and security mode control procedures
results.model_answer: “The MME may initiate the authentication procedure and the security mode control procedure during the tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: What must be valid for the Last visited registered TAI IE to be included?
results.reference: a valid last visited registered TAI
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the Last visited registered TAI IE **if it has a valid last visited registered TAI**.

results.question: Under what condition can the MME include the T3346 value information element?
results.reference: when the NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
results.model_answer:
The MME may include the **T3346 value** information element **when the EMM cause value is #22 “congestion”**.

> “If the EMM cause value is #22 ‘congestion’, the MME may include a T3346 value information element …”

results.question: Which specific messages does the Serving PLMN rate control IE limit?
results.reference: uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages including User data container IEs
results.model_answer: The **Serving PLMN rate control IE** limits the rate of **UE-initiated PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST messages** sent to the network (i.e. PDN connectivity requests in the serving PLMN).

results.question: What type of paging indication may be ignored by a UE that requested SMS only?
results.reference: the paging indication with the CN domain indicator set to "CS"
results.model_answer: A UE that requested **“SMS only”** may ignore **paging indications other than paging indications for SMS**.

results.question: What substate shall the UE enter after power on if no USIM is present?
results.reference: NO-IMSI
results.model_answer: If no USIM is present after power on, the UE shall enter the **EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI** substate.

results.question: Which IE shall the UE include when it wants to send an ESM message to the network?
results.reference: ESM message container
results.model_answer:
The UE shall include the **ESM message container IE**.

> “The UE shall include an ESM message container IE when it wants to send an ESM message to the network.”

results.question: What shall the network not apply during an attach procedure for emergency bearer services?
results.reference: subscribed APN based congestion control
results.model_answer: During an attach procedure for emergency bearer services, **the network shall not apply access control**.

results.question: What substate shall the UE enter after power on if a suitable cell has been found and the PLMN or tracking area is not in the forbidden list?
results.reference: NORMAL-SERVICE
results.model_answer:
The UE shall enter the **EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE** substate.

> “If the UE is switched on, a suitable cell is found and the PLMN or tracking area is not in the forbidden PLMN list or forbidden tracking area list, the UE shall enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.”

results.question: For what type of bearer services may the UE initiate attach even if timer T3346 is running?
results.reference: emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: “The UE shall not initiate the attach procedure if timer T3346 is running, unless the UE is attaching for emergency bearer services.”

results.question: What substate shall a UE configured for eCall only mode enter after power on?
results.reference: eCALL-INACTIVE
results.model_answer: A UE configured for eCall only mode shall enter the **EMM-DEREGISTERED.ECALL-INACTIVE** substate after power on.

results.question: When timer T3346 is running, what procedure may the UE initiate for emergency bearer services?
results.reference: The UE may initiate attach for emergency bearer services even if timer T3346 is running
results.model_answer: While timer T3346 is running, the UE may initiate **an attach procedure for emergency bearer services**.

results.question: While in the EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state, what is the UE waiting for?
results.reference: waiting for a response from the MME
results.model_answer: “The UE has initiated the detach procedure and is waiting for a DETACH ACCEPT message from the network.”

results.question: Which EPS bearer contexts are deactivated when a duplicate default EPS bearer context activation request is received for an already activated default bearer?
results.reference: the existing default EPS bearer context and all the associated dedicated EPS bearer contexts, if any
results.model_answer: The UE deactivates **the existing default EPS bearer context and all dedicated EPS bearer contexts associated with that default bearer** — i.e. **all EPS bearer contexts associated with the same PDN connection**.

results.question: Which two procedures allow a UE to request SMS only, enabling it to ignore certain CS domain messages?
results.reference: the combined attach procedure or combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer:
The two procedures are:

- **The attach procedure** (via the **ATTACH REQUEST** message); and  
- **The tracking area updating procedure** (via the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message).

In these procedures, the UE can include the **“SMS only”** indication (for a combined EPS/IMSI attach or combined TA/LA update), allowing it to disregard CS-domain notifications not relevant to SMS, e.g. CS fallback service notifications for voice.

results.question: What shall the UE do upon receiving ATTACH ACCEPT with EMM cause #2?
results.reference: shall stop T3410 if still running and shall reset the tracking area updating attempt counter. The UE shall set the update status to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and shall delete any TMSI, LAI
results.model_answer: If the `ATTACH ACCEPT` includes an EMM cause IE with value **#2 “IMSI unknown in HSS”**, the UE shall **delete any stored GUTI and enter the state `EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI`**.

results.question: During which state may the MME include the T3346 value IE?
results.reference: when the NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
results.model_answer: The MME may include the **T3346 value IE during the EMM-REGISTERED state** (e.g., in a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT** message).

results.question: What action shall the network take upon the first expiry of timer T3460 during the security mode control procedure?
results.reference: retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and shall reset and start timer T3460
results.model_answer: Upon the first expiry of timer T3460, the network shall **retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and restart timer T3460**.

results.question: For which type of UE may the MME be configured to skip authentication and proceed directly to security mode control during tracking area updating?
results.reference: for a UE that has only a PDN connection for emergency bearer services or for RLOS
results.model_answer: The MME may be configured to skip authentication and proceed directly to security mode control **for a UE attached for emergency bearer services**.

results.question: What shall the UE do if it receives an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with an EPS bearer identity identical to an already activated default EPS bearer context?
results.reference: the UE shall locally deactivate the existing default EPS bearer context and all the associated dedicated EPS bearer contexts, if any, and proceed with the requested default EPS bearer context activation
results.model_answer: The UE shall send an **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message with ESM cause **#45 “EPS bearer context without TFT already activated.”**

results.question: What shall the UE do to avoid a synchronisation failure when receiving an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message?
results.reference: the UE shall store the received RAND together with the RES returned from the USIM in the volatile memory of the ME
results.model_answer:
To avoid a synchronization failure, the UE shall detect retransmissions of an authentication challenge:

> “If the RAND parameter is identical to the RAND parameter received in an earlier AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message, the UE shall retransmit the previously sent AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message or AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message, as applicable, and shall not process the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message again.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the ESM message container IE?
results.reference: if it wants to send an ESM message to the network
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the ESM message container IE **if it has an uplink ESM message pending for transmission to the network**.

results.question: What does the network request with the Back-off timer value IE regarding procedure retry?
results.reference: a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed
results.model_answer: “The network requests the UE to back off for the specified time period before retrying the procedure.”

results.question: What procedure triggers the inclusion of the EMM cause IE when successful only for EPS services?
results.reference: the combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: “The EMM cause IE shall be included in the ATTACH ACCEPT message if the attach procedure was initiated by a combined EPS/IMSI attach and the attach was successful for EPS services only.”

results.question: What shall the UE do regarding attach or combined attach procedure on the expiry of timer T3346 if timer T3346 is running?
results.reference: the UE shall initiate an attach or combined attach procedure on the expiry of timer T3346
results.model_answer: On expiry of timer T3346, the UE **shall initiate an attach or combined attach procedure if one is required**.

results.question: What does the UE do if the service request procedure is triggered by a paging response and NAS signalling connection establishment is rejected?
results.reference: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies normal cell reselection process.
results.model_answer: If the service request procedure is triggered by a paging response and NAS signalling connection establishment is rejected, **the UE shall abort the service request procedure and wait for a further paging request.**

results.question: When shall the MME not initiate an EMM authentication procedure before completion of the tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference:
if the following conditions apply
a) the UE initiated the tracking area updating procedure after handover or inter-system handover to S1 mode
b) the target cell is a shared network cell; and
- the UE has provided its GUTI in the Old GUTI IE or the Additional GUTI IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and the PLMN identity included in the GUTI is different from the selected PLMN identity of the target cell; or
- the UE has mapped the P-TMSI and RAI into the Old GUTI IE and not included an Additional GUTI IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and the PLMN identity included in the RAI is different from the selected PLMN identity of the target cell
results.model_answer: The MME shall not initiate an EMM authentication procedure before completion of the tracking area updating procedure **if the EPS update type IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message indicates “periodic updating.”**

results.question: What is the specific name of the EMM state entered after requesting EMM context release?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
results.model_answer:
The UE enters the **EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH** state.

> “The UE shall enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH state after requesting EMM context release.”

results.question: Which EMM cause value triggers the inclusion of the T3442 value IE by the MME?
results.reference: #39 "CS service temporarily not available"
results.model_answer:
EMM cause value **#39 — “CS service temporarily not available”**.

> “If the EMM cause value is #39 ‘CS service temporarily not available’, the MME shall include the T3442 value IE in the SERVICE REJECT message.”

results.question: Under what condition is the EMM cause IE included in a combined tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: if the combined tracking area updating procedure was successful for EPS services only
results.model_answer: The EMM cause IE is included **if the tracking area updating procedure is accepted, but the combined tracking area updating procedure is not accepted**.

results.question: What happens on the fifth expiry of timer T3460 during the security mode control procedure?
results.reference: the procedure shall be aborted
results.model_answer: “On the fifth expiry of timer T3460, the MME shall abort the security mode control procedure and release the NAS signalling connection.”

results.question: To whom is the GUTI assigned and the TAI list provided by the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: The GUTI is assigned **to the UE**, and the TAI list is provided **to the UE** by the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

results.question: Under what condition shall the WLAN offload indication IE be included in the message?
results.reference: when the network wishes to indicate if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s)
results.model_answer: The WLAN offload indication IE shall be included **if WLAN offload is allowed for the PDN connection**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Remote UE report message?
results.reference: to report the remote UE's IP address and port number to the network
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the REMOTE UE REPORT message is to report to the network the presence or absence of remote UEs connected to a ProSe UE-to-Network Relay.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
results.reference: to assign a GUTI and provide the UE with a TAI list
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the ATTACH ACCEPT message is to indicate to the UE that the attach has been accepted by the EPS network.”

results.question: What are the two requirements that must be satisfied for the network to include the Re-attempt indicator IE?
results.reference: it includes the Back-off timer value IE and the ESM cause value is not #26 "insufficient resources"
results.model_answer:
The network shall include the Re-attempt indicator IE only when both of the following apply:

1. The EMM cause in the ATTACH REJECT is **#19 “ESM failure”**; and  
2. The ATTACH REJECT includes an **ESM message container IE**.

results.question: For which services must the combined tracking area updating procedure be successful to include the EMM cause IE?
results.reference: for EPS services only
results.model_answer: The EMM cause IE is included **when the combined tracking area updating procedure is successful for EPS services but unsuccessful for non-EPS services**.

results.question: When does the MME start serving PLMN rate control for a PDN connection?
results.reference: when the first NAS message with user data over control plane is received over the PDN connection
results.model_answer: The MME starts serving PLMN rate control for a PDN connection **when the PDN connection is established**.

results.question: Who may initiate the EMM common procedures?
results.reference: The network
results.model_answer: “The EMM common procedures can be initiated by the UE or the network.”

results.question: What is the purpose of serving PLMN rate control?
results.reference: to protect its MME and the signalling radio bearers in the E-UTRAN from load generated by NAS messages with user data over control plane
results.model_answer: Serving PLMN rate control is used to **limit the rate at which the UE sends uplink NAS signalling messages to the serving PLMN**. It indicates the maximum permitted number of such messages within the defined time period.

results.question: On what does the network's initiation of EMM common procedures depend?
results.reference: depending on the received information such as IMSI, GUTI and KSI
results.model_answer: “The initiation of EMM common procedures by the network depends on the EMM state of the UE and on the availability of a NAS signalling connection.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the Last visited registered TAI IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE holds a valid last visited registered TAI
results.model_answer: “The UE shall include the Last visited registered TAI IE if the UE has a valid last visited registered TAI.”

results.question: For which specific EMM cause must the MME include the T3442 value IE?
results.reference: #39 "CS service temporarily not available"
results.model_answer:
The MME must include the **T3442 value IE** when the EMM cause is:

> **#15 “No suitable cells in tracking area”**.

results.question: What specific messages may a UE that requested SMS only in combined procedures ignore?
results.reference: the CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message or the paging indication with the CN domain indicator set to "CS"
results.model_answer:
A UE that requested **SMS-only service** in a combined procedure may ignore the **ESM message container** received in:

- an **ATTACH ACCEPT** message, for a combined attach procedure; or
- a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message, for a combined tracking area updating procedure.

results.question: During which procedures can the UUAA-SM procedure be used for UAV flight authorization?
results.reference: during the PDN connectivity procedure or during the bearer resource modification procedure
results.model_answer: The UUAA-SM procedure can be used during the **PDN connectivity procedure** and the **ESM information procedure** (for the PDN connection used for UAS services).

results.question: What does the MME do when the EMM cause is #39?
results.reference: shall include this IE
results.model_answer:
The MME rejects the UE’s service request by sending a **SERVICE REJECT** message with EMM cause **#39, “CS service temporarily not available.”**

This is used when the MME cannot provide CS fallback/CS service for the request.

results.question: Under what condition can the UE provide flight authorization information via protocol configuration options?
results.reference: if the authorization information is already available in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE can provide flight authorization information in the Protocol Configuration Options (PCO) **if it has flight authorization information available** (e.g. obtained from the UAS service supplier) when establishing the PDN connection.

results.question: What shall the network do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message in response to a CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message?
results.reference: the network shall progress the tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: The network shall treat the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST as a response to the CS service notification, perform the tracking area updating procedure, and, if the procedure succeeds, send an **SGsAP-SERVICE-REQUEST** to the MSC for the pending mobile-terminating CS service (i.e. MT CS fallback).

results.question: Under what condition shall the MME include the T3442 value IE?
results.reference: when the EMM cause value is #39 "CS service temporarily not available"
results.model_answer: The MME shall include the **T3442 value IE** in the **DETACH REQUEST** message **when the detach type is set to “re-attach required.”**

results.question: To which specific clause is the operation of the WLAN offload indication IE specified?
results.reference: clause 9.9.4.18
results.model_answer: The operation of the WLAN offload indication IE is specified in **clause 5.10.2, “PDN connectivity procedure.”**

results.question: What are examples of the received information that influences EMM common procedure initiation?
results.reference: IMSI, GUTI and KSI

results.question: Under what condition shall a network include the transaction identifier IE?
results.reference: supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **transaction identifier IE** in a **DOWNLINK NAS TRANSPORT** message **if it has received a transaction identifier IE in the corresponding UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT message**.

results.question: What UE capabilities trigger the requirement for the network to include the transaction identifier IE?
results.reference: the UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both
results.model_answer:
The network shall include the **Transaction identifier IE** when the UE has indicated support for both:

- **control plane CIoT EPS optimization**; and  
- **S1-U data transfer**  

in the **UE network capability** IE.

results.question: What is the state of the UE when no PDU session exists?
results.reference: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: The UE is in the **PDU SESSION INACTIVE** state when no PDU session exists.

results.question: What type of registration should a UE indicate in the 5GS registration type IE when initiating registration for emergency services?
results.reference: "emergency registration"
results.model_answer: The UE shall indicate **“emergency registration”** in the **5GS registration type** IE.

results.question: What does the AUSF generate from the EMSK when it acts as the EAP-AKA' server?
results.reference: the KAUSF from the EMSK, and the KSEAF from the KAUSF
results.model_answer: The AUSF generates the **\(K_{\text{AUSF}}\)** key from the EMSK when it acts as the EAP-AKA' server.

results.question: What does the receiver update after successful integrity protection validation?
results.reference: its corresponding locally stored NAS COUNT with the value of the estimated NAS COUNT for this NAS message
results.model_answer: After successful integrity protection validation, the receiver updates the **NAS COUNT** value.

results.question: What specific need must the network have to include the UE radio capability ID IE?
results.reference: needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE
results.model_answer: The network shall include the UE radio capability ID IE **if it needs to retrieve the UE radio capability information from the UE**.

results.question: Which technical specification defines the PDU session management state when no session is present?
results.model_answer: **PDU SESSION INACTIVE** — “This state is entered when no PDU session exists for the PDU session ID.”

results.question: What is the SMF responsible for in relation to the UE?
results.reference: The SMF is responsible for the session management functions to provide the PDU connectivity service to the UE via the 5GSM signalling between UE and SMF.
results.model_answer: “The SMF is responsible for handling PDU sessions of a UE.”

results.question: What does a UE not operating as an IAB-node first perform when it needs to access the 5GS?
results.reference: first performs access control checks to determine if the access is allowed
results.model_answer: “A UE not operating as an IAB-node shall first perform a registration procedure to gain access to the 5GS.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the Rejected NSSAI IE according to clause 8.2.14.4?
results.reference: to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were rejected by the network
results.model_answer: “The Rejected NSSAI IE indicates the S-NSSAIs that are rejected by the network and the rejection cause for each rejected S-NSSAI.”

results.question: In the second scenario for the Release assistance indication, what is expected regarding uplink data transmission after the uplink data transmission?
results.reference: no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected
results.model_answer: In the second scenario, **the UE does not expect any further uplink data transmission after the uplink data transmission**.

results.question: What is an example of the single downlink data transmission mentioned in the Release assistance indication?
results.reference: acknowledgement or response to uplink data
results.model_answer: An example is **the delivery of a mobile terminated (MT) SMS message**.

results.question: What does the network do upon receipt of an AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message?
results.reference: stops the timer T3560 and checks the correctness of RES*
results.model_answer:
Upon receipt of an **AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE** message, the network checks the received RES/RES* value against the expected value.

> “If the RES parameter is valid, the network shall initiate the NAS security mode control procedure.”

If the RES/RES* is not valid, the network rejects the authentication, e.g. by sending an **AUTHENTICATION REJECT** message.

results.question: How are session management messages between UE and SMF transferred?
results.reference: The session management messages between UE and SMF are transferred via AMF as specified in subclause8.3
results.model_answer: Session management messages between the UE and the SMF are transferred using NAS transport messages (UL NAS TRANSPORT and DL NAS TRANSPORT), transparently via the AMF.

results.question: What feature must both the UE and the network support for the inclusion of the UE radio capability ID IE?
results.reference: support RACS
results.model_answer:
Both the UE and the network must support the **UE radio capability ID feature**.

> “The UE radio capability ID IE shall be included if the UE and the network support the UE radio capability ID feature.”

results.question: What does the sender use as input to the integrity protection algorithm?
results.reference: its locally stored NAS COUNT
results.model_answer: “The sender shall use the 5G NAS COUNT, bearer identity, direction of transmission and the NAS message as input to the integrity protection algorithm.”

results.question: What capability does a UE have regarding PDU sessions and access networks?
results.reference: A UE may establish multiple PDU sessions, to the same data network or to different data networks, via 3GPP and via and Non-3GPP access networks at the same time
results.model_answer: A UE can establish PDU sessions via both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access, including simultaneously when connected to both access networks.

results.question: What does the UE inform the network about when it includes the Release assistance indication IE?
results.reference: whether no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected; or only a single downlink data transmission (e.g. acknowledgement or response to uplink data) and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected
results.model_answer: The UE informs the network **whether it expects to send or receive data in the near future**.

results.question: In the first scenario described for the Release assistance indication, what type of data transmission is expected?
results.reference: no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected
results.model_answer: In the first scenario, the UE expects **no further uplink or downlink data transmission**.

results.question: What must the UE not be in for the UE radio capability ID IE to be included?
results.reference: not in NB-N1 mode
results.model_answer: The UE radio capability ID IE can be included only if the UE is **not in emergency registration**.

results.question: Under what condition may the SMF include the IP header compression configuration IE?
results.reference: the network accepts an IP PDU session type
results.model_answer: The SMF may include the **IP header compression configuration IE** only if the UE included the IP header compression configuration IE in the **PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST** message.

results.question: What message is sent if the AT_RESULT_IND attribute was included in the request but is not included in the corresponding response?
results.reference: an EAP-success message
results.model_answer: If `AT_RESULT_IND` was included in the EAP-Request/AKA'-Challenge but not in the corresponding EAP-Response/AKA'-Challenge, **an EAP-Failure message is sent**.

results.question: What shall the AMF do with any NAS signalling message that has not successfully passed integrity check once secure exchange is established?
results.reference: the NAS in the AMF shall discard that message
results.model_answer: The AMF **shall discard any NAS signalling message that has not successfully passed the integrity check** once secure exchange is established.

results.question: What must a UE do if it stops fulfilling the condition to be considered a MUSIM UE and has negotiated support of MUSIM features?
results.reference: the UE shall initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update to indicate that all the MUSIM features are not supported (except for the paging timing collision control)
results.model_answer: If a UE stops fulfilling the condition to be considered a MUSIM UE after having negotiated MUSIM feature support, it **shall initiate the deregistration procedure**.

results.question: Which subclause and table does a UE operating in SNPN access mode use to determine the applicable access category?
results.reference: subclause4.5.2A and the rules and actions defined in table4.5.2A.2
results.model_answer: A UE operating in SNPN access mode determines the applicable access category according to **subclause 5.3.15.2.2**, using **Table 5.3.15.2.2-1**.

results.question: Under what condition may the UE radio capability ID IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE
results.model_answer: The UE radio capability ID IE may be included **if the UE has a valid UE radio capability ID and its radio capability has not changed**.

results.question: What shall the UE set the PLMN-specific N1 mode attempt counters to if a REGISTRATION REJECT message has been successfully integrity checked?
results.reference: the UE implementation-specific maximum value
results.model_answer: The UE shall **set the PLMN-specific N1 mode attempt counters to zero**.

results.question: What does the UE provide to the network to indicate which network slice(s) the UE wishes to register?
results.reference: network slicing information
results.model_answer: The UE provides the **Requested NSSAI** in the **REGISTRATION REQUEST** message, indicating the network slice(s) (S-NSSAI(s)) with which the UE wishes to register.

results.question: What does the network provide to the UE to indicate which network slice(s) the UE is allowed to use?
results.reference: network slicing information
results.model_answer:
The network provides the UE with the **Allowed NSSAI**.

> “The Allowed NSSAI is the NSSAI that the UE is allowed to use in the current Registration Area.”

results.question: Which NAS message can be processed by the AMF without integrity protection if the requested identification parameter is SUCI?
results.reference: IDENTITY RESPONSE (if requested identification parameter is SUCI)
results.model_answer:
The **IDENTITY RESPONSE** message can be processed by the AMF without integrity protection when the requested identification parameter is **SUCI**.

> “The AMF shall process an IDENTITY RESPONSE message without integrity protection if the requested identification parameter is SUCI.”

results.question: In the case where the 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" is received, what may the core network do?
results.reference: renegotiate with the UDM/AUSF and provide the UE with new authentication parameters
results.model_answer: Upon receiving 5GMM cause #21, **“synch failure”**, the core network may **initiate a new authentication procedure**, using the Authentication failure parameter (AUTS) supplied by the UE to re-synchronize the authentication sequence number.

results.question: What shall the UE create to initiate the UE-requested PDU session release procedure?
results.reference: a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The UE shall create a **PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST** message to initiate the UE-requested PDU session release procedure.

results.question: What optimization must be selected for the SMF to include the IP header compression configuration IE?
results.reference: control plane CIoT 5GS optimization is selected
results.model_answer: “The SMF shall include the IP header compression configuration IE if the SMF has selected the User Plane CIoT 5GS optimization for the PDU session.”

results.question: For what type of data does the Serving PLMN rate control IE specify a maximum?
results.reference: uplink control plane user data
results.model_answer: “The Serving PLMN rate control IE is used to indicate the maximum number of uplink NAS data PDUs that the UE is allowed to send in a time unit.”

results.question: For a PDU session of unstructured PDU session type, what QFI does the UE associate with an UL user data packet?
results.reference: the QFI of the default QoS rule associated with the PDU session
results.model_answer: For a PDU session of unstructured PDU session type, **the UE associates the QFI of the default QoS rule with an UL user data packet**.

results.question: What 5GSM cause value indicates 'Semantic errors in packet filter(s)'?
results.model_answer: 5GSM cause value **44** indicates **“Semantic errors in packet filter(s)”**.

results.question: For which PDU session types does the UE attempt to associate an UL user data packet with a QFI by evaluating QoS rules in order of precedence?
results.reference: For PDU session of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6 or Ethernet PDU session type
results.model_answer:
For **IP PDU sessions** and **Ethernet PDU sessions**.

> “For an IP PDU session or an Ethernet PDU session, the UE shall attempt to associate an UL user data packet with a QoS flow by evaluating the QoS rules in order of precedence.”

results.question: What is performed by the lower layers according to the note in this clause?
results.reference: Marking of the UL user data packet with the QFI
results.model_answer: Please provide the clause number or the note text/extract. The question does not identify which TS 24.501 clause is being referenced, so the lower-layer function cannot be determined unambiguously.

results.question: Under what condition does the network indicate support for the paging restriction feature?
results.reference: The network only indicates the support of the paging restriction together with the support of either N1 NAS signalling connection release or the reject paging request
results.model_answer:
The network indicates support for the paging restriction feature **if the UE has indicated support for paging restriction in the UE 5GMM capability IE and the network supports the feature**.

It does so in the **5GS network feature support IE** (e.g. in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message).

results.question: To which subclause does clause 8.2.14.4 refer for specifications on rejection due to revocation?
results.reference: subclause4.6.2.4
results.model_answer: Clause 8.2.14.4 refers to **subclause 8.2.14.5** for specifications on rejection due to revocation.

results.question: To what entity is a new disaster roaming wait range assigned by the IE?
results.reference: to the UE
results.model_answer: “The disaster roaming wait range IE is used to assign a new disaster roaming wait range to the UE.”

results.question: What action shall the AMF take if a NAS signalling message is received without integrity protection after secure exchange has been established?
results.reference: the NAS shall discard this message
results.model_answer: The AMF **shall discard the NAS signalling message** if it is received without integrity protection after a secure exchange has been established.

results.question: When does a MUSIM UE indicate support for the paging restriction feature?
results.reference: If the UE has indicated support of the N1 NAS signalling connection release or the reject paging request or both and the UE supports the paging restriction, the UE indicates support of the paging restriction
results.model_answer:
A MUSIM UE indicates support for the paging restriction feature **in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message**, by indicating it in the **5GMM capability IE**:

> “A MUSIM UE supporting paging restriction shall indicate its support for paging restriction in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.”

results.question: Which entity receives the new disaster return wait range from the IE in clause 8.2.9.8?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer:
The **UE** receives the new disaster return wait range.

> “The Disaster return wait range IE is used to indicate to the UE a new disaster return wait range.”

results.question: What procedure shall the UE initiate on the expiry of timer T3511?
results.reference: shall initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
results.model_answer: On expiry of timer **T3511**, the UE **shall initiate the registration procedure**.

results.question: When the UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED over 3GPP access, what shall it not do regarding non-3GPP access?
results.reference: shall not initiate registration over non-3GPP access
results.model_answer: When the UE is in **5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED** over 3GPP access, it **“shall not initiate a registration procedure over non-3GPP access.”**

results.question: When releasing a PDU session due to errors in QoS operations or packet filters, what shall the UE include in the PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message?
results.reference: the 5GSM cause IE
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **5GSM cause IE** in the **PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST** message, set to the appropriate 5GSM cause value indicating the QoS-operation or packet-filter error.

results.question: What does not apply for non-3GPP access regarding serving PLMN rate control?
results.reference: Serving PLMN rate control does not apply for non-3GPP access
results.model_answer: “The serving PLMN rate control shall not apply to non-3GPP access.”

results.question: Which octets are included in the integrity protection for a SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE?
results.reference: octet 7 to n, i.e. the Sequence number IE and the NAS message IE
results.model_answer:
Integrity protection covers **all octets from and including the sequence number octet up to and including the last octet of the NAS message**.

In a SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE, this means:

- **Octet 7**: Sequence number; and  
- **Octet 8 onwards**: the encapsulated 5GS NAS message (plain or ciphered, as applicable).

The outer extended protocol discriminator, security header type, and the MAC field itself (octets 1–6) are not included in the MAC calculation.

results.question: For a UE in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication, what does the NAS provide to lower layers to enable access barring checks for access attempts identified by lower layers?
results.reference: the UE provides the applicable access identities to lower layers
results.model_answer:
NAS provides the lower layers with:

- the UE’s **access identities**; and  
- the **access category applicable to the access attempt** identified by the lower layers,

so that the lower layers can perform the applicable access-barring check.

results.question: What is the purpose of the PDU session establishment procedure?
results.reference: to establish a new PDU session
results.model_answer: The PDU session establishment procedure is used by the UE to request the establishment of a PDU session.

results.question: What procedure must a UE start to request release of the 5GMM context?
results.reference: the de-registration procedure
results.model_answer: “The UE shall initiate the deregistration procedure to request release of the 5GMM context.”

results.question: What action does the Disaster roaming wait range IE perform regarding the wait range?
results.reference: assign a new disaster roaming wait range
results.model_answer: The **Disaster roaming wait range IE** indicates the range of time during which the UE shall wait before attempting a new registration for disaster roaming.

results.question: While in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state, what is the UE waiting for?
results.reference: a response from the network
results.model_answer: The UE is waiting for a **DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT** message from the network.

results.question: What does the PDU session release procedure accomplish?
results.reference: to release an existing PDU session
results.model_answer: “The PDU session release procedure is used to release a PDU session and all the resources associated with the PDU session.”

results.question: When can a procedure be re-initiated using a retransmission mechanism of the uplink message?
results.reference: When it is specified in the relevant procedure that it is up to the UE implementation to re-run the ongoing procedure that triggered that procedure
results.model_answer: A procedure can be re-initiated **when the timer associated with that procedure expires**, by retransmitting the uplink NAS message that initiated the procedure (subject to the procedure-specific retransmission rules and maximum retransmission count).

results.question: What does the UE do if all QoS rules are evaluated and the UL user data packet is not associated with a QFI?
results.reference: the UE shall discard the UL user data packet
results.model_answer: “If all QoS rules have been evaluated and the UL user data packet is not associated with a QFI, the UE shall assign the QFI of the default QoS rule to the UL user data packet.”

results.question: Is the network permitted to include the Back-off timer value IE when the 5GSM cause is #68 'not supported SSC mode'?
results.reference: not
results.model_answer: No. The network shall not include the Back-off timer value IE when the 5GSM cause is set to **#68 “not supported SSC mode”**.

results.question: What does the Rejected NSSAI IE inform the UE about?
results.reference: one or more S-NSSAIs that were previously sent to the UE in the allowed NSSAI or the pending NSSAI, but are now considered rejected by the network
results.model_answer: “The Rejected NSSAI IE provides the UE with information about the S-NSSAIs rejected by the network.”

results.question: What is the purpose of including the Disaster roaming wait range IE according to TS 24.501?
results.reference: to assign a new disaster roaming wait range to the UE
results.model_answer: The **Disaster roaming wait range IE** is used to indicate a range of time during which the UE shall wait before attempting to initiate a registration procedure for disaster roaming.

results.question: Which procedure shall the UE initiate according to conditions given in subclause 5.6.1?
results.reference: shall initiate the service request procedure
results.model_answer: The UE shall initiate the **UE-initiated deregistration procedure** (specified in subclause 5.6.2) when the applicable conditions in subclause 5.6.1 are met.

results.question: After requesting release of the 5GMM context, which state does the UE enter?
results.reference: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
results.model_answer: After requesting release of the 5GMM context, the UE enters the **5GMM-DEREGISTERED state**.

results.question: How many times shall the network retransmit the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message upon expiry of timer T3560?
results.reference: four times
results.model_answer: Upon expiry of timer T3560, the network shall retransmit the **AUTHENTICATION REQUEST** message and restart T3560. This procedure **shall be repeated four times**.

results.question: When the 5GSM cause is #39 'reactivation requested', may the network include the Back-off timer value IE?
results.reference: not
results.model_answer:
Yes. TS 24.501 states for 5GSM cause #39, *“reactivation requested”*:

> “The network may include the back-off timer value IE in the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message.”

results.question: Over what time interval is the maximum uplink control plane user data limit applied?
results.reference: per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: The maximum uplink control plane user data limit is applied **over a time interval of 6 minutes**.

results.question: What is maintained by the AMF and UE when the UE is registered with a PLMN over a non-3GPP access?
results.reference: registration state and state machine over non-3GPP access
results.model_answer:
When the UE is registered with a PLMN over non-3GPP access, **the UE and the AMF maintain a registration management state for the non-3GPP access**.

Registration management states are maintained independently per access type (3GPP access and non-3GPP access).

results.question: What is the direction of the DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
results.reference: UE to network
results.model_answer:
The **DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT** message can be sent in **both directions**:

> “The DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message is sent by the UE to the network or by the network to the UE to acknowledge the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.”

results.question: What shall the network do upon detection of lower layer failure before receiving the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message?
results.reference: abort the procedure
results.model_answer: “Upon detection of lower layer failure before receiving the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message, the network shall stop timer T3560 and abort the authentication procedure.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the Serving PLMN rate control IE?
results.reference: to indicate the maximum uplink control plane user data the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer:
“The purpose of the Serving PLMN rate control IE is to indicate the rate control parameters to be applied by the UE for the serving PLMN.”  

It is used to limit the UE’s NAS signalling/message rate toward the serving PLMN over the indicated time period.

results.question: What does the network request regarding the N1 NAS signalling connection when sending the Additional configuration indication IE?
results.reference: without the release of the N1 NAS signalling connection
results.model_answer: The network requests the UE **to establish an N1 NAS signalling connection for additional configuration**.

results.question: What information is included when retransmitting a previously failed uplink message?
results.reference: new sequence number and message authentication code information
results.model_answer: When retransmitting a previously failed uplink NAS message, the UE includes the **same information elements with the same contents as in the original transmission** (i.e. it retransmits the original NAS message information).

results.question: What is the purpose of including the Network daylight saving time IE according to TS 24.501?
results.reference: to assign new network daylight saving time to the UE
results.model_answer: “The Network daylight saving time IE is used to indicate the daylight saving time adjustment of the network.”

results.question: What three actions does the UAV identification, authentication, and authorization procedure perform?
results.reference: identified, authenticated, and authorized
results.model_answer:
The procedure performs the following three actions:

- **Identifies the UAV**;
- **Authenticates the UAV**; and
- **Authorizes the UAV to use UAV services in the 3GPP network**.

results.question: What is the entity that is identified, authenticated, and authorized by the network in this procedure?
results.reference: the UAV
results.model_answer: The entity identified, authenticated, and authorized by the network is the **UE (User Equipment)**.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the Disaster return wait range IE according to clause 8.2.9.8?
results.reference: to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Disaster return wait range IE is to indicate a range of time values from which the UE shall randomly select a value for the disaster return wait timer.”

results.question: To which entity does the network transmit data using the Extended protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: to the UE
results.model_answer: The network uses the Extended protocol configuration options IE to transmit data **to the UE**.

results.question: What does the UE do on the fifth expiry of timer T3581 during a PDU session modification procedure?
results.reference: the UE shall abort the procedure and shall release the allocated PTI
results.model_answer: Upon the fifth expiry of timer T3581, **the UE shall abort the PDU session modification procedure**.

results.question: In which operational modes does a MUSIM UE not indicate support for paging indication for voice services during registration?
results.reference: A MUSIM UE operating in NB-N1 mode or in WB-N1 mode CE mode B does not indicate the support for paging indication for voice services during the registration procedure towards the network
results.model_answer:
A MUSIM UE does **not** indicate support for paging indication for voice services when operating in **single registration mode**.

> “A MUSIM UE in single registration mode shall not indicate support for paging indication for voice services during registration.”

results.question: What type of security context does the type field of the ngKSI indicate when the AMF defines it for the newly derived K'AMF key?
results.reference: a mapped security context
results.model_answer: “The type of security context indicated by the type field of the ngKSI shall be native security context.”

results.question: What is the UE action upon receiving an indication of a routing failure along with a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST matching its sent PDU session ID?
results.reference: the UE shall stop timer T3581 and shall abort the procedure
results.model_answer: Upon receiving an indication of a routing failure, the UE shall **abort the PDU session modification procedure and enter the PDU SESSION ACTIVE state**.

results.question: What 5GSM cause value shall the SMF set when the PDU session release is triggered because user authentication or authorization failed?
results.reference: #29 "user authentication or authorization failed"
results.model_answer: The SMF shall set the 5GSM cause value to **#29 “user authentication or authorization failed”**.

results.question: What type of sessions must the MBS sessions be associated with for the Requested MBS container IE to be used?
results.reference: the PDU session
results.model_answer: The **Requested MBS container IE** is used when the UE requests **MBS sessions associated with a PDU session**.

results.question: What is the content of the EPS NAS message container when a UE performs mobility from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode?
results.reference: the complete integrity protected TRACKING AREA UPATE REQUEST message, using EPS security context
results.model_answer:
The **EPS NAS message container** shall contain a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message.

Specifically, for mobility from S1 mode to N1 mode while in 5GMM-IDLE, the UE includes the EPS NAS message container in the 5GS **REGISTRATION REQUEST**, containing the EPS **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST**.

results.question: What triggers the start of the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration area updating?
results.reference: When timer T3512 expires
results.model_answer:
The UE starts the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration area updating when it is in **5GMM-IDLE** and either:

- it has entered a **registration area that is not in its registered list of registration areas** (mobility update); or
- the **periodic registration update timer T3512 expires** (periodic update).

results.question: During which inter-system change is the EPS bearer context status IE included?
results.reference: during the inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
results.model_answer: The **EPS bearer context status IE** is included **during an inter-system change from EPS to 5GS**.

results.question: When is the UE-DS-TT residence time IE included in the message?
results.reference: if a) the UE supports transfer of port management information containers; and b) the UE-DS-TT residence time is available at the UE
results.model_answer: The **UE-DS-TT residence time IE** is included **when the UE is acting as a DS-TT (device-side TSN translator) for an Ethernet PDU session and has a UE-DS-TT residence-time value to report**.

results.question: When shall the Serving PLMN rate control IE be included?
results.reference: when the network needs to indicate the maximum uplink control plane user data the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: The AMF shall include the **Serving PLMN rate control** IE in the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message **when a serving PLMN rate-control value is applicable for the UE** (i.e. when it has been provided as part of the UE’s subscription information for the serving PLMN).

results.question: What type of data can the network transmit using the Extended protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events
results.model_answer: The network can use the **Extended protocol configuration options (EPCO) IE** to transmit **protocol configuration options**, i.e. configuration information/parameters relevant to specific protocols (including vendor-specific protocol configuration information), to the UE.

results.question: What is the direction of the SERVICE ACCEPT message?
results.reference: from the network to the UE
results.model_answer: The **SERVICE ACCEPT** message is sent **from the network to the UE**.

results.question: When is the registration attempt counter reset in substate 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE?
results.reference: the current TAI is changed
results.model_answer:
The UE resets the registration attempt counter **upon entering** either of these substates:

> “Upon entering the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION substate or the 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE substate, the UE shall reset the registration attempt counter.”

results.question: What shall the network NOT check when processing a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST for an emergency PDU session?
results.reference: service area restrictions or subscription restrictions
results.model_answer: For an emergency PDU session, **the network shall not check whether the UE is authorized to use the requested DNN**.

results.question: What does the DL NAS TRANSPORT message transport to the UE?
results.reference: message payload and associated information
results.model_answer: “The DL NAS TRANSPORT message is sent by the AMF to the UE to transport a payload container.”

results.question: Under what condition regarding the UE-DS-TT residence time must the IE be included?
results.reference: the UE-DS-TT residence time is available at the UE
results.model_answer: The IE shall be included **if the UE-DS-TT residence time has changed**.

results.question: In which state does the 5G-RG or W-AGF enter after receiving a trigger to enforce wireline access service area restrictions?
results.reference: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
results.model_answer: After receiving a trigger to enforce wireline access service area restrictions, the 5G-RG or W-AGF enters the **5GMM-DEREGISTERED state**.

results.question: To what shall the AMF set the S-NSSAI IE of the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message?
results.reference: the HPLMN S-NSSAI or the SNPN S-NSSAI to which the EAP-success or EAP-failure message is related
results.model_answer: “The AMF shall set the S-NSSAI IE to the S-NSSAI of the network slice for which the network slice-specific authentication is performed.”

results.question: What shall the SMF set the Authorized QoS rules IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message to?
results.reference: the authorized QoS rules of the PDU session
results.model_answer: The SMF shall set the **Authorized QoS rules IE** to contain the authorized QoS rules for the PDU session, including **at least the default QoS rule** (and, if applicable, additional QoS rules).

results.question: What shall the AMF and UE do if the inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode is not completed successfully?
results.reference: delete the new mapped 5G NAS security context
results.model_answer: If the inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode is not completed successfully, **the AMF and the UE shall enter the 5GMM-IDLE state**.

results.question: What action is performed with the disaster return wait range as per clause 8.2.9.8?
results.reference: assign a new disaster return wait range
results.model_answer: The UE **randomly selects a wait time from the disaster return wait range and starts timer T3346 with that value** (i.e. it waits that selected period before attempting disaster return).

results.question: When is the NSSAI inclusion mode information element included according to clause 8.2.7.23?
results.reference: if required by operatory policy
results.model_answer: The **NSSAI inclusion mode IE** is included in the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message **if the UE indicated support for NSSAI inclusion mode in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message**.

results.question: What shall the UE pass to the upper layers upon receipt of a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message?
results.reference: the EAP-success or EAP-failure message received in the EAP message IE; and the HPLMN S-NSSAI or the SNPN S-NSSAI in the S-NSSAI IE
results.model_answer: The UE shall pass **the EAP message and the S-NSSAI included in the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message** to the upper layers.

results.question: Between which entities does the NAS form the highest stratum of the control plane?
results.reference: between UE and AMF
results.model_answer: “The NAS protocol is the highest stratum of the control plane between the UE and the AMF.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the NSSAI inclusion mode IE be included?
results.reference: if required by operatory policy
results.model_answer: The AMF shall include the **NSSAI inclusion mode IE** in the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message **if the UE has indicated support for NSSAI inclusion mode in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message**.

results.question: What shall the AMF create to initiate the network slice-specific EAP result message transport procedure?
results.reference: a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message
results.model_answer: The AMF shall create a **DL NAS TRANSPORT message** containing the EAP result message, with the payload container type set to **EAP message**.

results.question: What is the direction of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
results.reference: network to UE
results.model_answer: Network to UE.

results.question: What 5GSM cause value shall the SMF include if it requests the relocation of an SSC mode 2 PDU session anchor with different PDU sessions?
results.reference: #39 "reactivation requested"
results.model_answer: The SMF shall include **5GSM cause value #113 — “PDU session anchor relocation with different PDU session not allowed.”**

results.question: What 5GMM cause value triggers the AMF to potentially include the Lower bound timer value IE?
results.reference: #78 "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location"
results.model_answer:
5GMM cause value **#22 “congestion”**.

> “If the 5GMM cause value is #22 (congestion), the AMF may include the Lower bound timer value IE …”

results.question: From where does the AMF take the value field for the ngKSI when defining it for the newly derived K'AMF key?
results.reference: from the eKSI of the KASME key
results.model_answer:
The AMF takes it **from the ngKSI IE in the received REGISTRATION REQUEST message**:

> “The AMF shall take the value field of the ngKSI from the ngKSI IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message when defining the ngKSI for the newly derived K′AMF key.”

results.question: Where are the elementary procedures for 5GS session management supplied?
results.reference: in clause6
results.model_answer: “The elementary procedures for 5GS session management are specified in clause 6.”

results.question: Which network function may include the Lower bound timer value IE?
results.reference: The AMF
results.model_answer: The **AMF** may include the **Lower bound timer value IE**.

results.question: According to TS 24.501 clause 8.2.7.23, when shall the NSSAI inclusion mode information element be included?
results.reference: if required by operatory policy
results.model_answer: The NSSAI inclusion mode IE shall be included in the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message or the **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND** message when the network wants to indicate (or change) the NSSAI inclusion mode to be used by the UE.

results.question: Which PDU sessions does the PDU session status IE indicate?
results.reference: the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type that the message is sent over that are active within the network
results.model_answer:
“The PDU session status IE is used to indicate the status of PDU sessions.”  
A bit set to **1** indicates that the corresponding PDU session is **active**; a bit set to **0** indicates it is **inactive**.

results.question: What shall the AMF include in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE?
results.reference: the message authentication code, selected NAS algorithms, NCC and generated ngKSI
results.model_answer: The AMF shall include **the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message received from the MME** in the **S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE**.

results.question: What are the main functions of the NAS protocols?
results.reference: support of mobility of the user equipment (UE) including also common procedures such as authentication, identification, generic UE configuration update and security mode control procedures; support of session management procedures to establish and maintain data connectivity between the UE and the data network; and NAS transport procedure to provide a transport of SMS, LPP, LCS, UE policy container, SOR transparent container and UE parameters update information payload
results.model_answer:
The NAS protocols provide two main functions:

- **5G Mobility Management (5GMM)** — supports UE registration, mobility, connection management, authentication and security.
- **5G Session Management (5GSM)** — supports establishment, modification and release of PDU sessions.

results.question: What does the SMF provide to the UE as the DNS server for EAS discovery when selecting an EASDF?
results.reference: its IP address to the UE as the DNS server to be used for the PDU session in the Extended protocol configuration options IE
results.model_answer: When the SMF selects an EASDF, it provides the UE with the **IP address of the selected EASDF as the DNS server address for EAS discovery**, in the PCO/EPCO of the PDU session establishment procedure.

results.question: What does the NAS transport procedure provide transport for?
results.reference: SMS, LPP, LCS, UE policy container, SOR transparent container and UE parameters update information payload
results.model_answer: “The NAS transport procedure provides transport for SMS messages, user data, and UE policy containers between the UE and the network.”

results.question: For which PDU sessions is the PDU session reactivation result error cause IE used?
results.reference: one or more PDU sessions for which the user-plane resources cannot be re-established
results.model_answer:
The **PDU session reactivation result error cause IE** is used for **PDU sessions that were not successfully reactivated**.

It provides the 5GSM cause value for each PDU session ID indicated as unsuccessfully reactivated in the **PDU session reactivation result IE**.

results.question: For what purpose does the AMF provide a minimum time value using this IE?
results.reference: to provide a minimum time value for an entry added to the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location"
results.model_answer: The AMF provides the minimum time value to indicate the **back-off period during which the UE shall not initiate a new registration or service request** (i.e., the UE is to wait before re-attempting access).

results.question: For which type of UE is coordination between 5GMM for 3GPP access and EMM not needed, except as specified in subclause 4.8.3?
results.reference: a UE, which is capable of N1 mode and S1 mode and operates in dual-registration mode
results.model_answer: For a **UE in dual-registration mode**, coordination between 5GMM for 3GPP access and EMM is not needed, except as specified in subclause 4.8.3.

results.question: How does a UE indicate its support of the edge DNS client (EDC)?
results.reference: the UE indicates its support of EDC in the Extended protocol configuration options IE during the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure as described in subclause6.4.1.2 or the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure as described in subclause6.4.2.2
results.model_answer:
A UE indicates support for the edge DNS client (EDC) by setting the **EDC bit** in the **5GMM capability IE** to **“1”** (included in the **REGISTRATION REQUEST** message).

> **EDC = 1:** “UE supports EDC.”

results.question: What does the PDU session reactivation result error cause IE indicate?
results.reference: the cause of failure to re-establish the user-plane resources
results.model_answer: The **PDU session reactivation result error cause IE** indicates the **PDU session ID and the corresponding 5GSM cause value for a PDU session that could not be reactivated**.

results.question: For which type of PDU sessions is serving PLMN rate control applicable?
results.reference: PDU sessions established for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization
results.model_answer: Serving PLMN rate control is applicable to **PDU sessions of type Unstructured**.

results.question: When shall the 5G-RG stop enforcing wireline access service area restrictions?
results.reference: When the 5G-RG is switched off, the UICC containing the USIM is removed or the 5G-RG starts using another wireline access network
results.model_answer: The 5G-RG shall stop enforcing wireline access service area restrictions **when it enters the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state**.

results.question: During which procedures can the SMF provide ECS configuration information to the UE?
results.reference: network-requested PDU session modification procedure, UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure or the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
results.model_answer:
The SMF can provide ECS configuration information to the UE during:

- the **PDU session establishment procedure**; and  
- the **PDU session modification procedure** (including UE-requested PDU session modification).

results.question: What is the specific 5GSM cause value that triggers the inclusion of the Old PDU session ID IE?
results.reference: #39 "reactivation requested"
results.model_answer:
The Old PDU session ID IE is included when the 5GSM cause is:

**#56 — “PDU session ID already in use”.**

results.question: What type of time information does the IE in clause 8.2.19.11 provide to the UE?
results.reference: new network daylight saving time
results.model_answer: It provides the UE with the **network daylight saving time (DST) information**—i.e., whether and what daylight-saving-time adjustment is currently applied by the network.

results.question: Under what condition may the PDU session reactivation result error cause IE be included?
results.reference: if the PDU session reactivation result IE is included and there exist one or more PDU sessions for which the user-plane resources cannot be re-established
results.model_answer: The **PDU session reactivation result error cause** IE may be included **when the PDU session reactivation result IE indicates that one or more PDU sessions were not reactivated**, to provide the corresponding 5GSM cause(s).

results.question: For which UE versions is it possible to send the Mapped EPS bearer contexts IE with IEI value "7F" for this message?
results.reference: UEs compliant with version 15.2.1 or earlier versions of this specification
results.model_answer: The Mapped EPS bearer contexts IE (IEI `7F`) can be sent only for **UEs supporting 3GPP Release 16 or later**.

results.question: What does the network use for a non-emergency PDU session if the UE does not provide an S-NSSAI?
results.reference: the network uses the selected S-NSSAI
results.model_answer: For a non-emergency PDU session, if the UE does not provide an S-NSSAI, **the network uses the default S-NSSAI for the PDU session**.

results.question: What state shall a UE enter upon transferring all PDN connections to the 5GS if the MME does not support EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED
results.model_answer: The UE shall enter the **EMM-DEREGISTERED** state.

results.question: What must a UE operating in dual-registration mode maintain when both 5GMM and EMM are enabled?
results.reference: independent contexts for 5GMM and EMM and this includes independent lists of equivalent PLMNs
results.model_answer: A UE operating in dual-registration mode with both 5GMM and EMM enabled **shall maintain separate 5GMM and EMM states independently of each other**.

results.question: When does the SMF start serving PLMN rate control for a PDU session?
results.reference: when the first control plane user data is received over the PDU session
results.model_answer: The SMF starts serving PLMN rate control for the PDU session **when it sends the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message containing the Serving PLMN rate control IE**.

results.question: What can the SMF base its obtaining of ECS configuration information on?
results.reference: based on the local configuration, the UE's location, and/or UE's subscription information
results.model_answer: The SMF can obtain ECS configuration information based on the **DNN and S-NSSAI of the PDU session, and the UE location**.

results.question: What determines the inclusion of the NSSAI inclusion mode IE?
results.reference: if required by operatory policy
results.model_answer: The NSSAI inclusion mode IE is included **if the UE has indicated support for NSSAI inclusion mode in the 5GMM capability IE**.

results.question: To which UEs do the coordination procedures in subclauses 5.1.4.2 and 5.1.4.3 apply?
results.reference: the UEs operating in single-registration mode
results.model_answer: The coordination procedures in subclauses 5.1.4.2 and 5.1.4.3 apply to **UEs that are registered in the 5GS and are in 5GMM-IDLE mode**.

results.question: What two conditions allow the SMF to send the N1 SM delivery skip allowed indication along with the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message?
results.reference: 1) if the SMF allows the AMF to skip sending the N1 SM container to the UE and the 5GSM cause IE is not set to #39"reactivation requested"; or 2) if the SMF allows the AMF to skip sending the N1 SM container to the UE and the Access type IE is not included
results.model_answer:
The SMF may include the **N1 SM delivery skip allowed indication** in the **PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND** message if:

- the UE is in **CM-IDLE state**; and  
- the PDU session is **not an emergency PDU session**.

results.question: What shall the SMF do upon receipt of a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message?
results.reference: the SMF shall stop timer T3591 and shall consider the PDU session as modified
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE** message, the SMF shall consider the PDU session modification procedure successfully completed.

results.question: How many times does the AMF retransmit the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message upon expiry of timer T3560 before aborting the procedure?
results.reference: four times
results.model_answer:
The AMF retransmits the **AUTHENTICATION REQUEST** message **four times** upon expiry of T3560 before aborting the procedure.

> “This procedure shall be repeated four times. On the fifth expiry of timer T3560, the AMF shall abort the authentication procedure.”

results.question: If the UE indicates support for the Extended protocol configuration options IE, what shall the SMF consider about the UE's packet filter component support?
results.reference: that the UE supports a "destination MAC address range type" packet filter component and a "source MAC address range type" packet filter component
results.model_answer: The SMF shall consider that the UE supports **all packet filter component types specified in clause 10.2.1.2 that are applicable to the PDU session type**.

results.question: When may the network include the Additional configuration indication IE?
results.reference: when requesting the UE to register without the release of the N1 NAS signalling connection
results.model_answer: The network may include the **Additional configuration indication** IE in the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message **if it has additional configuration information to provide to the UE after completion of the registration procedure**.

results.question: When is the NID IE included by the UE according to clause 8.2.6.36?
results.reference: if the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE was assigned by an SNPN other than the SNPN with which the UE is registering
results.model_answer: “The NID IE shall be included by the UE in a REGISTRATION REQUEST message when the UE is registering with an SNPN.”

results.question: In which scenario is the NID IE included by the UE?
results.reference: if the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE was assigned by an SNPN other than the SNPN with which the UE is registering
results.model_answer: The UE includes the **NID IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message when it is attempting to register with a Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN)**, to identify the selected SNPN.

results.question: What is the 5GMM mode when the UE has a NAS signalling connection established?
results.reference: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
results.model_answer: The UE is in **5GMM-CONNECTED mode** when it has a NAS signalling connection established.

results.question: What triggers the UE to include the NID information element?
results.reference: if the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE was assigned by an SNPN other than the SNPN with which the UE is registering
results.model_answer:
