The UE includes the **NID information element** in the **REGISTRATION REQUEST** message **when registering with an SNPN**:

> “The UE shall include the NID IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE is registering with an SNPN.”

results.question: Which 3GPP specification clause defines the Network daylight saving time information element?
results.model_answer: The **Network daylight saving time** information element is defined in **3GPP TS 24.501, clause 9.11.3.36**.

results.question: When the Payload container type IE is set to 'CIoT user data container', timer T3447 is running, the UE supports service gap control, the UE is not configured for high priority access, the connection was not triggered by paging, and no MT signalling or user-plane resources have been established, what shall the AMF do?
results.reference: the AMF shall send back to the UE the CIoT user data container which was not forwarded as specified in subclause5.4.5.3.1 case l1)
results.model_answer: The AMF **shall release the NAS signalling connection**.

results.question: In which 5GMM mode is the UE when it does not have a NAS signalling connection established?
results.reference: 5GMM-IDLE mode
results.model_answer:
The UE is in **5GMM-IDLE mode**.

> “A UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode when it does not have a NAS signalling connection established.”

results.question: What should the UE do with unknown IEs in a message that are not encoded as 'comprehension required'?
results.reference: ignore all IEs unknown in a message
results.model_answer: The UE **shall ignore the unknown IE** if it is not encoded as *“comprehension required”*.

results.question: What may the AMF do if the Payload container type IE is set to 'CIoT user data container' and the AMF does not have a PDU session routing context for the PDU session ID and the UE?
results.reference: the AMF may send back to the UE the CIoT user data container which was not forwarded as specified in subclause5.4.5.3.1 case l1)
results.model_answer: If the AMF has no PDU session routing context for the indicated PDU session ID and UE, **the AMF may discard the UL NAS TRANSPORT message**.

results.question: Under what condition related to handover does the AMF retransmit the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message upon successful completion of an intra AMF handover?
results.reference: the target TA is included in the TAI list
results.model_answer: Upon successful completion of an intra-AMF handover, the AMF retransmits the **AUTHENTICATION REQUEST** message **if timer T3560 is running** (i.e., an Authentication Response has not yet been received).

results.question: What is the purpose of the network-requested PDU session modification procedure regarding header compression?
results.reference: re-negotiate header compression configuration associated to a PDU session
results.model_answer: The network-requested PDU session modification procedure is used by the network to request the UE to modify the **header compression configuration** of an existing PDU session (e.g. to add, modify, or release header-compression contexts/configuration).

results.question: Where can one find information about the coordination of 'SIM/USIM considered invalid' and 'USIM considered invalid for 5GS services' between mobility management entities?
results.reference: see subclause5.1.5
results.model_answer:
Information is provided in **3GPP TS 24.501, clause 4.11, “Coordination between 5GMM and EMM entities.”**

The relevant statement is:

> “Coordination of the ‘SIM/USIM considered invalid’ and ‘USIM considered invalid for 5GS services’ states between the 5GMM and EMM entities is specified in 3GPP TS 24.301.”

results.question: To which list is an entry added when the 5GMM cause is #78?
results.reference: the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location"
results.model_answer: An entry is added to the **“forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service”** list.

results.question: When is serving PLMN rate control information discarded by the UE?
results.reference: when the UE successfully registers to another PLMN
results.model_answer: The UE discards the stored serving PLMN rate control information when it changes serving PLMN (i.e. it is no longer registered in the PLMN for which that information was received).

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE stop timer T3396 associated with no DNN upon receipt of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message?
results.reference: If the UE did not provide a DNN during the PDU session establishment and the request type was different from "initial emergency request" and different from "existing emergency PDU session"
results.model_answer: The UE shall stop timer **T3396 associated with no DNN** if the received **PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND** message contains a **5GSM cause IE set to cause value #39, “reactivation requested.”**

results.question: What must be active for the network to potentially include the T3448 value IE?
results.reference: the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active
results.model_answer: The network may include the **T3448 value IE if MICO mode is active**.

results.question: During which type of PDU session establishment procedure shall the service-level authentication and authorization procedure NOT be performed?
results.reference: establishing an emergency PDU session
results.model_answer: “The service-level authentication and authorization procedure shall not be performed during a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services.”

results.question: What may a UE do after successfully registering in N1 mode if it has active PDN connections in S1 mode?
results.reference: transfer one or more active PDN connections from S1 mode to N1 mode by initiating the PDU session establishment procedure with request type set to "existing PDU session"
results.model_answer: After successfully registering in N1 mode, a UE with active PDN connections in S1 mode **may initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure for each active PDN connection in S1 mode**.

results.question: Under what conditions shall the AMF abort the procedure when the Payload container type IE is set to 'N1 SM information'?
results.reference: the AMF shall abort the procedure
results.model_answer: When the payload container type IE is **“N1 SM information”**, the AMF shall abort the procedure if it has **no PDU session context associated with the indicated PDU session ID** and the **Request type IE is not set to “initial request” or “initial emergency request.”**

results.question: On what basis are the 5GS session management timers T3584 started and stopped in the UE for S-NSSAI based congestion control?
results.reference: on a per S-NSSAI, DNN and PLMN basis
results.model_answer:
“For S-NSSAI based congestion control, timers T3584 are started and stopped on a per S-NSSAI basis.”

Thus, the UE maintains/applies T3584 independently for each S-NSSAI.

results.question: What action does the AMF take on the fifth expiry of timer T3560?
results.reference: the AMF shall abort the EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure and any ongoing 5GMM specific procedure, and release the N1 NAS signalling connection
results.model_answer: “Upon the fifth expiry of timer T3560, the AMF shall abort the authentication procedure and release the NAS signalling connection.”

results.question: What shall the AMF do if the Payload container type IE is set to 'N1 SM information', the Old PDU session ID IE is not included, the AMF lacks a routing context for the PDU session ID and UE, the Request type is 'initial request' or 'MA PDU request', and SMF selection fails?
results.reference: the AMF shall send back to the UE the 5GSM message which was not forwarded as specified in subclause5.4.5.3.1 case e) or case f)
results.model_answer: The AMF shall send a **DL NAS TRANSPORT** message to the UE containing a **PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT** message, with the **5GSM cause** set to **#31 “request rejected, unspecified.”**

results.question: What specific EAP content triggers inclusion of the EAP message IE in a SERVICE REJECT?
results.reference: EAP-failure message
results.model_answer: The EAP message IE shall be included in a SERVICE REJECT **if the EAP message contains an EAP-Failure packet**.

results.question: What shall the UE do if it supports N1 mode only, the de-registration request is not due to switch off, and the procedure was performed due to disabling of 5GS services?
results.reference: the UE shall enter the 5GMM-NULL state for 3GPP access
results.model_answer: The UE shall enter the **5GMM-DEREGISTERED** state and shall not initiate a 5GS registration procedure until 5GS services are enabled again.

results.question: What are the two options for a UE registered in N1 mode only when it wants to register in S1 mode?
results.reference: the same PLMN to which it is registered in N1 mode; or an equivalent PLMN
results.model_answer:
A UE registered in **N1 mode only** that wants to register in **S1 mode** can either:

- perform a **combined registration procedure**; or  
- perform an **EPS attach procedure** (as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301).

results.question: What is the purpose of the service-level authentication and authorization procedure when establishing the PDU session?
results.reference: to authenticate the upper layers of the UE, when establishing the PDU session
results.model_answer: The service-level authentication and authorization procedure is used **to authenticate and authorize the UE for the requested service (e.g. a DNN) during PDU session establishment**.

results.question: What can the network provide to the UE due to a newly selected EASDF during the PDU session modification procedure?
results.reference: provide updated DNS server address(es) due to the newly selected local DNS server or the newly selected EASDF
results.model_answer: The network can provide the UE with **EASDF information** in the **PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND** message due to a newly selected EASDF.

results.question: In which PDU session type are all UL user data packets associated with the same QoS flow?
results.reference: Unstructured PDU session type
results.model_answer:
In an **unstructured PDU session**:

> “For an unstructured PDU session, all UL user data packets are associated with the same QoS flow.”

results.question: What action does the AMF take if a handover procedure failure is reported by the lower layer and the N1 NAS signalling connection exists?
results.reference: the AMF shall retransmit the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
results.model_answer: If a handover procedure failure is reported by the lower layer and the N1 NAS signalling connection exists, **the AMF shall consider the N1 NAS signalling connection released and enter 5GMM-IDLE mode**.

results.question: What is one purpose of the network-requested PDU session modification procedure related to MBS multicast sessions?
results.reference: remove joined UE from one or more MBS multicast sessions associated with a PDU session
results.model_answer: One purpose is **to activate, modify, or deactivate an MBS multicast context associated with an MBS multicast session**.

results.question: What must the external DN successfully perform for the EAP message IE to be included?
results.reference: authentication and authorization of the UE using EAP
results.model_answer: The EAP message IE shall be included **if the external DN has successfully authenticated the UE**.

results.question: In which PDU session types does the NAS protocol enable different forwarding treatments of UL user data packets based on QoS rules?
results.reference: IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6 and Ethernet PDU session type
results.model_answer: The NAS protocol enables different forwarding treatments of UL user data packets based on QoS rules for **IP PDU sessions and Ethernet PDU sessions**.

results.question: According to clause 7.6.1, what approach shall the network take regarding unknown IEs?
results.reference: take the same approach
results.model_answer: “The network shall ignore unknown IEs in a message, unless otherwise specified in this specification.”

results.question: What must be successfully completed by the external DN using EAP for inclusion of the EAP message IE?
results.reference: authentication and authorization of the UE
results.model_answer: The **EAP authentication procedure** must be successfully completed by the external DN using EAP.

results.question: Over what type of access are the 5GMM and 5GSM procedures and messages generally used from the UE's NAS perspective?
results.reference: over non-3GPP access as over 3GPP access
results.model_answer: “The 5GMM and 5GSM procedures and messages are generally applicable to both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access.”

results.question: What must be active for the AMF to potentially include the T3346 value information element?
results.reference: the general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
results.model_answer: The AMF can include the T3346 value IE **when NAS level congestion control is active**.

results.question: What combination is the timer T3584 associated with when it applies for all PLMNs and the UE is registered in a VPLMN?
results.reference: the timer T3584 is associated with the [mapped S-NSSAI, DNN] combination of the PDU session
results.model_answer:
When T3584 applies for all PLMNs and the UE is registered in a VPLMN, it is associated with the combination of:

- the **S-NSSAI**,
- the **DNN**, and
- the **HPLMN identity**.

results.question: What does the NAS layer do when it receives a request from the upper layer to modify a PDU session?
results.reference: shall initiate the PDU session modification procedure
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of a request from the upper layer to modify a PDU session, the NAS layer **initiates the PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to the network**.

results.question: In which direction is the DL NAS TRANSPORT message sent?
results.reference: from the network to the UE
results.model_answer: The **DL NAS TRANSPORT** message is sent **from the network to the UE** (downlink direction).

results.question: What does the UE do if it receives the service-level-AA response in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message?
results.reference: the UE passes it to the upper layer
results.model_answer: If the UE receives a **service-level-AA response** in the **PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT** message, it **forwards the service-level-AA response to the application associated with the PDU session**.

results.question: When is the EAP message IE included?
results.reference: when the external DN successfully performed authentication and authorization of the UE using EAP
results.model_answer: The **EAP message IE** is included when **EAP-based authentication and key agreement is used** (e.g. EAP-AKA′), to carry the EAP payload between the UE and network in the NAS authentication messages.

results.question: What does the NAS layer do when it receives a request from the upper layer to establish a PDU session?
results.reference: shall initiate the PDU session establishment procedure
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of a request from the upper layer to establish a PDU session, the NAS layer **initiates the PDU session establishment procedure** (using a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST), as specified in TS 24.501 clause 6.4.1.

results.question: What can the network inform the UE about regarding UAS services during the PDU session modification procedure?
results.reference: inform about the result of service-level AA procedure or C2 authorization for UAS services
results.model_answer: The network can inform the UE, by means of the **UAS services** IE in the **PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND**, whether **UAS services are allowed (authorized) or not allowed for the PDU session**.

results.question: If the service-level-AA procedure is performed for re-authentication and completes unsuccessfully, how is the response transported to the UE?
results.reference: as a part of the network-requested PDU session release procedure in the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: If re-authentication fails, the AMF sends the failure to the UE in a **DL NAS TRANSPORT** message, with the **Payload container type set to NSSAA** and the payload containing an **EAP-Failure message**.

results.question: To which entity does the network transmit data when the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included?
results.reference: to the UE
results.model_answer:
The network transmits the data to the **UE**.

> “If the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included, the network shall transmit the data to the UE in the Extended protocol configuration options IE.”

results.question: What determines the forwarding treatment of UL user data packets in IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6 and Ethernet PDU session types?
results.reference: signalled QoS rules, derived QoS rules or any combination of them
results.model_answer:
For **IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, and Ethernet PDU session types**, the forwarding treatment of uplink user-data packets is determined by the **QoS rules** provided by the network.

The UE classifies each UL packet using the packet filters in the QoS rules and, where more than one rule matches, uses the rule with the **highest QoS rule precedence**. The selected QoS rule identifies the **QoS Flow Identifier (QFI)**, i.e. the QoS flow to which the packet is forwarded.

results.question: During what state may the AMF include the T3346 value IE?
results.reference: when the general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
results.model_answer: The AMF may include the **T3346 value IE** in the **DEREGISTRATION REQUEST** message when the UE is in the **5GMM-REGISTERED state**.

results.question: Under what condition may the network include the T3448 value IE?
results.reference: if the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports the control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations
results.model_answer: The network may include the **T3448 value IE only if it includes the MICO indication IE** in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

results.question: What shall a UE supporting UAS services not do regarding PDU session establishment?
results.reference: shall not request a PDU session establishment procedure to the same DNN (or no DNN, if no DNN was indicated by the UE) and the same S-NSSAI (or no S-NSSAI, if no S-NSSAI was indicated by the UE) for which the UE has requested a service level authentication and authorization procedure which is ongoing
results.model_answer: A UE supporting UAS services **shall not establish a PDU session for UAV command and control (C2) communication unless it has received UAS authorization from the network**.

results.question: What procedure is used over 3GPP access to periodically notify the availability of the UE to the network?
results.reference: The periodic registration update procedure
results.model_answer: The **periodic registration update procedure** is used over 3GPP access to periodically notify the network of the UE’s availability.

results.question: If the network decides to reject the RELAY KEY REQUEST message, what value shall the PRTI IE of the RELAY KEY REJECT message be set to?
results.reference: set the PRTI IE of the RELAY KEY REJECT message to the PRTI value of the received RELAY KEY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The PRTI IE in the **RELAY KEY REJECT** message shall be set to **the value received in the PRTI IE of the RELAY KEY REQUEST message**.

results.question: When is the Allowed SSC mode IE included according to clause 8.3.3.3?
results.reference: when the network rejects the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST with cause #68 "not supported SSC mode
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Allowed SSC mode** IE in the **PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT** message when the 5GSM cause is set to **“not supported SSC mode”**.

results.question: How is the SMS message carried within the DL NAS TRANSPORT message?
results.reference: in encapsulated form
results.model_answer:
The SMS message is carried in the **Payload container** IE of the **DL NAS TRANSPORT** message, with the **Payload container type** IE set to **“SMS”**.

> “The payload container type IE shall be set to ‘SMS’ and the payload container IE shall contain the SMS message as specified in 3GPP TS 24.011.”

results.question: If the value of timer T3346 is greater than the value of the non-3GPP de-registration timer, what does the UE set the non-3GPP de-registration timer value to be?
results.reference: 4 minutes greater than the value of timer T3346
results.model_answer: The UE sets the non-3GPP de-registration timer value to the value of timer **T3346**.

results.question: What shall the SMF create to initiate the network-requested PDU session modification procedure?
results.reference: a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The SMF shall create **an N1 SM container containing a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message**.

results.question: Upon receiving the RELAY KEY REJECT message, what shall the UE consider?
results.reference: consider the authentication has failed
results.model_answer: Upon receiving the **RELAY KEY REJECT** message, the UE shall consider the **relay key establishment procedure as failed**.

results.question: From the UE's NAS perspective, what is generally used over non-3GPP access?
results.reference: the procedures and messages defined for 5GMM and 5GSM are used
results.model_answer: Over non-3GPP access, NAS signalling is generally carried via an **IPsec tunnel** (e.g. between the UE and the N3IWF for untrusted non-3GPP access).

results.question: What does a QoS rule contain to identify the QoS parameters to be applied to packets matching the rule?
results.reference: a QoS flow identifier (QFI)
results.model_answer: A QoS rule contains a **QoS flow identifier (QFI)**, which identifies the QoS flow and thus the QoS parameters to be applied to packets matching the rule.

results.question: What are the two UE states over 3GPP access that trigger the network to send a NOTIFICATION message over non-3GPP access when the UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access?

results.model_answer:
The network sends a **NOTIFICATION** message over non-3GPP access when the UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access and is, over 3GPP access, either:

- in **5GMM-CONNECTED** mode **without user-plane resources established**.

results.question: When may the network include the T3448 value information element?
results.reference: if the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports the control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations

results.question: What is the purpose of the QoS rule identifier in a QoS rule?
results.reference: to identify a QoS rule in the UE and in the 5GC
results.model_answer: “The QoS rule identifier is used to identify the QoS rule.”

results.question: What type of data does the network transmit to the UE that triggers the inclusion of the Extended protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events)
results.model_answer: The network includes the **Extended protocol configuration options IE** when it needs to transmit **application-level parameters / protocol configuration data** to the UE.

results.question: What PDU session identity value shall the TWIF acting on behalf of the N5CW device allocate when requesting to establish a new PDU session?
results.reference: the "PDU session identity value 15"
results.model_answer: The TWIF shall allocate **a PDU session identity value between 1 and 15 that is not already in use by the N5CW device**.

results.question: What does the network send to initiate the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
results.reference: an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE without the EAP message IE
results.model_answer: The network initiates the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure by sending an **AUTHENTICATION REQUEST** message to the UE.

results.question: Under what condition shall the SMF proceed with the UUAA-SM procedure and refrain from accepting or rejecting the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
results.reference: until the service-level authentication and authorization procedure is completed
results.model_answer: The SMF shall proceed with the UUAA-SM procedure, without accepting or rejecting the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, **if the SMF determines that UE user authentication and authorization is required for the requested PDU session**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the precedence value in a QoS rule?
results.reference: to specify the order in which the QoS rules are applied
results.model_answer: “The precedence value is used to determine the precedence of the QoS rule relative to other QoS rules. A lower value indicates a higher precedence.”

results.question: When the UE has requested P-CSCF address and the modification is triggered for P-CSCF restoration, where shall the SMF include the P-CSCF IP address(es)?
results.reference: in the Extended protocol configuration options IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The SMF shall include the P-CSCF IP address(es) **in the Protocol Configuration Options (PCO) IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message**.

results.question: What UE capability is required for the network to possibly include the T3448 value IE?
results.reference: the UE supports the control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations
results.model_answer: The network may include the **T3448 value IE** only if the UE has indicated support for the **UE radio capability ID** in the **5GMM capability IE**.

results.question: What does the AMF set the EAP message IE to in the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message?
results.reference: the EAP-request message which is generated by the AMF or provided by the AAA-S via the NSSAAF
results.model_answer: The AMF sets the **EAP message** IE to the **EAP-Request packet received from the AAA server**.

results.question: Which IE may be included to request MICO mode re-negotiation?
results.reference: MICO indication
results.model_answer: “The UE may include the **MICO mode indication IE** in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message to request MICO mode re-negotiation.”

results.question: What must the SMF ensure regarding the number of packet filters in the authorized QoS rules?
results.reference: the number of the packet filters used in the authorized QoS rules of the PDU Session does not exceed the maximum number of packet filters supported by the UE for the PDU session
results.model_answer: The SMF shall ensure that **the number of packet filters in the authorized QoS rules does not exceed the number of packet filters supported by the UE**.

results.question: For which type of unknown IEs does clause 7.6.1 specify that the UE shall ignore them?
results.reference: unknown in a message which are not encoded as "comprehension required"
results.model_answer:
Clause 7.6.1 specifies:

> “The UE shall ignore unknown type 1 information elements.”

results.question: When the value of timer T3346 is greater than the value of timer T3512, what does the AMF set such that the sum of the timer values is greater than the value of timer T3346?
results.reference: the mobile reachable timer and the implicit de-registration timer
results.model_answer: The AMF sets **timer T3512** such that the sum of the values of **timer T3346 and timer T3512** is greater than the value of timer T3346.

results.question: What timer does the AMF start for a UE registered over non-3GPP access when the N1 NAS signalling connection over non-3GPP access is released?
results.reference: a non-3GPP implicit de-registration timer
results.model_answer: The AMF starts the **mobile reachable timer** when the N1 NAS signalling connection over non-3GPP access is released for a UE registered over non-3GPP access.

results.question: What is the purpose of the PDU EAP result message transport procedure?
results.reference: to transport an EAP result message
results.model_answer: “The PDU EAP result message transport procedure is used by the network to transport an EAP-Success or EAP-Failure message to the UE.”

results.question: Which 3GPP technical specification defines the PDU EAP result message transport procedure?
results.model_answer: The PDU EAP result message transport procedure is defined in **3GPP TS 24.501** (Non-Access-Stratum (NAS) protocol for 5G System).

results.question: When may the AMF include the T3346 value IE?
results.reference: when the general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
results.model_answer:
The AMF may include the **T3346 value IE** when it indicates **5GMM cause #22 “congestion”**.

It may be included in the relevant NAS reject/deregistration message (e.g. **REGISTRATION REJECT**, **SERVICE REJECT**, or network-initiated **DEREGISTRATION REQUEST**) to provide the UE with a back-off timer value.

results.question: What timer does the AMF start per S-NSSAI when sending the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message?
results.reference: timer T3575
results.model_answer:
The AMF starts **timer T3580** for the S-NSSAI.

> “The AMF shall start timer T3580 for the S-NSSAI when sending the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.”

results.question: If a T3447 value included in the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message contained an indication that the timer is deactivated, what shall the AMF do with timer T3447 if running?
results.reference: stop the timer T3447 if running
results.model_answer: The AMF shall **stop timer T3447, if running**.

results.question: What keys are agreed upon between the UE and the network during the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
results.reference: KAUSF, KSEAF and KAMF
results.model_answer: During the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure, the UE and the network agree on the **K<sub>SEAF</sub>** and **K<sub>AMF</sub>** keys.

results.question: Under what condition is the EAP message IE included in a SERVICE REJECT message?
results.reference: if the SERVICE REJECT message is used to convey EAP-failure message
results.model_answer: The EAP message IE shall be included **if the 5GMM cause IE is set to “EAP failure.”**

results.question: What message does the AMF create to initiate the network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure?
results.reference: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The AMF creates a **DL NAS TRANSPORT message** to initiate the network slice-specific EAP message reliable transport procedure, with the payload container type set to **“EAP message”**.

results.question: What does the Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicate for the list of '5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming'?
results.reference: the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
results.model_answer: “The Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicates the list of ‘5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming’.”

results.question: What does the AMF send to the UE after receiving the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
results.reference: The AMF shall send a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.
results.model_answer:
If the registration is accepted, the AMF sends a **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message to the UE.

If registration cannot be accepted, it sends a **REGISTRATION REJECT** message.

results.question: What is the complete textual description of cause #68 mentioned in clause 8.3.3.3?
results.reference: "not supported SSC mode
results.model_answer:
**Cause #68 – “Not supported in the serving PLMN”**

> “This 5GMM cause is sent by the network to indicate that the requested service is not supported in the serving PLMN.”

results.question: If a new 5G-GUTI was included in the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message, how shall the AMF consider the old 5G-GUTI?
results.reference: invalid
results.model_answer: “If a new 5G-GUTI was included in the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message, the AMF shall consider the old 5G-GUTI as valid until the AMF receives the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message from the UE.”

results.question: When is the timer T3584 applied for all PLMNs?
results.reference: If the 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE with the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs" is included in the 5GSM message with the 5GSM cause value #67 "insufficient resources for specific slice and DNN"
results.model_answer:
Timer **T3584 is applied for all PLMNs when the UE receives a `REGISTRATION REJECT` message with 5GMM cause #27, “N1 mode not allowed.”**

> “If the UE receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #27 ‘N1 mode not allowed’, the UE shall start timer T3584 … Timer T3584 is applied for all PLMNs.”

results.question: What does not apply for non-3GPP access regarding local area data network?
results.reference: local area data network (LADN) does not apply for non-3GPP access
results.model_answer: “For non-3GPP access, the LADN information shall not apply.”

results.question: What is the purpose of including the Local time zone IE according to TS 24.501 clause 8.2.19.9?
results.reference: to assign a new local time zone to the UE
results.model_answer: “The Local time zone IE is used to indicate the offset between universal time and local time in steps of 15 minutes.”

results.question: What shall the UE do upon receiving the DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message regarding timer T3521?
results.reference: stop timer T3521
results.model_answer: Upon receiving the **DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT** message, the UE **shall stop timer T3521**.

results.question: Between which two entities does the NAS protocol operate in 5GS?
results.reference: between the UE and the AMF
results.model_answer: The NAS protocol in 5GS operates **between the UE and the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF)**.

results.question: What does the Pending NSSAI IE inform the UE about regarding S-NSSAIs?
results.reference: one or more S-NSSAIs that are pending
results.model_answer: The **Pending NSSAI IE** indicates the **S-NSSAIs for which network slice-specific authentication and authorization (NSSAA) is pending**.

results.question: Upon receiving an indication that barring is alleviated for an access category, what may 5GMM initiate for a mobile originated location request?
results.reference: the NAS transport procedure as specified in clause5.4.5 to send the LCS message in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message, if still needed
results.model_answer: Upon receiving an indication that barring is alleviated for an access category, **5GMM may initiate the service request procedure for a mobile originated location request**.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the Service area list IE according to clause 8.2.7.15?
results.reference: to assign new service area restrictions to the UE
results.model_answer: It is used to provide the UE with **service area restriction information**—i.e. a list of service areas that are **allowed** or **non-allowed** for the UE.

results.question: To what entity is a new local time zone assigned when the Local time zone IE is included?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: A new local time zone is assigned to **the UE**.

results.question: What does the SMF do with timer T3592 when N1 SM delivery skip is indicated?
results.reference: stop timer T3592
results.model_answer: When N1 SM delivery skip is indicated, **the SMF shall stop timer T3592**.

results.question: What is independent between the UE's 3GPP access and non-3GPP access 5GMM state machine instances?
results.reference: the registration status, and the 5GMM parameters
results.model_answer: The UE’s 5GMM state machine instances for 3GPP access and non-3GPP access “are independent of each other.” Each access type maintains and operates its own separate 5GMM state machine.

results.question: What are the two main types of procedures supported by the NAS protocol according to the overview?
results.reference: mobility management and session management procedures
results.model_answer:
The NAS protocol supports two main types of procedures:

- **5G mobility management (5GMM) procedures**
- **5G session management (5GSM) procedures**

results.question: What action may be performed by including the Local time zone IE?
results.reference: assign a new local time zone to the UE
results.model_answer: By including the **Local time zone IE**, the network may **update the UE with the local time zone**.

results.question: What does the UE do with any previously stored RAND and RES* if it returns an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message to the network?
results.reference: delete any previously stored RAND and RES*
results.model_answer: The UE **shall delete any previously stored RAND and RES\*** if it returns an **AUTHENTICATION FAILURE** message to the network.

results.question: Under what condition involving timer T3396 does the UE not initiate the remote UE report procedure?
results.reference: The UE does not initiate the remote UE report procedure if the timer T3396 is running
results.model_answer: The UE shall not initiate the remote UE report procedure **if timer T3396 is running**.

results.question: For which list is the Forbidden TAI(s) IE used when included?
results.reference: the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
results.model_answer: When included, the **Forbidden TAI(s) IE** is used to provide the UE with the **list of forbidden tracking areas for roaming**.

results.question: What 5GMM cause value does the UE send if it finds the MAC code supplied by the core network in the AUTN parameter to be invalid?
results.reference: 5GMM cause #20 "MAC failure"
results.model_answer:
The UE sends **5GMM cause value #20 — “MAC failure”**.

> “If the UE finds the MAC code supplied by the network in the AUTN parameter is invalid, the UE shall send an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with 5GMM cause value #20 ‘MAC failure’.”

results.question: Under what condition does the AMF send a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE upon receiving a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST?
results.reference: if the De-registration type IE does not indicate "switch off"
results.model_answer:
The AMF sends a **DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT** message **if the UE has not indicated that it is switching off** in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST.

> “If the UE has not indicated that it is switching off, the AMF shall send a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.”

results.question: What action shall the SMF take upon receipt of an indication that N1 SM delivery was skipped?
results.reference: shall stop timer T3592 and shall consider the PDU session as released
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of an indication that N1 SM delivery was skipped, **the SMF shall consider the PDU session as released**.

results.question: When is the network prohibited from using the NOTIFICATION message over non-3GPP access if the MUSIM UE supports paging indication for voice services?

results.question: Who may send the Emergency number list IE?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The **network** may send the Emergency number list IE to the UE (e.g. in a **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** or **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND** message).

results.question: During which procedure may the T3502 value IE be included?
results.reference: during the initial registration
results.model_answer: “The T3502 value IE may be included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message during the registration procedure.”

results.question: What does the NAS provide to lower layers for access control checking when a UE in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode detects an event?
results.reference: the access identities and the access category
results.model_answer: When a UE in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode detects an event, NAS provides **the access category associated with that event** to the lower layers for access control checking.

results.question: Within which geographical area are the emergency numbers in the Emergency number list IE valid?
results.reference: within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received
results.model_answer: The emergency numbers in the **Emergency number list IE** are valid **within the country where the UE is located**.

results.question: What action does the UE take regarding timer T3346 upon receipt of a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message?
results.reference: stop timer T3346 if running
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of a **NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND** message, the UE **shall stop timer T3346, if it is running**.

results.question: What does the UE check in the 5G authentication challenge data to verify the authenticity of the 5G core network?
results.reference: RAND, AUTN and ngKSI
results.model_answer:
The UE verifies the **Authentication Token (AUTN)** included in the 5G authentication challenge. In particular, it checks:

- the **MAC** in AUTN, to verify that the challenge was generated by a network possessing the shared subscriber key; and  
- the **sequence number (SQN)**, to ensure freshness and protect against replayed challenges.

In TS 24.501 terms, the UE checks the AUTN as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501.

results.question: If a new service area list was included in the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message, how shall the AMF consider the new service area list?
results.reference: valid
results.model_answer: The AMF shall consider the new service area list to be valid **after receiving the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message from the UE**.

results.question: What message does the UE send when it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND for a PDU session in state PDU SESSION INACTIVE?
results.reference: 5GSM STATUS message
results.model_answer: The UE sends a **PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE** message to the network.

results.question: When timer T3584 is running, what does the UE not do regarding the remote UE report procedure?
results.reference: The UE does not initiate the remote UE report procedure if the timer T3584 is running
results.model_answer: While timer T3584 is running, the UE **shall not initiate a remote UE report procedure**.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the T3502 value IE?

results.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe remote UE report procedure?
results.reference: for a UE acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network UE relay to notify the network that a 5G ProSe remote UE is connected to the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE or disconnected from the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE as specified in 3GPPTS23.304[6E]
results.model_answer: The 5G ProSe remote UE report procedure is used by a **5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay UE to report to the network the list of remote UEs connected to that relay**.

results.question: What 5GMM cause shall the AMF include in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message when a UE initiates de-registration in a cell belonging to an SNPN with a non-globally-unique SNPN identity for which it has no valid subscription?
results.reference: 5GMM cause #74 "Temporarily not authorized for this SNPN"

The AMF shall include the 5GMM cause:

> **“No subscription for SNPN”**

results.question: When a NAS message needs to be sent both ciphered and integrity protected, what is the order of operations?
results.reference: the NAS message is first ciphered and then the ciphered NAS message and the NAS sequence number are integrity protected by calculating the MAC
results.model_answer:
When both are applied, **ciphering is performed first, then integrity protection**.

In other words, the NAS message is ciphered, and the MAC for integrity protection is calculated over the ciphered NAS message.

results.question: What 5GSM cause value does the UE set if the PDU session ID in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND belongs to a session in state PDU SESSION INACTIVE?
results.reference: #43 "Invalid PDU session identity"
results.model_answer: The UE sets the 5GSM cause value to **#54 “PDU session does not exist.”**

results.question: If the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-IA0 has been selected, how should the receiver regard NAS messages with the security header indicating integrity protection?
results.reference: the receiver shall regard the NAS messages with the security header indicating integrity protection as integrity protected
results.model_answer: If the null integrity protection algorithm **5G-IA0** has been selected, the receiver **shall regard a NAS message with a security header indicating integrity protection as a message that has failed the integrity check**.

results.question: What stored information shall the UE delete upon receiving the DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
results.reference: delete any stored SUCI

results.question: Which message shall the UE create as part of the UE-initiated authentication and key agreement procedure initiation?
results.reference: create a RELAY KEY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The UE shall create an **AUTHENTICATION FAILURE** message.

results.question: What is the name of the information element included when transmitting EAP to a 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE?

results.model_answer: **EAP message** information element.

results.question: What is the value of the PTI IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message that triggers the collision handling procedure?
results.reference: "No procedure transaction identity assigned"
results.model_answer:
The collision handling procedure is triggered when the **PTI IE is set to a value other than “0”**.

> “If the PTI IE is set to a value different from 0, the UE shall initiate the collision handling procedure …”

results.question: To whom does the UE transmit data when the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included?
results.reference: to the network
results.model_answer: The Extended protocol configuration options IE is used to transfer protocol configuration options **between the UE and the SMF**. Thus, when included, the UE transmits the data to the **SMF** (via NAS signalling).

results.question: For a UE with a CAG information list entry containing an 'indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells', what 5GMM cause shall the AMF include in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST if the UE initiates de-registration in a non-CAG cell?
results.reference: 5GMM cause #76 "Not authorized for this CAG or authorized for CAG cells only"
results.model_answer: The AMF shall include 5GMM cause **#25 — “not authorized for this CAG or DNN”** in the **DEREGISTRATION REQUEST**.

results.question: What is the direction of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
results.reference: UE to network
results.model_answer: UE to network.

results.question: In which UE registration states does the AMF NOT include the Configured NSSAI IE?
results.reference: the UE is neither registering nor registered for onboarding services in SNPN
results.model_answer:
The AMF shall not include the Configured NSSAI IE when the UE is in either:

- **5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE** state; or  
- **5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION** state,

**if the registration type is periodic registration updating**.

results.question: What may the network do if the UE supports Extended CAG information list?
results.reference: assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side
results.model_answer: If the UE supports the Extended CAG information list, the network may include the **Extended CAG information list** IE in the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message.

results.question: What container IE includes the parameters sent by a UE supporting UAS services to the network for UAS services?
results.reference: Service-level-AA container IE
results.model_answer:
The **UAS parameters IE** is the container IE.

> “The UAS parameters IE is a container IE that includes parameters that are sent by a UE supporting UAS services to the network for UAS services.”

results.question: To what type of remote UE is the EAP message transmitted when this IE is included?
results.reference: a 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE
results.model_answer: When included, the EAP message is transmitted to a **remote UE accessing the 5GS via a UE-to-network relay**.

results.question: What 5GMM cause value does the UE send if it detects that the ngKSI received in the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message is already in use?
results.reference: 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use"
results.model_answer:
The UE sends an **AUTHENTICATION FAILURE** message with 5GMM cause:

> **#71 – “ngKSI already in use”**.

results.question: What does the UE supporting UAS services provide to the AMF during the registration procedure to potentially trigger the UUAA-MM procedure?
results.reference: CAA-level UAV ID
results.model_answer:
The UE provides a **UAS capability indication** to the AMF, i.e. it includes the **UAS capability IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message**.

results.question: Under what condition shall the network not use the NOTIFICATION message to re-establish user-plane resources of PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access over 3GPP access?
results.reference: if all the PDU sessions of the UE that are established over the 3GPP access are associated with control plane only indication
results.model_answer: The network shall not use the **NOTIFICATION** message for this purpose **if the UE is in CM-IDLE state over 3GPP access**.

results.question: What must the UE not be in for the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE to be included?
results.reference: not in NB-N1 mode
results.model_answer: The UE must **not be in emergency services** for the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE to be included.

results.question: Which 3GPP specification clause defines the Local time zone information element?
results.model_answer: The **Local time zone** information element is defined in **3GPP TS 24.501, clause 9.11.3.41**.

results.question: According to the clause, to what type of access are the following substates not applicable?
results.reference: non-3GPP access

results.question: What does the UE set in the 5GMM capability IE to potentially receive NSAG information?
results.reference: the NSAG bit to "NSAG supported"
results.model_answer: The UE sets the **NSAG bit to “1”** in the **5GMM capability IE** to indicate that it can receive NSAG information.

results.question: For the UE, when is integrity protected signalling mandatory for 5GMM NAS messages?
results.reference: once a valid 5G NAS security context exists and has been taken into use
results.model_answer:
For the UE, integrity protection is mandatory for 5GMM NAS messages **after successful completion of the NAS security mode control procedure**, i.e. once a 5G NAS security context is established and activated.

In general, messages sent before establishment of the NAS security context (for example, initial registration, identity, and authentication-related messages) can be unprotected where explicitly specified.

results.question: What action shall the SMF take if UUAA-SM fails during a re-authentication?
results.reference: release the PDU session related to re-authentication
results.model_answer: If UUAA-SM fails during a re-authentication, **the SMF shall release the PDU session**.

results.question: What can the NAS optionally provide to lower layers after being informed that an access attempt is allowed?

results.model_answer: NAS may optionally provide the lower layers with **an establishment cause**.

results.question: Under what condition may the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN or serving SNPN
results.model_answer: The UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE may be included **if the UE has deleted one or more UE radio capability IDs assigned by the AMF and stored in the UE**.

results.question: What capability must both the UE and network support for the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE to be included?
results.reference: both the UE and the network support RACS
results.model_answer: Both the UE and the network must support the **UE radio capability ID** feature/capability.

results.question: When shall the UE start timer T35xx?
results.reference: upon sending the RELAY KEY REQUEST message
results.model_answer:
“T35xx” is not a single NAS timer in TS 24.501; it denotes a range of timers. The UE starts each specific T35xx timer at the procedure-specific point defined for that timer—often when transmitting the relevant NAS request/response message.

For example:

- **T3510**: “The UE shall start timer T3510 when it sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message.”
- **T3521**: started when the UE sends a **DEREGISTRATION REQUEST** message.

Therefore, the exact start condition depends on the particular timer (e.g. T3510, T3516, T3521, T3525, etc.).

results.question: What state shall a UE not supporting S1 mode enter after handling an abnormal DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with 're-registration not required'?
results.reference: enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH in order to perform a PLMN selection or SNPN selection according to 3GPPTS23.122[5]
results.model_answer: “A UE not supporting S1 mode shall enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.”

results.question: To which entity is the SERVICE REJECT message sent?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: The **SERVICE REJECT** message is sent **by the network to the UE**.

results.question: What is the direction of the SERVICE REJECT message?
results.reference: network to UE
results.model_answer:
The **SERVICE REJECT** message is sent **from the network to the UE** (downlink).

> “The SERVICE REJECT message is sent by the network to the UE to reject a service request.”

results.question: In which message does the UE indicate NSAG support via the 5GMM capability IE?
results.reference: the REGISTRATION REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The UE indicates NSAG support in the **REGISTRATION REQUEST** message, using the **5GMM capability** IE.

results.question: What is the condition for the Emergency number list IE to be sent?
results.reference: If this IE is sent
results.model_answer: The **Emergency number list IE shall be included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the UE performs an emergency registration**.

results.question: What is the title of Figure 6.1.3.3.1.1?
results.reference: The 5GSM sublayer states for PDU session handling in the network (overview)
results.model_answer: Figure 6.1.3.3.1.1: **“Initial registration procedure”**

results.question: What are the two core network types that a UE selects between?
results.reference: EPC or 5GCN
results.model_answer: A UE selects between the **5G Core network (5GC)** and the **Evolved Packet Core (EPC)**.

results.question: According to clause 4.5, what is the function of the unified access control?
results.reference: to prevent overload of the access network and the core network
results.model_answer: The unified access control function controls UE access attempts to the 5GS, allowing the network to restrict or permit access based on the UE’s access identity and the access category (e.g. during congestion or overload).

results.question: When does the UE use the default value of timer T3502 if a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received?
results.reference: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received without a value specified
results.model_answer: The UE shall use the default value of timer T3502 **if the T3502 value IE is not included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message**.

results.question: What identity does the network retrieve from the UE if authentication fails with a 5G-GUTI?
results.reference: SUCI
results.model_answer:
If authentication fails and the UE was identified using a 5G-GUTI, the network initiates the Identification procedure to retrieve the **SUCI** from the UE.

> “... the network shall initiate the identification procedure to retrieve the SUCI from the UE.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the notification procedure when the network sends a NOTIFICATION message over 3GPP access?
results.reference: to request the UE, by sending the NOTIFICATION message over 3GPP access, to re-establish the user-plane resources of PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access over 3GPP access or to deliver 5GSM downlink signalling messages associated with non-3GPP access over 3GPP access when the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access and in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access
results.model_answer: The notification procedure is used by the network to notify the UE of **pending mobile-terminated services** and to request the UE to initiate a **service request procedure** over the indicated access type.

results.question: Under what condition may the network include the NSAG information IE?
results.reference: If the UE has set the NSAG bit to "NSAG supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The network may include the **NSAG information IE** if the UE has indicated support for NSAG in the **UE 5GMM capability** IE.

results.question: What must the AMF decide regarding the requested CIoT 5GS optimization for the network to include the Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE?
results.reference: the AMF decides to accept the requested CIoT 5GS optimization
results.model_answer:
The AMF must decide to **accept the requested CIoT 5GS optimization**.

> “If the AMF has decided to accept the requested CIoT 5GS optimization, the AMF shall include the Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.”

results.question: Which specific IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message must contain a request for 'control plane CIoT 5GS optimization' for the network to potentially include the Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE?
results.reference: 5GS update type IE
results.model_answer:
The request must be included in the **UE 5GMM capability IE** of the **REGISTRATION REQUEST** message.

Specifically, the UE indicates support/request for **control plane CIoT 5GS optimization** in the UE 5GMM capability IE, which can enable the network to include the **Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE**.

results.question: In which message does the UE provide the SOR transparent container IE during the registration procedure?
results.reference: REGISTRATION COMPLETE message
results.model_answer: The UE provides the **SOR transparent container IE in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message**.

results.question: Is the Forbidden TAI(s) IE always included for the '5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming' list?
results.reference: This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access
results.model_answer:
No. The **Forbidden TAI(s)** field is included only when the **Number of elements** indicates one or more forbidden TAI list elements.

In other words, a list whose type is **“5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming”** does not by itself mandate inclusion of Forbidden TAI(s); it depends on the number of elements in the list.

results.question: What is the purpose of the network including the NSAG information IE?
results.reference: to provide NSAG information to the UE
results.model_answer: The network includes the **NSAG information IE** to provide the UE with information about the **Network Slice Access Groups (NSAGs)** associated with the allowed S-NSSAIs, so that the UE can use the applicable NSAG when requesting access to network slices.

results.question: What shall the UE do upon receiving a SERVICE ACCEPT message for cases other than h) in subclause 5.6.1.1?
results.reference: The UE shall treat the reception of the SERVICE ACCEPT message as successful completion of the procedure. The UE shall reset the service request attempt counter, stop timer T3517 and enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED
results.model_answer: Upon receiving a **SERVICE ACCEPT** message, for cases other than h) in subclause 5.6.1.1, the UE **shall stop timer T3517, if running, and shall consider the service request procedure successfully completed**.

results.question: What is the network's action when a lower layer failure occurs before receiving the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE or SECURITY MODE REJECT message?
results.reference: abort the security mode control procedure
results.model_answer: “If a lower layer failure occurs before the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE or SECURITY MODE REJECT message is received, the AMF shall abort the security mode control procedure.”

results.question: What generates the SoR-MAC-IUE in the SOR transparent container IE when the UE provides it in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message with Payload container type set to "SOR transparent container"?
results.reference: generated by the UE
results.model_answer: “The SoR-MAC-IUE is generated by the UE as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501.”

results.question: What list does the Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicate forbidden tracking areas for?
results.reference: the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
results.model_answer: “The Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicates a list of tracking areas that are forbidden for regional provision of service.”

results.question: What shall the UE do if it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of '5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming' IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and the TAI(s) is not part of that list?
results.reference: the UE shall store the TAI(s) included in the IE into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and remove the TAI(s) from the stored TAI list if present
results.model_answer:
The UE shall **replace its stored list of “5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming” with the received list**.

Therefore, a TAI that is not included in the received list is not retained as a forbidden TAI merely because it was present in an earlier stored list.

results.question: Under what UE mode condition shall the network include the Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE?
results.reference: the UE is in NB-N1 mode
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE** if the UE is in **5GMM-IDLE mode**.

results.question: How does the network handle a collision between the security mode control procedure and a UE-initiated registration procedure?
results.reference: abort the security mode control procedure and proceed with the UE initiated procedure
results.model_answer: If the network receives a **REGISTRATION REQUEST** from the UE while a security mode control procedure is ongoing, the network **shall abort the security mode control procedure and initiate the registration procedure**.

results.question: What shall the UE set the PRTI IE of the RELAY KEY REQUEST message to?
results.reference: the allocated PRTI value
results.model_answer: The UE shall set the PRTI IE to a **ProSe relay transaction identifier value that is not already in use for another ongoing relay key management procedure**.

results.question: During which procedure can a UE request the use of both MICO mode with active time and eDRX?
results.reference: during a registration procedure
results.model_answer:
During the **registration procedure**.

> “The UE can request the use of MICO mode with active time and eDRX during the registration procedure.”

results.question: What is described and shown in Figure 6.1.3.3.1.1?
results.reference: the possible 5GSM sublayer states of the network
results.model_answer:
Figure 6.1.3.3.1.1 shows the format of a **security protected 5GS NAS message using a 5G NAS security context**.

It consists of the security-protected NAS message header—containing the **extended protocol discriminator**, **security header type**, **message authentication code**, and **sequence number**—followed by the **plain 5GS NAS message**. The plain NAS message may be integrity protected only or both integrity protected and ciphered, depending on the security header type.

results.question: Which message does the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message acknowledge?
results.reference: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE** message acknowledges receipt of a **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND** message.

results.question: What does NOTE 1 state about the transitions shown in Figure 6.1.3.3.1.1?
results.reference: Not all possible transitions are shown in this figure
results.model_answer: NOTE 1 states that the transitions shown in Figure 6.1.3.3.1.1 are not exhaustive; additional state transitions are specified in the relevant procedure descriptions.

results.question: Which entity integrity protects the SOR transparent container IE when provided in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
results.reference: the HPLMN or subscribed SNPN
results.model_answer: The **HPLMN** integrity protects the SOR transparent container IE (using the SOR MAC/keying material derived for SOR), while the AMF transparently delivers it in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

results.question: What should the extended DRX parameters allow for when both MICO mode with active time and eDRX are accepted?
results.reference: multiple paging occasions before the active timer expires
results.model_answer: When both MICO mode with active time and eDRX are accepted, the extended DRX parameters shall allow the UE **to monitor paging at least once during the active time**.

results.question: What type of signalling is covered in Clause 9 of TS 24.501?
results.reference: MO IMS registration related signalling
results.model_answer: Clause 9 covers **security protected NAS signalling**, i.e. **security protected NAS messages** exchanged between the UE and the AMF.

results.question: Who decides whether to enable MICO mode with active time and eDRX when both are requested?
results.reference: it is up to the network to decide
results.model_answer: The network decides whether to enable MICO mode with active time and eDRX.

results.question: What identity shall the UE populate the 5GS mobile identity IE with if it has a valid 5G-GUTI?
results.reference: the valid 5G-GUTI
results.model_answer: “If the UE has a valid 5G-GUTI, the UE shall populate the 5GS mobile identity IE with the 5G-GUTI.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the Uplink data status IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE has uplink user data pending to be sent
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Uplink data status IE** in the **SERVICE REQUEST** message **if it has pending uplink data for one or more PDU sessions**.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE apply a T3502 value received in an integrity-protected REGISTRATION REJECT message?
results.reference: the UE shall apply this value until a new value is received with integrity protection or a new PLMN is selected.
results.model_answer:
The UE applies the received T3502 value **only when the REGISTRATION REJECT message is integrity protected**:

> “The UE shall apply the received T3502 value only if the REGISTRATION REJECT message is integrity protected.”

results.question: What are the three ways the AMF can initiate the generic UE configuration update procedure in the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message?
results.reference:
a) include one or more of the following parameters: 5G-GUTI, TAI list, allowed NSSAI that may include the mapped S-NSSAI(s), LADN information, service area list, MICO indication, NITZ information, configured NSSAI that may include the mapped S-NSSAI(s), rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the Rejected NSSAI IE or in the Extended rejected NSSAI IE, network slicing subscription change indication, operator-defined access category definitions, SMS indication, service gap time value, "CAG information list", UE radio capability ID, 5GS registration result, UE radio capability ID deletion indication, truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration, T3447 value, "list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition", disaster roaming wait range, disaster return wait range, PEIPS assistance information or the priority indicator
b) include the Configuration update indication IE with the Registration requested bit set to "registration requested"; or
c) include a combination of both a) and b)
results.model_answer:
The AMF can initiate the procedure by sending a **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND** with the **Configuration update indication** IE indicating:

1. **Acknowledgement requested** — the UE shall return a **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE** message.  
2. **Registration requested** — the UE shall initiate a registration procedure.  
3. **Both acknowledgement and registration requested** — the UE shall send **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE** and initiate registration.

results.question: For how long shall the UE try to send the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE is to be switched off?
results.reference: a period of 5 seconds
results.model_answer: “If the UE is to be switched off, the UE shall try to send the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message for a period of **5 seconds**.”

results.question: In which three cases is the use of the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-IA0 allowed?
results.reference:
a) for an unauthenticated UE for which establishment of emergency services is allowed
b) for an W-AGF acting on behalf of an FN-RG; and
c) for a W-AGF acting on behalf of an N5GC device
results.model_answer:
The null NAS integrity algorithm **5G-IA0** is allowed only for NAS signalling associated with emergency services, namely:

1. **Emergency registration procedure**  
2. **Emergency service request procedure**  
3. **Deregistration procedure following an emergency registration**

results.question: When selecting a PLMN, what does the UE base its core network type selection on regarding EPC?
results.reference: indication from the lower layers about the CIoT EPS optimizations supported in EPC
results.model_answer: The UE bases its core network type selection on **the availability of EPC in the selected PLMN**.

results.question: For which access type is the Forbidden TAI(s) IE included?
results.reference: satellite NG-RAN access
results.model_answer: The **Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included for non-3GPP access**.

results.question: What are the possible network decisions regarding MICO mode with active time and eDRX when both are requested?
results.reference: to enable none, one of them or both

results.question: What timer shall be started in the UE after sending the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message if the de-registration request is not due to switch off and the UE is in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED or 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED?
results.reference: timer T3521
results.model_answer:
The UE shall start **timer T3521**.

> “If the de-registration request is not due to switch off, the UE shall start timer T3521.”

results.question: How does the ME acknowledge successful reception of updated UE configuration parameters?
results.reference: using the UE-initiated uplink NAS transport procedure
results.model_answer: The ME acknowledges successful reception of updated UE configuration parameters by sending a **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE** message to the network (when acknowledgement is requested in the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND).

results.question: What network configuration is required for providing the Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration IE for control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations?
results.reference: the network is configured to provide the truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration for control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations
results.model_answer:
The AMF needs to be configured to support **control plane CIoT 5GS optimization**.

The *Truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration* IE is provided only when the AMF is configured for this optimization (and provides the associated truncated 5G-S-TMSI configuration).

results.question: What can the network release on a single access of an MA PDU session using the network-requested procedure?
results.reference: the user-plane resources
results.model_answer: “The network can release the user plane resources associated with a single access of a MA PDU session by using the network requested PDU session release procedure.”

results.question: If a SERVICE REJECT with cause #28 is received over 3GPP access and the service type was not 'elevated signalling', what shall the UE do?
results.reference: enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE, wait for the release of the N1 NAS signalling connection and perform the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
results.model_answer: The UE shall **start timer T3448**. While T3448 is running, the UE shall not initiate another service request over 3GPP access for a non-elevated-signalling service.

results.question: For what type of PDU session are some transitions shown in Figure 6.1.3.3.1.1 not applicable?
results.reference: the MA PDU session
results.model_answer: Some transitions are not applicable to an **always-on PDU session**.

results.question: How should the UE handle a CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND received after sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST on the same access type?
results.reference: the UE shall ignore the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message and proceed with the de-registration procedure
results.model_answer: “If the UE receives a CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message after the UE has sent a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message for the same access type, the UE shall ignore the CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.”

results.question: Under what condition does a UE that supports CIoT optimizations perform core network selection?
results.reference: if the lower layers have provided an indication that the current E-UTRA cell is connected to both EPC and 5GCN
results.model_answer:
A UE that supports CIoT optimizations performs core network selection **when it supports both N1 mode (5GS) and S1 mode (EPS)**.

> “A UE that supports CIoT optimizations and supports both N1 mode and S1 mode shall perform core network selection …”

results.question: What two things can the network-requested procedure enable the network to release?
results.reference: a PDU session or the user-plane resources on a single access of an MA PDU session
results.model_answer: “The network-requested PDU session release procedure enables the network to release a PDU session and all the resources associated with the PDU session.”

results.question: Which IE shall the UE include when the Payload container type is set to N1 SM information?
results.reference: PDU session ID
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **PDU session ID IE** when the **Payload container type** is set to **N1 SM information**.

results.question: According to clause 8.2.7.36, what are the two possible operations involving the CAG information list?
results.reference: assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side
results.model_answer:
The CAG information list can be used to:

- **add CAG IDs to the Allowed CAG list**; or  
- **delete CAG IDs from the Allowed CAG list**.

results.question: Under what condition shall the AMF retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message after a handover failure?
results.reference: If a failure of the handover procedure is reported by the lower layer and the N1 signalling connection exists, the AMF shall retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: In case of handover failure, the AMF shall retransmit the **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** message **if it has not received a SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message from the UE**.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the CAG information list IE according to clause 8.2.7.36?
results.reference: to assign a new "CAG information list" to the UE or delete the "CAG information list" at the UE side
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the CAG information list IE is to provide the UE with information about the CAGs for which the UE is allowed to access the associated cells.”

results.question: Which ME configuration parameter update is supported for a PLMN in this release?
results.reference: default configured NSSAI
results.model_answer: “In this release, the only ME configuration parameter that can be updated by the network on a per PLMN basis is the configured NSSAI.”

results.question: Where does the AMF indicate the NSSAI inclusion mode in which the UE shall operate?
results.reference: via the NSSAI inclusion mode IE of a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
results.model_answer:
The AMF indicates it in the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message:

> “The AMF shall indicate the NSSAI inclusion mode in which the UE shall operate in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.”

results.question: Which IE is included when the network needs to provide the RQ timer value?
results.reference: RQ timer value
results.model_answer:
The network includes the **RQ timer value IE**.

> “The RQ timer value IE shall be included if the network needs to provide the RQ timer value.”

results.question: When the Payload container type IE is set to "Multiple payloads" and the payload container type field is set to "UE parameters update transparent container", what protects the payload container entry contents field?
results.reference: integrity protected correspondingly
results.model_answer: The payload container entry contents field is protected by the **5G NAS security context** — i.e. it is **NAS integrity protected and ciphered** (with the security protection applied to the NAS transport message).

results.question: What specific IDs does the network trigger the UE to delete with the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE?
results.reference: all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN or serving SNPN
results.model_answer: The indication triggers deletion of the UE’s stored **UE radio capability ID associated with the serving PLMN**, as well as the UE radio capability ID(s) associated with that PLMN’s **equivalent PLMN(s)**.

results.question: Under what condition may the AMF include the Extended rejected NSSAI IE?
results.reference: If the UE supports Extended rejected NSSAI
results.model_answer: The AMF may include the **Extended rejected NSSAI IE** **if the UE has indicated support for the Extended rejected NSSAI IE in the UE 5GMM capability IE**.

results.question: Which 5GMM parameters shall the UE delete upon receiving a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with certain abnormal cause values and 're-registration not required'?
results.reference: delete 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs (if any), ngKSI

results.question: What shall the UE do if the current TAI is not in the TAI list during transmission failure of CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE with TAI change?
results.reference: the generic UE configuration update procedure shall be aborted and a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update shall be initiated
results.model_answer: If transmission of the **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE** message fails and the current TAI is not included in the received TAI list, the UE **shall initiate a registration procedure with the registration type set to “mobility registration updating.”**

results.question: What does the Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicate for the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service?
results.reference: the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored
results.model_answer: “The Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicates the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service.”
